disableEffect: Benshi will no longer record app-close events through this service.

name: ai.causalfoundry.android.sdk.core.nudge.activities.CFNotificationActivity

disableEffect: Causal Foundry will no longer receive the dismissal event through this receiver.

name: ai.causalfoundry.android.sdk.core.nudge.receivers.NotificationOnClickBroadcastReceiver

disableEffect: Taps on Causal Foundry nudge notifications will no longer be processed by the SDK.

name: ai.causalfoundry.android.sdk.core.nudge.services.GetBackendNudgeService
description: When Android reports a network connection change, the Causal Foundry SDK checks connectivity and schedules a fetch for new nudges.
disableEffect: Causal Foundry will no longer schedule nudge fetches through this connectivity receiver.

name: ai.causalfoundry.android.sdk.core.services.AppLifecycleService
description: When the user removes the app from recent tasks, the Causal Foundry SDK service records an app-close event and stops.
disableEffect: Causal Foundry will no longer record app-close events through this service.

name: ai.devrev.sdk.plug.activity.PlugActivity

disableEffect: The app’s in-app DevRev support chat and file attachments will be unavailable.

disableEffect: The app’s OpenBot chat, bot answers, feedback, and support actions will be unavailable.

name: ai.engagely.openbot.view.activities.YouTubePlayerActivity

name: ai.fedml.edge.utils.preference.SharedPreferenceProvider

description: Leqi ShareCenter opens a web-based sharing page whose options can save images to the photo album, share them to WeChat friends or Moments, and request WeChat authorization.

name: ai.leqi.lib_share_center.ui.WXEntryActivity
description: Leqi ShareCenter uses this Activity to receive results from WeChat after sharing or authorization. It returns authorization codes to the sharing page and displays other operation results.
disableEffect: WeChat authorization and sharing cannot return their results to ShareCenter.

name: ai.meson.rendering.MesonFullScreenActivity
description: When Meson displays a full-screen ad or in-ad page, this Activity attaches the ad view and handles its close and navigation controls.
disableEffect: Full-screen Meson ads and their in-ad pages will not display.

name: ai.meson.rendering.MesonLandingPageActivity
description: When a user opens a Meson ad landing page, this Activity attaches the requested ad view and reports when it is displayed.
disableEffect: Meson ad landing pages will no longer open.

name: ai.meson.sdk.testsuite.SdkTestSuiteActivity
description: The Meson test suite opens this screen with SDK test data to check the integration and fetch the test results.
disableEffect: The Meson SDK setup-check screen will no longer be available.

name: ai.nextbillion.assettracking.receiver.BatteryLevelReceiver
description: Android battery-level broadcasts trigger the NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK receiver. It forwards the percentage so the tracking service can include it with location records and show low-battery warnings.
disableEffect: Disabling the manifest entry does not stop location tracking or battery updates during an active tracking session; the SDK also listens for battery changes while tracking.

name: ai.nextbillion.assettracking.service.AssetTrackingJobService
description: Android runs this scheduled job for the NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK when its tracking job is due. It restores the saved tracking settings and starts asset-location tracking if tracking is not already running.
disableEffect: Background asset tracking may fail to restart or resume after Android stops its tracking service.

name: ai.nextbillion.assettracking.service.AssetTrackingService
description: The NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK starts this foreground service when asset tracking is enabled. It requests device location updates, records and batches positions with battery information, and uploads the batches to the tracking service.
disableEffect: The app can no longer collect and send ongoing asset locations in the background.

name: ai.nextbillion.assettracking.service.RemoteService
description: The NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK starts this foreground service in a separate app process while tracking is active. It helps sustain background location tracking and maintains the SDK's tracking notification.
disableEffect: The app's background asset tracking may stop or fail to resume.

name: ai.nextbillion.navigation.core.navigation.NavigationService
description: The NextBillion Navigation SDK starts this foreground service when guided navigation begins. It continues receiving location updates and maintains navigation status and notifications while the route is active.
disableEffect: The app may not keep guided navigation active or show its navigation notification in the background.

name: ai.nextbillion.navigation.ui.NextBillionPreviewActivity
description: When the app opens this screen with a route, the NextBillion Navigation SDK displays a map preview and lets users step through its turns.
disableEffect: Users lose the app's visual route-preview screen before navigation.

name: ai.nextbillion.navigation.ui.NextbillionNavActivity
description: The NextBillion Navigation SDK launches this screen when the app begins turn-by-turn guidance. It loads the selected route, displays the map, and updates guidance as the device location changes.
disableEffect: The app's NextBillion turn-by-turn navigation screen cannot open.

name: ai.passio.passiosdk.core.download.PassioDownloadService
description: Passio Nutrition AI schedules this background service when required recognition files are missing. It downloads the requested model files into the SDK's data folder so food recognition can run.
disableEffect: Food recognition may not initialize when required model files are absent.

name: ai.proba.probasdk.ProbaDebugActivity
description: The Proba Android SDK opens this developer screen when the app launches its experiment controls. It lets a tester inspect available experiments and save or clear local test overrides.
disableEffect: Blocking it only removes the SDK's experiment-testing screen; regular app screens and features remain available.

name: ai.promoted.metrics.usecases.anomaly.ModalAnomalyActivity
description: The Promoted.AI Android Metrics SDK opens this dialog for a reported initialization or logging anomaly. It shows a problem description and Promoted support contacts, and identifies the warning as intended for development builds.
disableEffect: Disabling it hides the SDK's diagnostic dialog without affecting the app's normal screens.

name: ai.redpen.capture.sdk.screenshot.RecordingIdentifierService
description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK starts this service after a user begins a screen recording for a report. It shows a floating timer with controls and opens the report form when recording ends.
disableEffect: Redpen screen-recording reports lose the floating timer and the automatic transition from recording to the report form.

name: ai.redpen.capture.sdk.screenshot.ScreenCaptureService
description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK starts this foreground service after the user grants screen-capture permission. It records the device display into a video file for attaching to a feedback report.
disableEffect: The SDK cannot attach a screen recording to a report.

name: ai.redpen.capture.sdk.screenshot.ScreenshotService
description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK starts this foreground service after the user grants screen-capture permission. It saves screen images and passes the captured files to the report flow.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to attach screenshots to Redpen reports.

name: ai.redpen.capture.sdk.ui.IssueActivity
description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK opens this form when a user submits a screenshot or screen-recording report. It collects a title and details, attaches the selected evidence, and sends the issue to the configured project board.
disableEffect: Users cannot send issue reports through Redpen.

name: ai.redpen.capture.sdk.ui.OnBoardingScreen
description: When the host app opens it, the Redpen Capture Widget SDK shows a brief onboarding overlay. It closes itself after about five seconds.
disableEffect: The brief Redpen onboarding overlay will not be shown.

name: ai.redpen.capture.sdk.ui.RedpenWidgetScreen
description: The app or SDK opens this screen when a user chooses Redpen feedback. It lets them start a screenshot or screen recording and attach it to a report.
disableEffect: Users lose Redpen's in-app screenshot and screen-recording report flow.

name: ai.tabby.android.internal.ui.SimpleWebActivity
description: The Tabby Android SDK opens this in-app web page when a shopper taps Learn More on Tabby's installment widget. It loads the financing information page using the purchase amount and currency, then closes from its close control or Back.
disableEffect: Shoppers cannot open the Tabby installment information page from that widget.

name: ai.tabby.android.internal.ui.TabbyCheckoutActivity
description: The Tabby Android SDK opens this screen with the checkout address for the selected purchase. It hosts Tabby's checkout page and returns the checkout result to the app when the flow ends.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete the app's Tabby checkout flow or return its result to the app.

name: ai.zerek.sdk.core.providers.APFileProvider
description: The ZerekAI SDK uses this Provider when a user shares a story image, creating the file link that the sharing sheet sends to another app.
disableEffect: Sharing a ZerekAI story image may fail because other apps can no longer open the file.

name: ai.zerek.sdk.ui.components.video.APAlarmReceiver
description: The ZerekAI SDK can start this Receiver with a direct cleanup message naming a video file; it deletes that file from the app cache.
disableEffect: Video files it was asked to delete may remain in the app cache and use storage.

name: am.mediastre.mediastreamplatformsdkandroid.MediastreamCastNotificationActivity
description: Mediastream Platform uses this Cast entry to bring the app's existing screen to the foreground, then closes. It runs when that entry is opened.
disableEffect: The Cast entry will no longer bring the app to the foreground; media already playing can continue.

name: am.mediastre.mediastreamplatformsdkandroid.MediastreamExpandedControlsActivity
description: Mediastream Platform provides Google's expanded Cast controller as a full-screen control page during Cast playback.
disableEffect: Users will lose the expanded Cast controls page provided by Mediastream Platform.

name: am.mediastre.mediastreamplatformsdkandroid.MediastreamPlayerService$Companion$NotificationReceiver
description: Mediastream Platform listens for Next and Previous actions from its media playback notification and tells the player to change tracks.
disableEffect: The Next and Previous buttons in the playback notification will no longer change tracks.

name: ando.file.core.FileProvider
description: Ando File Operator (Javakam) uses this provider when the app opens or shares local files through the library. It gives another app temporary access to a selected file.
disableEffect: File opening or sharing through Ando File Operator can fail if this provider is disabled.

name: ando.gallery.PictureCustomCameraActivity
description: Ando Gallery (Javakam) opens this screen when its picker is configured to use the built-in camera. It lets the user take a photo or record a video and returns the capture to the picker.
disableEffect: The app can no longer capture photos or videos with Ando Gallery's built-in camera.

name: ando.gallery.PictureExternalPreviewActivity
description: Ando Gallery opens this viewer when the app asks to preview supplied photos or videos outside the picker. It lets the user browse the items and, when enabled, delete or save them.
disableEffect: External media preview and its enabled save or delete actions will stop working.

name: ando.gallery.PictureFileProvider
description: Ando Gallery uses this provider when it creates a camera output file or shares selected media. It gives the camera or receiving app access to the file through a temporary link.
disableEffect: Camera capture and file sharing through Ando Gallery can fail when it cannot provide access to the media file.

name: ando.gallery.PicturePreviewActivity
description: Ando Gallery opens this full-screen viewer from its media picker so the user can browse selected items, change the selection, and crop photos when cropping is enabled.
disableEffect: Users can no longer preview or crop selected media inside Ando Gallery.

name: ando.gallery.PictureSelectorActivity
description: Ando Gallery opens this screen when the app starts its media picker. It lets the user browse device albums and choose photos, videos, or audio files for the app.
disableEffect: The app loses Ando Gallery's media-selection flow.

name: ando.gallery.PictureSelectorCameraEmptyActivity
description: Ando Gallery uses this screen when its picker routes photo, video, or audio capture through the device camera or recorder. It requests the needed permission, processes the returned file, and adds it to the selection result.
disableEffect: The picker's standard camera or audio-capture flow can no longer return media to the app.

name: ando.gallery.PictureSelectorPreviewWeChatStyleActivity
description: Ando Gallery opens this WeChat-style preview while the user reviews selected photos or videos. It shows the current item and selected-item strip before the user confirms the choice.
disableEffect: Reviewing and confirming selected media in Ando Gallery's WeChat-style preview will stop working.

name: ando.gallery.PictureSelectorWeChatStyleActivity
description: Ando Gallery uses this alternate picker screen to show device media in a WeChat-style layout. The user can select items and return them to the app.
disableEffect: The app can no longer use Ando Gallery's WeChat-style media picker.

name: ando.gallery.PictureVideoPlayActivity
description: Ando Gallery opens this player when a user previews a video from the picker or media viewer. It plays the video and can return it as the selected item.
disableEffect: Video playback inside Ando Gallery stops, so apps that require this preview cannot complete that step.

name: ando.webview.core.ActionActivity
description: Ando WebView (Javakam) opens this screen when an embedded page requests the device's location. It checks whether Android should explain the permission and then asks for location access.
disableEffect: Web pages in the app can no longer request location permission through Ando WebView.

name: android.accounts.CantAddAccountActivity
description: Just shows an error message about the account restrictions for the limited user.

name: android.app.Activity
description: An activity is a single, focused thing that the user can do. Almost all activities interact with the user, so the Activity class takes care of creating a window for you in which you can place your UI with #setContentView. While activities are often presented to the user as full-screen windows, they can also be used in other ways: as floating windows (via a theme with android.R.attr#windowIsFloating set).

name: android.arch.lifecycle.LifecycleRuntimeTrojanProvider
description: Google Android Architecture Components initializes this Provider as an app process starts; it registers app lifecycle callbacks and sets up foreground and background tracking.
disableEffect: App features that rely on automatic lifecycle events may stop detecting foreground and background changes correctly.

name: android.arch.lifecycle.ProcessLifecycleOwnerInitializer
description: Google Android Architecture Components initializes this Provider as an app process starts; it registers app lifecycle callbacks and sets up foreground and background tracking.
disableEffect: App features that rely on automatic lifecycle events may stop detecting foreground and background changes correctly.

name: android.content.SyncActivityTooManyDeletes
description: Presents multiple options for handling the case where a sync was aborted because there were too many pending deletes. One option is to force the delete, another is to rollback the deletes, the third is to do nothing.

name: android.ext.services.displayhash.DisplayHashingServiceImpl
description: The implementation service for DisplayHashingService

name: android.ext.services.notification.Assistant
description: Notification assistant that provides guidance on notification channel blocking

name: android.ext.services.resolver.LRResolverRankerService
description: A Logistic Regression based android.service.resolver.ResolverRankerService, to be used in ResolverComparator.

name: android.ext.services.storage.CacheQuotaServiceImpl
description: CacheQuotaServiceImpl implements the CacheQuotaService with a strategy for populating the quota of CacheQuotaHint.

name: android.ext.services.watchdog.ExplicitHealthCheckServiceImpl
description: Routes explicit health check requests to the appropriate ExplicitHealthChecker.

name: android.hardware.location.GeofenceHardwareService
description: Service that handles hardware geofencing.

name: android.lorenwang.commonbaseframe.image.AcbflwPictureCropActivity
description: When the app’s picture-cropping flow finishes, this Loren Wang common-frame Activity returns the cropped photo to the app.
disableEffect: Picture cropping through this library cannot return the edited photo to the app.

name: android.service.games.GameSessionTrampolineActivity
description: Trampoline activity that enables the GameSession#startActivityFromGameSessionForResult(Intent, Bundle, Executor, GameSessionActivityCallback) API by reusing existing activity result infrastructure in the Activity class. This activity forwards activity results back to the calling GameSession via AndroidFuture.

name: android.service.selectiontoolbar.DefaultSelectionToolbarRenderService
description: The default implementation of SelectionToolbarRenderService. <b>NOTE:<b/> The requests are handled on the service main thread.

name: android.support.v4.content.FileProvider
description: Android Support Library creates a shareable link to an app file when another app or SDK needs to open or share it. It runs when the host app requests that file link.
disableEffect: File sharing, opening, or installation flows that use this provider can fail; an SDK that requests a file link from it can also fail.

name: android.support.v4.media.session.MediaButtonReceiver
description: The Android Support Library media receiver forwards button presses from headsets and other media controls to the active playback service. Disabling it prevents those buttons from controlling playback.
disableEffect: Headset and other media-control buttons will no longer control the app's audio playback.

name: android.support.v7.mms.MmsService
description: Service to execute MMS requests using deprecated legacy APIs on older platform (prior to L)

name: androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
description: AndroidX Activity provides a basic app screen for showing content and remembering its state as the app pauses or restarts. It also handles the system Back button and requests that open other screens; the analyzed manifests give it no launch entry, so an app or test must start it directly.
disableEffect: Tests or app actions that directly open this basic screen will no longer be able to use it.

name: androidx.ads.identifier.provider.internal.AdvertisingIdService
description: AndroidX Ads Identifier Provider starts when an app binds to request the advertising ID and returns the registered provider through the service connection.
disableEffect: Advertising requests that use this provider will no longer receive its identifier.

name: androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
description: AndroidX AppCompat helps apps keep their screens and controls working consistently across Android versions. This standalone Activity has no page content of its own.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops this empty screen from opening; other app screens that use AppCompat are separate and can remain available.

name: androidx.appcompat.app.AppLocalesMetadataHolderService
description: AndroidX AppCompat reads this service entry metadata when deciding whether to save and restore the language selected in the app.
disableEffect: AppCompat reads this component metadata even while it is disabled and can enable it during Android locale synchronization, so disabling the entry does not remove in-app language support.

name: androidx.appfunctions.internal.AppFunctionCallerVerificationReceiver
description: AndroidX AppFunctions targets this private Receiver with a one-time caller-check message; the Receiver returns a success result to the access check.
disableEffect: App functions that require this caller check may be denied before they run.

name: androidx.appfunctions.service.ExtensionAppFunctionService
description: AndroidX AppFunctions starts this service when the system requests a function published by the app; it runs the requested function and returns its result or an error.
disableEffect: The system and other authorized callers will no longer be able to run functions the app exposes through Android AppFunctions.

name: androidx.appfunctions.service.PlatformAppFunctionService
description: On supported Android versions, AndroidX AppFunctions starts this service when the platform requests a function published by the app; it runs the function and returns its result or an error.
disableEffect: The platform will no longer be able to run functions the app exposes through Android AppFunctions.

name: androidx.benchmark.IsolationActivity
description: The AndroidX Benchmark test runner opens this full-screen Activity during performance measurements and keeps it visible until the run is done. It appears only in instrumented benchmark runs.
disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts benchmark runs that use this screen.

name: androidx.biometric.DeviceCredentialHandlerActivity
description: AndroidX Biometric opens this Activity when an authentication prompt uses the phone lock-screen credential; it starts the credential check and returns its result to the app.
disableEffect: Apps that use AndroidX Biometric for a device PIN, pattern, or password check may fail to complete authentication.

name: androidx.biometric.internal.ui.FingerprintDialogActivity
description: AndroidX Biometric opens this Activity for its fingerprint authentication flow on supported devices; it displays the prompt and returns success, cancellation, or an error to the app.
disableEffect: Apps relying on this AndroidX fingerprint prompt may be unable to authenticate users.

name: androidx.browser.customtabs.PostMessageService
description: When a compatible Custom Tabs browser binds this AndroidX Browser service, it forwards browser-ready and browser message callbacks to the app.
disableEffect: Custom Tabs message channels stop working, which can interrupt app flows that rely on browser-to-app messages.

name: androidx.camera.core.impl.MetadataHolderService
description: AndroidX CameraX reads this disabled-by-default Service's package information while initializing the camera to find the default Camera2 setup and compatibility settings; the Service itself is never started.
disableEffect: Disabling it does not hide its package metadata from CameraX, so camera setup and camera features continue to work.

name: androidx.camera.featurecombinationquery.playservices.MetadataHolderService
description: When an app asks AndroidX CameraX which camera feature combinations a device supports, this Service advertises the Google Play services provider that answers the query. CameraX reads this entry while setting up the query.
disableEffect: Without this entry, devices that lack a native replacement may no longer report supported camera combinations, which can make camera modes that depend on those checks unavailable.

name: androidx.car.app.CarAppMetadataHolderService
description: AndroidX Android for Cars App reads this disabled-by-default Service's package information when setting up car hardware access and result handling; its metadata selects the Automotive or projected Android Auto implementation.
disableEffect: Blocking it leaves its package metadata readable, so the car hardware and result implementations remain available.

name: androidx.car.app.CarAppPermissionActivity
description: AndroidX Android for Cars App opens this Activity when the car host requests app permissions, shows Android's permission prompt, and returns which permissions were granted or rejected.
disableEffect: Car permission requests will not open or return their result, so car features that need those permissions may stop working.

name: androidx.car.app.notification.CarAppNotificationBroadcastReceiver
description: AndroidX Android for Cars App uses this Receiver when a user taps an app notification action; it asks the connected car host to open the app.
disableEffect: Tapping those notification actions will no longer open the car app.

name: androidx.compose.runtime.tracing.RecompositionTracingReceiver
description: A development tool can send a start or stop broadcast to the AndroidX Compose tracing Receiver to record how Compose screens are recomputed during a diagnostic session.
disableEffect: Compose recomposition tracing cannot be started or stopped through this Receiver, while normal app screens remain unaffected.

name: androidx.compose.runtime.tracing.internal.RecompositionTracingEnabledReceiver
description: AndroidX Compose tracing changes this disabled-by-default Receiver's state while recomposition capture starts or ends; it only indicates whether tracing is active and does not handle app screens.
disableEffect: Blocking it can affect tracing status checks, but Compose screens and other app features keep working.

name: androidx.compose.ui.tooling.PreviewActivity
description: AndroidX Compose Tooling opens this Activity in a debuggable app to render a requested Compose preview, including previews with sample parameters.
disableEffect: Compose previews in the development tools can no longer use this preview screen; installed app screens are unaffected.

name: androidx.core.content.FileProvider
description: AndroidX Core provides a private file-sharing component that turns files from configured folders into temporary links other apps can access. Android starts it with the app; it is used when the app shares a file or hands a photo or video to another app, and it has no screen of its own.
disableEffect: Disabling it can make file sharing, exports, photo or video handoffs, and camera capture fail when an app relies on it to give another app access to a file.

name: androidx.core.google.shortcuts.TrampolineActivity
description: AndroidX Core Google Shortcuts uses this no-display Activity to open a published shortcut: it verifies the signed shortcut link and then opens its destination screen.
disableEffect: Shortcuts published through the Google integration will no longer open their destination, while normal in-app navigation remains available.

name: androidx.core.pip.contentpip.ContentPipInternalActivity
description: AndroidX Core PiP starts this hidden Activity when an app requests its content picture-in-picture fallback; it attaches the supplied content, enters picture-in-picture, and reports when that view closes.
disableEffect: Apps using this fallback can no longer show or close their content in picture-in-picture.

name: androidx.core.telecom.internal.JetpackConnectionService
description: AndroidX Core Telecom exposes this Service to Android Telecom, which binds it for incoming or outgoing app calls so it can create the call connection.
disableEffect: Android Telecom cannot create or manage the app's calls through this Service, so call handling and system call controls may fail.

name: androidx.core.telecom.internal.MuteStateReceiver
description: AndroidX Core Telecom declares this Receiver for system microphone-mute changes. The copy started from the manifest has no call listener; active calls register their own listener directly.
disableEffect: Blocking the manifest entry does not stop active calls from tracking microphone mute changes, because they use a separate listener.

name: androidx.core.widget.RemoteViewsCompatService
description: AndroidX RemoteViews binds this Service when a home-screen widget needs a collection such as a list or grid; it supplies the saved rows for the requested widget.
disableEffect: Widgets that use these collection views lose their list or grid content and may appear empty.

name: androidx.credentials.playservices.CredentialProviderMetadataHolder
description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth advertises its Google sign-in and credential-saving provider through this Service; Credential Manager reads the entry when choosing available providers.
disableEffect: Play services sign-in, password-saving, and passkey flows may no longer find this provider.

name: androidx.credentials.playservices.HiddenActivity
description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth opens this hidden Activity while Google Play services handles sign-in, password saving, or passkey creation; it presents Google's pending screen and returns the result to Credential Manager.
disableEffect: These Play services credential flows may fail because their sign-in or confirmation screen cannot open.

name: androidx.credentials.playservices.IdentityCredentialApiHiddenActivity
description: The older AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth adapter opens this hidden Activity for digital-credential requests; it presents Google's pending identity screen and returns the user's result to Credential Manager.
disableEffect: Digital-credential retrieval through this older Play services adapter may fail.

name: androidx.credentials.playservices.controllers.identityauth.HiddenActivity
description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth opens this Activity for a pending Google sign-in, password, or passkey screen; after the user responds, it returns the result to Credential Manager.
disableEffect: Play services authentication, password-saving, and passkey operations may fail before their result can return.

name: androidx.credentials.playservices.controllers.identitycredentials.IdentityCredentialApiHiddenActivity
description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth opens this hidden Activity when Google returns a pending screen for creating or retrieving a digital credential; it sends the user's result back to Credential Manager.
disableEffect: Google digital-credential creation or sign-in through this adapter may fail.

name: androidx.credentials.providerevents.playservices.HiddenActivity
description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events with Play services opens this Activity to show Google's pending screen for a credential import or transfer and returns the outcome to the app.
disableEffect: Credential import and transfer operations through Play services cannot complete their screen handoff.

name: androidx.credentials.providerevents.playservices.ImportExportFileProvider
description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events with Play services uses this file provider to give Google Play services access to temporary credential-transfer files.
disableEffect: Google Play services can no longer open those transfer files, so credential import or export may fail.

name: androidx.credentials.providerevents.playservices.ProviderEventsMetadataHolder
description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events with Play services advertises the Google-backed provider-events implementation through this Service; the provider-events library reads the entry when selecting an implementation.
disableEffect: Play services provider-event updates and credential-transfer operations may no longer find this implementation.

name: androidx.credentials.registry.provider.playservices.RegistryManagerProviderMetadataHolder
description: The AndroidX Credentials Registry Play Services integration uses this Service to advertise the Play Services-backed credential registry to Credential Manager. That registry handles an app registering or clearing digital credentials and their sign-in options.
disableEffect: Apps that rely on this integration may lose digital credential registration and cleanup.

name: androidx.fragment.app.testing.EmptyFragmentActivity
description: AndroidX Fragment Testing launches this blank Activity when a test needs to host a fragment. It creates the fragment container and applies the requested test theme.
disableEffect: Fragment tests that use this host cannot launch, while normal app screens are unaffected.

name: androidx.glance.appwidget.GlanceRemoteViewsService
description: When the launcher requests a scrolling collection in an AndroidX Glance AppWidget, this Service supplies the collection rows for that widget. It starts or resumes the widget content needed to fill the list.
disableEffect: List sections in affected Glance widgets may appear blank or unavailable.

name: androidx.glance.appwidget.MyPackageReplacedReceiver
description: After the app is replaced by an update, AndroidX Glance checks which widget providers are still installed and removes saved entries for providers that are gone.
disableEffect: Glance may retain stale records for widget providers removed in an app update.

name: androidx.glance.appwidget.UnmanagedSessionReceiver
description: When an AndroidX Glance widget sends a tap for an action tied to an active widget session, this Receiver finds that session and runs the action. This applies to widgets that use session-based actions.
disableEffect: Glance widget controls that depend on an active session may stop responding.

name: androidx.glance.appwidget.action.ActionCallbackBroadcastReceiver
description: When a user taps a Glance widget control configured to run an app action, this Receiver reads the action details and starts that action.
disableEffect: Glance widget controls that use these app actions will stop running their assigned behavior.

name: androidx.glance.appwidget.action.ActionTrampolineActivity
description: When a user taps a Glance widget control that opens an app screen, this no-display Activity launches that screen.
disableEffect: Those widget controls will no longer open their target app screens.

name: androidx.glance.appwidget.action.InvisibleActionTrampolineActivity
description: When a user taps a Glance widget control that triggers a broadcast, service, or callback, this invisible Activity runs the assigned action without displaying a screen.
disableEffect: Those widget controls will no longer trigger their assigned app actions.

name: androidx.health.platform.client.impl.sdkservice.HealthDataSdkService
description: AndroidX Health Connect Client exposes this Service to the Health Connect system app for permission-state requests. It lets that app update or retrieve the current permission token and check whether the calling app is in the foreground.
disableEffect: Health Connect permission checks and health data access for the app may fail.

name: androidx.health.services.client.VersionApiService
description: AndroidX Health Services Client exposes this version service when the Wear OS Health Services app sends its protected binding request. It returns the Health Services API and client SDK version numbers for compatibility checks.
disableEffect: Wear OS Health Services may be unable to verify compatibility and provide health features through the app.

name: androidx.lifecycle.ProcessLifecycleOwnerInitializer
description: Class that provides lifecycle for the whole application process. It is useful for use cases where you would like to react on your app coming to the foreground or going to the background and you don't need a milliseconds accuracy in receiving lifecycle events.

name: androidx.media.session.MediaButtonReceiver
description: A media button receiver receives and helps translate hardware media playback buttons, such as those found on wired and wireless headsets, into the appropriate callbacks in your app.

name: androidx.media3.exoplayer.scheduler.PlatformScheduler$PlatformSchedulerService
description: The AndroidX Media3 playback library uses this service for scheduled media work, including downloads. Android runs it when requirements such as network access, charging, idle state, or available storage are met, and it starts the requested media service.
disableEffect: Scheduled Media3 downloads will not restart through this job when their requirements are met.

name: androidx.media3.session.BluetoothValidationActivity
description: When Android checks which apps can open audio content for Bluetooth media controls, this AndroidX Media3 Session Activity matches the check and immediately closes if launched.
disableEffect: Bluetooth may not recognize the app as an audio player when matching apps to audio content.

name: androidx.media3.session.MediaButtonReceiver
description: AndroidX Media3 receives media-button commands from headsets, car controls, and system media controls, then forwards them to the app’s media service.
disableEffect: System or headset media-button commands will no longer reach the app’s media service.

name: androidx.mediarouter.media.MediaTransferReceiver
description: AndroidX MediaRouter includes this receiver so Android’s system interface can offer media-transfer controls for apps that route playback to other devices.
disableEffect: Android’s media-transfer interface will no longer offer this app’s routed playback for moving between devices.

name: androidx.pdf.service.PdfDocumentServiceImpl
description: AndroidX PDF uses this isolated service when the PDF viewer binds to process a document. It provides PDF document processing and page rendering for apps using the AndroidX PDF library.
disableEffect: Apps using AndroidX PDF may fail to open, inspect, or render PDF documents.

name: androidx.privacysandbox.sdkruntime.client.activity.SdkActivity
description: When a Privacy Sandbox SDK used by the app asks to show a screen, AndroidX Privacy Sandbox SDK Runtime opens this Activity to display the SDK-provided screen.
disableEffect: Screens supplied by the app's Privacy Sandbox SDKs may fail to open.

name: androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstallReceiver
description: This AndroidX Profile Installer receiver runs when a developer or benchmark tool requests profile maintenance. It installs or saves the app’s startup profile and adjusts profile-related settings for benchmark runs.
disableEffect: The app can still open and use its normal features, but developer tools cannot use this receiver for profile or benchmark operations.

name: androidx.remotecallback.ProviderRelayReceiver
description: When another part of the app sends a remote callback through a content provider, this AndroidX Remote Callback receiver forwards the request to that provider.
disableEffect: Any app feature that depends on this callback path will no longer receive its callback.

name: androidx.room.MultiInstanceInvalidationService
description: This AndroidX Room service keeps data up to date when different parts of the app use the same database. When one part changes a table, it notifies the others so they can refresh.
disableEffect: A change made in one part of the app may not appear in another until it reloads, leaving information out of date.

name: androidx.room3.MultiInstanceInvalidationService
description: This AndroidX Room 3 service keeps data up to date when different parts of the app use the same database. When one part changes a table, it notifies the others so they can refresh.
disableEffect: A change made in one part of the app may not appear in another until it reloads, leaving information out of date.

name: androidx.sharetarget.ChooserTargetServiceCompat
description: This AndroidX Share Target service runs when Android asks for suggestions in the share menu. It matches the content being shared to saved app shortcuts and offers matching destinations.
disableEffect: The app’s shortcut-based destinations will no longer appear as suggestions in Android’s share menu.

name: androidx.slice.compat.SlicePermissionActivity
description: This AndroidX Slice activity opens a confirmation when another app asks to display a small shared panel from this app. If allowed, the requesting app receives access to that panel.
disableEffect: Other apps cannot complete the permission request for the app’s shared panels, so a connected view that needs approval may not appear.

name: androidx.startup.InitializationProvider
description: AndroidX Startup reads the library initializers registered in the app manifest and runs them automatically when the app process starts.
disableEffect: Libraries that rely on automatic startup can remain uninitialized, so their dependent features may not work.

name: androidx.test.core.app.InstrumentationActivityInvoker$BootstrapActivity
description: AndroidX Test Core starts this temporary Activity when an instrumentation test launches another screen for a result. It starts that screen and passes its result back to the test.
disableEffect: AndroidX Test Core tests that launch screens for results may fail; normal app launches are unaffected.

name: androidx.test.core.app.InstrumentationActivityInvoker$EmptyActivity
description: AndroidX Test Core starts this blank Activity during instrumentation tests to move the app into a stopped screen state while testing another Activity.
disableEffect: Tests that rely on these screen lifecycle transitions may fail or time out; normal app navigation is unaffected.

name: androidx.test.core.app.InstrumentationActivityInvoker$EmptyFloatingActivity
description: AndroidX Test Core starts this blank floating Activity during instrumentation tests to pause another screen and check its paused state.
disableEffect: Tests that rely on this screen lifecycle transition may fail or time out; normal app navigation is unaffected.

name: androidx.tracing.perfetto.StartupTracingConfigStoreIsEnabledGate
description: AndroidX Tracing Perfetto keeps this receiver disabled by default and checks its enabled state when deciding whether to restore saved startup-tracing settings. Tracing tools enable it while startup tracing is configured.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents saved startup-tracing settings from being restored; normal app use is unaffected.

name: androidx.tracing.perfetto.TracingReceiver
description: This AndroidX Tracing Perfetto receiver runs when a developer tool asks to record performance data now, start tracing on a later app launch, or clear that setup. These requests require Android’s DUMP permission.
disableEffect: Developers can no longer control Perfetto tracing through these requests, but the app’s own features continue to work.

name: androidx.tracing.profiler.ConnectedProfilerTracingEnabledReceiver
description: This AndroidX Tracing Wire receiver is disabled in the SDK manifest and has no intent actions. Its receive handler does nothing, so it has no task during ordinary app use.
disableEffect: Disabling it causes no visible change to the app; the receiver is already disabled and performs no work.

name: androidx.tracing.profiler.ConnectedProfilerTracingReceiver
description: This AndroidX Tracing Wire receiver runs when a developer tool with the required permission asks to start, stop, or retrieve an in-app trace. It can copy completed trace files to device storage for inspection.
disableEffect: Connected-profiler tools can no longer start, stop, or retrieve traces, but app features continue to work.

name: androidx.ui.tooling.preview.PreviewActivity
description: AndroidX Compose Tooling opens this screen for an IDE preview in a debuggable app, rendering the selected composable and, when supplied, sample values.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents IDE previews from opening; the app's normal screens continue to work.

name: androidx.wear.watchface.ComplicationHelperActivity
description: AndroidX Wear Watchface opens this screen when a user configures a watch-face complication; it requests data permission and starts the system chooser for a data source.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete the permission or data-source selection flow for watch-face complications.

name: androidx.wear.watchface.control.WatchFaceControlService
description: AndroidX Wear Watchface responds when Wear OS requests a watch-face control connection, providing the host app's watch-face instance for system management.
disableEffect: Wear OS can no longer connect to this service to manage the app's watch-face instances.

name: androidx.work.impl.WorkManagerInitializer
description: AndroidX WorkManager runs this initializer as the app process starts so scheduled background jobs can be set up.
disableEffect: Background jobs that rely on WorkManager may stop running, and apps without another initialization path may fail when scheduling them.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.firebase.FirebaseDelayedJobAlarmReceiver
description: Android WorkManager Firebase integration starts this Receiver from an alarm for deferred work, looks up the saved task, and submits it to Firebase JobDispatcher when it is due.
disableEffect: Tasks scheduled through this Firebase backend may not be submitted when due, delaying or stopping related background work.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.firebase.FirebaseJobService
description: When Firebase JobDispatcher delivers a scheduled task, this Android WorkManager service starts or stops the task as requested and reports when it finishes.
disableEffect: Jobs sent through Firebase JobDispatcher will not run through this service, which can stop app background tasks that depend on it.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemalarm.ConstraintProxy$BatteryChargingProxy
description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts when the phone starts or stops charging and asks WorkManager to recheck background tasks that require charging.
disableEffect: Tasks that require charging may not resume promptly when the charging state changes.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemalarm.ConstraintProxy$BatteryNotLowProxy
description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts when Android reports a low battery or a recovered battery and rechecks background tasks that require enough charge.
disableEffect: Tasks waiting for a safe battery level may not resume promptly after the battery state changes.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemalarm.ConstraintProxy$NetworkStateProxy
description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts to network connection changes and asks WorkManager to recheck background tasks that require a network.
disableEffect: Network-dependent background tasks may remain pending after connectivity changes.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemalarm.ConstraintProxy$StorageNotLowProxy
description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts when device storage becomes low or available again and rechecks tasks that require free storage.
disableEffect: Tasks waiting for free storage may not resume after space becomes available.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemalarm.ConstraintProxyUpdateReceiver
description: AndroidX WorkManager sends this Receiver an internal update when its queued tasks change; it updates monitoring for the battery, network, and storage conditions those tasks require.
disableEffect: WorkManager may not update condition monitoring, so tasks waiting on battery, network, or storage conditions can be delayed or run at the wrong time.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemalarm.RescheduleReceiver
description: When Android reports that the device has restarted, AndroidX WorkManager uses this Receiver to schedule its saved background tasks again.
disableEffect: Saved WorkManager tasks may not resume after a reboot.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemalarm.SystemAlarmService
description: AndroidX WorkManager starts this Service to process alarm-based background task commands and run or reschedule queued tasks.
disableEffect: Tasks assigned to WorkManager alarm scheduling may stop running.

name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemjob.SystemJobService
description: Android JobScheduler binds to this WorkManager service when a background job is ready; the service runs or stops the task as Android directs.
disableEffect: Background jobs assigned to Android JobScheduler will not run through WorkManager.

name: androidx.work.impl.diagnostics.DiagnosticsReceiver
description: AndroidX WorkManager responds when a privileged support tool requests a report on recent and active background tasks.
disableEffect: WorkManager support tools cannot request this report; the app's scheduled background tasks continue to run.

name: androidx.work.impl.foreground.SystemForegroundService
description: AndroidX WorkManager uses this Service for long-running work that must run in the foreground with an ongoing notification. It starts when a worker requests foreground execution.
disableEffect: Long-running tasks that depend on it may stop or fail, and their progress notifications may disappear.

name: androidx.work.impl.utils.ForceStopRunnable$BroadcastReceiver
description: AndroidX WorkManager targets this private Receiver with an internal alarm broadcast; when it fires, the Receiver resets the long-lived alarm used to track app force-stops.
disableEffect: WorkManager force-stop recovery can be disrupted, which may affect saved background tasks after the app is force-stopped.

name: androidx.work.multiprocess.RemoteWorkManagerService
description: AndroidX WorkManager uses this internal service to coordinate background tasks that the app runs from another process.
disableEffect: Background tasks that rely on this service cannot be started or managed by the app's other processes.

name: androidx.xr.projected.TrampolineRequestPermissionsOnHostActivity
description: AndroidX XR Projected opens this short-lived screen when an XR app requests permissions for a projected device; it forwards the request to Android's permission prompt in that device's context and returns the results.
disableEffect: Projected-device permission requests cannot complete through this flow, preventing features that need those permissions from working.

name: androidx.xr.projected.permissions.GoToHostProjectedActivity
description: AndroidX XR Projected opens this bridge when a projected-device app needs permissions; it forwards the request to a screen on the host device and returns the user's decision.
disableEffect: Projected-device apps cannot use this flow to request permissions from the host device.

name: androidx.xr.projected.permissions.RequestPermissionsOnHostActivity
description: AndroidX XR Projected opens this screen on the host device for a projected app's permission request; it presents and requests the permissions, then sends the grant results back.
disableEffect: Projected apps cannot request or receive host-device permission results through this flow.

name: andrxid.app.ResultReceiverActivity
description: When an app uses Suckgamony's Andrxid library to open another screen and wait for a result, this transparent Activity receives that result and returns it to the app.
disableEffect: App actions that depend on results from screens opened through Andrxid may not complete.

name: app.akexorcist.bluetotohspp.library.DeviceList
description: The AkeXorcist BluetoothSPP library opens a picker of paired and newly discovered Bluetooth devices and returns the selected device address to the calling app.
disableEffect: The app cannot use this BluetoothSPP picker to select a serial Bluetooth device.

name: app.cybrid.sdkandroid.components.activity.AccountsActivity
description: Cybrid's Android financial UI opens this screen to show a customer's accounts and total balance, plus account-linked trades and transfers; it refreshes account and price data while open.
disableEffect: Users lose this Cybrid account overview and its related trade and transfer details.

name: app.cybrid.sdkandroid.components.activity.BankAccountsActivity
description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to list linked bank accounts and start Plaid's bank-link flow when a customer connects or updates an account.
disableEffect: Users cannot link, update, view, or disconnect bank accounts through Cybrid's bank-account screen.

name: app.cybrid.sdkandroid.components.activity.CryptoTransferActivity
description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to transfer cryptocurrency between a customer's Cybrid account and an external wallet; it loads accounts, wallets, prices, and a transfer quote before submission.
disableEffect: Users cannot create this crypto transfer or use its quote flow.

name: app.cybrid.sdkandroid.components.activity.KYCActivity
description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen for customer identity verification and launches Persona's Inquiry flow when verification is required.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete Cybrid identity-verification steps, leaving features that require verification unavailable.

name: app.cybrid.sdkandroid.components.activity.TradeActivity
description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to display tradable asset prices and prepare, quote, and submit customer trades.
disableEffect: Users cannot place trades through this Cybrid trading screen.

name: app.cybrid.sdkandroid.components.activity.TransferActivity
description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to move funds between a customer's Cybrid account and linked bank accounts; it loads a quote and submits the transfer.
disableEffect: Users cannot quote or submit these bank transfers through the app.

name: app.cybrid.sdkandroid.components.activity.WalletsActivity
description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to view and manage external cryptocurrency wallets, add or remove a wallet, and view its transfers.
disableEffect: Users lose the Cybrid flow for managing external wallets and their transfers.

name: app.king.filePicker.CropActivity
description: King App's file picker opens this Activity for image-cropping requests. It loads the selected image and returns the crop result to the app.
disableEffect: The app's photo-cropping step will be unavailable when it uses this picker.

name: app.kula.onlaunch.client.ui.OnLaunchActivity
description: Kula's OnLaunch client displays a supplied message and its actions; messages marked as blocking do not close with the back button, and a store action opens the configured app-store link.
disableEffect: Users cannot see OnLaunch messages, including blocking notices, or use their app-store actions.

name: app.pivo.android.podsdk.SdkContentProvider
description: At app startup, the Pivo Pod Basic SDK and Pivo Device SDK use this Provider to initialize the app's Pivo Pod and accessory controls, including the Pod, microphone, and light controllers.
disableEffect: Pivo Pod movement and supported accessory controls may fail to start.

name: app.screeb.sdk.ScreebFilePickerActivity
description: When a Screeb survey asks the user to attach a file, the Screeb Android survey SDK opens this Activity to run the file picker and return the selected file to the survey.
disableEffect: File attachments in Screeb surveys will not work.

name: app.screeb.sdk.ScreebInitProvider
description: The Screeb Android survey SDK runs this Provider at app startup to initialize itself with the app context so survey features can be used.
disableEffect: Screeb surveys will not initialize automatically when the app starts.

name: app.screeb.sdk.ScreebPermissionActivity
description: When a Screeb survey needs an Android permission, the Screeb Android survey SDK opens this Activity to request it and return the result.
disableEffect: Screeb survey features that need those permissions will not be able to request them.

name: app.suprsend.notification.NotificationRedirectionActivity
description: The SuprSend Android SDK opens this Activity when someone taps one of its push notifications. It records the tap and opens the notification's link, or opens the app if the notification has no link.
disableEffect: Tapping a SuprSend notification will no longer open its destination or bring the app to the foreground, and SuprSend will not receive the tap event.

name: app.suprsend.notification.SSNotificationDismissBroadcastReceiver
description: The SuprSend Android SDK invokes this Receiver when one of its push notifications is dismissed. It reports the dismissal to SuprSend for notification activity tracking.
disableEffect: SuprSend will stop recording when its notifications are dismissed; other app screens remain available.

name: app.xmpp.adapter.activities.XMPPConfigureActivity
description: Chat SDK's XMPP sign-in flow opens this screen from the advanced server option when server setup is enabled. It lets the user enter or save the XMPP server connection details.
disableEffect: Without it, users cannot configure a custom XMPP server and may be unable to sign in when the app depends on that server.

name: app.xmpp.adapter.activities.XMPPLoginActivity
description: The Chat SDK XMPP adapter uses this sign-in screen when a user logs in through an XMPP server. It checks the account details and saves the chosen server details when they are valid.
disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to an XMPP-based chat service through the Chat SDK.

name: appaloosa_store.com.appaloosa_android_tools.tools.interfaces.CloseAndCleanActivity
description: The Appaloosa Android Tools library provides this short-lived Activity, which closes itself as soon as Android opens it. The analyzed artifact does not show what launches it.
disableEffect: A flow that relies on this immediate close step will no longer close at this point.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.enjoyment.EnjoymentDialogSupportFragmentManagerActivity
description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when an in-app enjoyment prompt is triggered. It presents the prompt for the user to respond to.
disableEffect: The optional Apptentive enjoyment prompt will no longer appear.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.link.view.NavigateTolinkActivity
description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when a message or survey contains a link. It displays the linked page inside the app.
disableEffect: Links opened from Apptentive messages and surveys will no longer load in the in-app browser.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.messagecenter.view.ImagePreviewActivity
description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when a user selects an image attachment in the message center. It displays the image for preview.
disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to preview image attachments in Apptentive conversations.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.messagecenter.view.MessageCenterActivity
description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when the app launches its message center. It shows conversations and lets users send messages and attachments or open their profile settings.
disableEffect: The Apptentive message center, including support conversations and message attachments, will be unavailable.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.messagecenter.view.ProfileActivity
description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen from the message center's profile settings. It lets users edit the contact details associated with their conversations.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or update their Apptentive message center contact details.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.notifications.ApptentiveNotificationActivity
description: When a user taps an Apptentive notification, this screen routes them to the related message center. It is part of Apptentive's customer feedback SDK.
disableEffect: Tapping Apptentive notifications will no longer open the related message center; other app features remain available.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.survey.SurveyActivity
description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when an in-app survey is presented. It displays the questions and submits the user's answers.
disableEffect: Apptentive surveys will no longer appear or accept responses.

name: apptentive.com.android.feedback.textmodal.TextModalSupportFragmentManagerActivity
description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when an in-app note is triggered. It displays the configured message in a dialog.
disableEffect: Apptentive in-app notes will no longer be shown.

name: at.asitplus.signum.supreme.InitProvider
description: At app startup, the A-SIT Plus Signum Supreme SDK uses this Provider to track the current screen so it can show biometric unlock for protected Android Keystore signing keys.
disableEffect: Biometric signing that relies on the active screen may fail if this Provider is disabled.

name: at.bluesource.choicesdk.messaging.gms.GmsMessagingService
description: When Google Firebase delivers a push message or refreshes its token, ChoiceSDK Messaging forwards the message or token update to the app.
disableEffect: The app will stop receiving messages and token updates through Google Firebase via ChoiceSDK.

name: at.bluesource.choicesdk.messaging.hms.HmsMessagingService
description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a push message or refreshes its token, ChoiceSDK Messaging forwards the message or token update to the app.
disableEffect: The app will stop receiving messages and token updates through Huawei Push Kit via ChoiceSDK.

name: au.com.gridstone.debugdrawer.timber.DebugDrawerTimberFileProvider
description: The Gridstone DebugDrawer Timber module uses this Provider when its debug drawer shares a saved file of app logs.
disableEffect: Sharing diagnostic logs from the debug drawer will fail when it tries to open the log file.

name: au.com.gridstone.debugdrawer.timber.LumberYardInstaller
description: At app startup, the Gridstone DebugDrawer Timber module uses this Provider to begin collecting app logs for the debug drawer.
disableEffect: The debug log panel may fail to open, and the module will not collect app logs.

name: auryc.com.callback.NetworkChangeReceiver
description: The Auryc Android SDK receives Android connectivity and Wi-Fi change broadcasts and starts its replay-video upload service. This lets queued screen-session videos be retried when network conditions change.
disableEffect: Auryc may not retry queued session-video uploads when connectivity changes.

name: auryc.com.job.CreateVideo
description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this background job to make videos from screen captures recorded during app sessions. It checks saved session captures and creates a replay video after recording is complete.
disableEffect: Auryc will not create session replay videos from captured screens.

name: auryc.com.job.GarbageCleaner
description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this job to remove local records and files for sessions whose event data and replay videos have already been uploaded. It runs in the background as part of Auryc’s data cleanup.
disableEffect: Auryc will retain uploaded session records and files longer, which may use more device storage.

name: auryc.com.job.UploadEvents
description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this job to send stored usage and interaction records for app sessions when event uploading is enabled and a network is available.
disableEffect: Auryc usage and interaction records will no longer be uploaded from this background job.

name: auryc.com.job.UploadVideo
description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this job to upload saved session-replay videos when the configured network preference allows it.
disableEffect: Auryc session-replay videos will not be uploaded by this background job.

name: auryc.com.service.EventUploader
description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this background service while it is initialized. It processes queued app-session interaction records and sends them to Auryc when uploading is enabled and the network is available.
disableEffect: Auryc interaction records will not be uploaded by this service.

name: auryc.com.service.GarbageCleaner
description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this service during initialization. It periodically removes local session records and files after their event data and replay videos have been uploaded.
disableEffect: Auryc will retain uploaded session records and files longer, which may use more device storage.

name: auryc.com.service.ScreenRecorder
description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this service for tracked app sessions. It periodically captures screen images and records view timing so Auryc can assemble an app-session replay.
disableEffect: Auryc will no longer capture the screens needed to build app-session replays.

name: auryc.com.service.VideoCreator
description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this background service to turn saved screen captures into videos for app-session replay. It also removes incomplete video work left by an interrupted run.
disableEffect: Auryc will not assemble captured screens into app-session replay videos.

name: auryc.com.service.VideoUploader
description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this service to upload completed app-session videos to its replay storage, following the configured network preference. It retries queued files while active.
disableEffect: Auryc will not upload completed session-replay videos through this service.

name: auryc.com.voc.FeedbackContainerActivity
description: Auryc opens this screen when its in-app feedback form or preview is requested. It fetches the selected form from Auryc and displays it so the user can provide feedback.
disableEffect: Auryc feedback forms will no longer open, while the host app’s other screens remain available.

name: bd.com.ipay.sdk.activity.IPayCheckoutActivity
description: When an iPay checkout starts, this Activity opens the iPay app; when the payment app returns through a VIEW link, it reads the checkout result and sends it back to the app.
disableEffect: Users may not be able to finish iPay payments or return their checkout result to the app.

name: bd.com.ipay.sdk.activity.IPayWebCheckoutActivity
description: When the iPay app is unavailable and checkout falls back to the web, this Activity loads the payment page and returns its success, failure, or cancellation result to the app.
disableEffect: Web-based fallback payments and their completion results will stop working.

name: bd.com.ipay.sdk.provider.IPaySDKInitProvider
description: At app startup, the iPay Checkout SDK uses this Provider to initialize itself and read its app settings; checkout code also initializes the SDK on demand before a transaction.
disableEffect: The iPay SDK will initialize when checkout is first requested instead of at app startup.

name: be.msdc.hypco.internal.ui.activity.MainActivity
description: This is part of MrSweeter's HypCo app logger. This is HypCo's app-logging screen; when opened, it loads the saved records and lets users export a selected item as a JSON file.
disableEffect: HypCo's saved-record browser and JSON export screen will be unavailable; the host app's features are unaffected.

name: bingo.game.activity.GameActivity
description: The BumptechLab Shell SDK opens this screen when the app starts a game session; it runs the game and handles returning from it.
disableEffect: Users cannot play the game provided through this SDK if disabled.

name: bingo.game.activity.WebViewActivity
description: The BumptechLab Shell SDK opens this screen when a game feature requests a web page; it displays that page inside the app and supports back navigation.
