disableEffect: Users cannot make these BluePay transfers if this screen is disabled.

name: br.com.zup.beagle.android.preview.PreviewActivity
description: Beagle (Zup IT)'s optional live preview screen connects to the preview service and displays incoming screen updates.
disableEffect: Beagle's live developer preview will no longer connect or display screen updates.

name: br.com.zup.beagle.android.view.ServerDrivenActivity
description: When the app opens a Beagle (Zup IT) server-driven page, this Activity hosts the page and shows loading or retry feedback while it loads.
disableEffect: App screens delivered through Beagle will not open, which can make their app features unavailable.

name: bugbattle.io.bugbattle.BBMainActivity
description: The BugBattle Android SDK opens its hosted bug report form when a user starts a report from the app. The form can attach a screenshot and send the user's feedback to BugBattle.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit bug reports or feedback through BugBattle.

name: c.a.b.e.registerForContextMenu
description: When Firebase delivers a CleverTap push, RenderMax helps the SDK finish displaying the notification.
disableEffect: Some CleverTap push notifications may not appear or may take longer to display.

name: cafe.adriel.androidaudiorecorder.AudioRecorderActivity
description: Chat SDK's bundled audio recorder opens when the host app starts an audio recording request. It lets users record audio, listen back, and save the clip to the requested file.
disableEffect: Users cannot record and save audio clips through this recorder, so any chat feature that uses it for audio messages stops working.

name: cards.pay.paycardsrecognizer.sdk.ui.ScanCardActivity
description: When an app starts the Lyra PayCards Recognizer card-scan flow, this screen checks camera access and recognition availability, then displays the scanner; a successful scan returns card details to the app.
disableEffect: The card-scanning flow will be unavailable, so users cannot capture card details with the camera through this SDK.

name: cat.ereza.customactivityoncrash.activity.DefaultErrorActivity
description: After Custom Activity on Crash handles an uncaught app failure, this screen can show error details and offer restart or close options, depending on the app's settings.
disableEffect: After a crash, users will not see this SDK's custom error and restart screen.

name: cat.ereza.customactivityoncrash.provider.CaocInitProvider
description: Android runs this provider with the app, and the Custom Activity on Crash SDK uses it so a crash can show the SDK’s recovery screen.
disableEffect: The SDK's custom crash screen will no longer be installed; ordinary app screens do not depend on this provider.

name: cat.rokubun.core.data.gnss.service.GnssManagerServiceBind
description: Rokubun Core's Spear Location Engine uses this foreground service for GNSS location work. It provides a local connection to the location manager and shows an ongoing location notification while running.
disableEffect: Location tracking that relies on Rokubun Core will lose its GNSS service connection.

name: ch.itomy.meringue.firebase.MeringueMessagingService
description: Meringue's Firebase push service delivers incoming messages to the app's registered listeners and saves refreshed push tokens. It runs when Firebase delivers a message or token update.
disableEffect: Meringue message callbacks and token updates stop, so app behavior driven by Meringue push messages may no longer work.

name: ch.postfinance.activities.MainReactActivity
description: PostFinance Checkout opens this screen to display its payment checkout. It loads the checkout interface and its payment methods, including TWINT.
disableEffect: Users cannot open or complete payments through PostFinance Checkout.

name: ch.postfinance.activities.SplashScreenActivity
description: PostFinance Checkout shows this branded loading screen while a checkout starts, then closes it when the payment screen is ready.
disableEffect: The checkout launcher cannot show its loading screen, so opening a PostFinance payment flow fails.

name: chao.app.ami.FragmentContainer
description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools use this Activity to open optional in-app diagnostic screens.
disableEffect: AMI's diagnostic screens that use this container will no longer open.

name: chao.app.ami.SupportFragmentContainer
description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools use this Activity to open optional in-app diagnostic screens.
disableEffect: AMI's diagnostic screens that use this container will no longer open.

name: chao.app.ami.monitor.CommandService
description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools start this Service to handle background diagnostic commands for their monitor screens, including dump and memory-cleanup requests.
disableEffect: AMI's diagnostic monitor commands will stop, while ordinary app features remain available.

name: chao.app.ami.utils.permission.AmiPermission$PermissionActivity
description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools open this Activity to request Android permissions needed by an optional diagnostic tool. It returns the permission result to AMI.
disableEffect: AMI's permission-dependent diagnostic tools cannot request or report permissions; unrelated host-app features remain available.

name: chehara.crosswalklib.CrossActivity
description: AnswerzDigital CrosswalkLib opens a web page in its embedded browser when users tap its launcher entry or the app asks the library to open it. Some releases register it as the app launcher.
disableEffect: The page will no longer open, and a release that relies on it as the launcher may leave the app without its normal entry screen.

name: chehara.crosswalklib.MainActivity
description: The AnswerzDigital CrosswalkLib opens a web page in its embedded browser from its launcher icon.
disableEffect: If this is the app's only launcher screen, disabling it may prevent users from opening the app normally.

name: chehara.libraryapp.MainLIBActivity
description: The Yoharaja Library and Malathi8190 MyLib samples use this Activity for the same demo screen: a button displays a greeting when tapped.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes this optional sample greeting screen.

name: chehara.mylibapplication.RoomActivity
description: AnswerzDigital MyLIBApplication opens the CheharaTime room page selected by the app, shows loading or error feedback, and lets the room page share an invitation.
disableEffect: Users can no longer join a room through this screen or share its invitation.

name: cl.magnet.magnetrestclient.UpgradeRequiredActivity
description: MagnetRestClient uses this screen when the host app requires an update; its button opens the app's store listing or, if no store app is available, the web listing.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot show its required-update prompt or send users to the update page.

name: clickstream.eventvisualiser.ui.internal.ui.activity.CSEvHomeActivity
description: The Gojek Clickstream event visualizer opens this screen when the user taps its floating viewer control. It lists captured event names for inspection while debugging.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the in-app Clickstream event viewer; event collection and the app's regular screens remain available.

name: cloud.ezpush.android.EzPushReceivePushService
description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a push or refreshes the device token, the EZPush Android SDK uses this service to handle its messages and commands and register the new token.
disableEffect: EZPush notifications, commands, and token updates will no longer be handled, while the rest of the host app remains available.

name: cloud.ezpush.android.NotificationsEventReceiver
description: When a user dismisses an EZPush notification, the EZPush Android SDK records that dismissal through this receiver.
disableEffect: EZPush will stop recording dismissed notifications, but notifications can still be received and shown.

name: cloud.ezpush.android.activity.PairingDeviceActivity
description: Opening an EZPush test-device pairing link starts this screen; the SDK registers the phone as a test device and shows whether pairing succeeded.
disableEffect: The EZPush test-device pairing link will no longer register the phone, while other app features remain available.

name: cloud.ezpush.android.activity.TrampolineActivity
description: After a user taps an EZPush notification, the SDK briefly opens this screen and passes the notification link and extra information to the host app.
disableEffect: Tapping an EZPush notification will no longer open the host app with its link or extra information; users can still open the app normally.

name: cloud.mindbox.mobile_sdk.inapp.presentation.actions.PushActivationActivity
description: Mindbox opens this screen during its in-app push setup to request notification permission; it handles the user's choice and can direct them to notification settings after repeated denials.
disableEffect: Mindbox cannot request notification permission or guide users to notification settings through this flow, so Mindbox push activation stops working.

name: cloud.pace.sdk.appkit.app.AppActivity
description: When the host app opens a PACE connected-fueling page, the PACE Cloud SDK displays it in the app and handles page actions such as Google Pay requests.
disableEffect: PACE in-app pages and their payment actions will not open, so connected-fueling tasks that use them can fail.

name: cloud.pace.sdk.appkit.app.deeplink.DeepLinkManagementActivity
description: When a PACE page asks to open a link, the PACE Cloud SDK opens it in an in-app web page or a Chrome custom tab and passes the return result back to the original page.
disableEffect: PACE page links that leave the app and need to return to the original page will not complete.

name: cloud.pace.sdk.appkit.app.deeplink.RedirectUriReceiverActivity
description: When Android opens a return link registered by the PACE Cloud SDK, this screen passes it back into the app so the active PACE web flow can finish.
disableEffect: PACE web flows that rely on this return link, such as sign-in or payment, will not return to the app.

name: cloud.pace.sdk.appkit.app.deeplink.WebViewActivity
description: The PACE Cloud SDK uses this screen for in-app payment pages; it loads the requested page and routes PACE return links back into the app.
disableEffect: The in-app PACE payment page and its return flow will not work.

name: cloud.pace.sdk.appkit.utils.PACECloudSDKFileProvider
description: When a user shares a receipt PDF from the PACE Cloud SDK, this provider lets Android's share menu read the generated file.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to share PACE receipt PDFs from the app.

name: cloud.pace.sdk.idkit.authorization.integrated.AuthorizationWebViewActivity
description: When PACE account sign-in or sign-out is requested, the PACE Cloud SDK displays the authorization page and returns its result to the app.
disableEffect: PACE account authorization and sign-out flows that use this screen will fail.

name: cloud.proxi.job.OnBootCompletedReceiver
description: When Android finishes starting the device, this receiver initializes the Proxi.cloud proximity SDK in the main process of the app.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud background location features may not initialize until the app is opened.

name: cloud.proxi.job.v23.ProxiJobV23Service
description: Android starts this Proxi.cloud service when one of its scheduled background tasks is due. Older SDK releases use it to run the saved task; in SDK 3.0.14, starting it has no visible effect.
disableEffect: Blocking it can stop scheduled Proxi.cloud updates and uploads in older releases; the app's ordinary screens remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.RebootReceiver
description: After a normal or quick reboot, this receiver restarts Proxi.cloud when enabled and clears its saved last location.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud background proximity monitoring may not restart until the app is opened.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.analytics.LoadLayoutJob
description: When queued as background work, this Proxi.cloud job refreshes the layout and settings used for location-based content.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud may keep outdated location-based content and settings; other app features remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.analytics.LoadLayoutReceiver
description: When its scheduled alarm fires, this receiver checks whether Proxi.cloud is enabled and queues a refresh of its location-based content and settings.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud content may stop refreshing in the background and become outdated.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.analytics.SendAnalyticsJob
description: When Proxi.cloud queues a background sync, this job uploads its stored location and usage events.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud stops sending these event records; the app's other features remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.analytics.SendAnalyticsReceiver
description: When its scheduled alarm fires, this receiver checks whether Proxi.cloud is enabled and queues an upload of stored events.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud event records will no longer be uploaded on schedule.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.fcm.jobs.HandleFcmJob
description: When Firebase delivers a Proxi.cloud message, this background job processes it, can display its notification, and records the event.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud push notifications and their event reports stop being processed.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.firebase.jobs.HandleFcmJob
description: When Firebase sends a Proxi.cloud message, this background job processes it, displays the corresponding notification, and records the event.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud Firebase notifications and related event reporting stop.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.GeofenceReceiver
description: When Google location services reports that the device entered or left a Proxi.cloud area, this receiver passes the visit for content matching and notification handling. Older SDK releases also use it for location updates and changes to location settings.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud location-triggered messages and visit reports stop, while the rest of the app remains available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.HmsGeofenceReceiver
description: When Huawei location services reports a Proxi.cloud area entry, exit, location update, or provider change, this receiver forwards it for proximity processing.
disableEffect: Huawei-based Proxi.cloud location messages and event reports stop; other app features remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.LocationReceiver
description: When Google location services delivers a new location, this receiver uses it to refresh Proxi.cloud area monitoring.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud background area monitoring will no longer refresh from new locations.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.PCGeofenceReceiver
description: When Google location services reports a Proxi.cloud area transition, this receiver processes it and can display matching content. Earlier SDK releases queue a separate background task to do this work.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud area-triggered messages and visit reports stop.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.PCLocationReceiver
description: When Google location services reports a new location, this receiver refreshes Proxi.cloud area monitoring; earlier releases pass the update to a background task.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud location matching and related notifications may stop updating.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.jobs.HandleGeofenceJob
description: When an area entry or exit is queued, this Proxi.cloud job checks for matching content, records the visit, and can display a notification.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud area-triggered notifications and visit reporting stop.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.jobs.HandleLocationResult
description: When a location result is queued, this Proxi.cloud background job uses the latest position to refresh area monitoring.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud area monitoring will no longer refresh from location updates.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.location.services.HandleCustomEventService
description: When the app sends Proxi.cloud a custom event, this service adds available location and app-state details before reporting it.
disableEffect: Custom app events and their location context will no longer reach Proxi.cloud; normal app features remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.receivers.OnAppUpdatedReceiver
description: When Android reports that the app was updated, this receiver cancels Proxi.cloud's old scheduled tasks so they do not run alongside the new ones.
disableEffect: Old Proxi.cloud background tasks may not be canceled after an app update.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.receivers.ProxiCloudCodeReceiver
description: When a special Proxi.cloud dial code is entered, this receiver turns SDK diagnostic logging on or off.
disableEffect: The dial code can no longer change Proxi.cloud logging; ordinary app use is unaffected.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.HostApplicationInBackgroundService
description: When the app moves to the background, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to upload saved event history; a later inspected release has no visible action.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud event history may upload less often in older releases; the app remains usable.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.HostApplicationInForegroundService
description: When the app returns to the foreground, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to upload event history and refresh area monitoring; a later inspected release has no visible action.
disableEffect: In older releases, Proxi.cloud location messages may not refresh when the app opens; the app remains usable.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.PermissionService
description: After the app reports a location permission decision, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to start area monitoring when permission is granted; a later inspected release has no visible action.
disableEffect: Location-triggered Proxi.cloud content may not start after permission is granted in older releases; other app functions remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.ReportEventService
description: When Proxi.cloud queues a beacon event, older releases add the current area and event details to its event processing; a later inspected release has no visible action.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud beacon events may no longer be matched or reported in older releases; other app functions remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.SetAdvertisingIdentifierService
description: After the app records advertising consent, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to save an advertising identifier only when consent allows it; later inspected code has no visible action.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud events may lose advertising attribution data in older releases; normal app use is unchanged.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.SetLoggingService
description: When an internal Proxi.cloud logging setting changes, older releases use this service to apply it; a later inspected release has no visible action.
disableEffect: The SDK diagnostic logging setting may not change in older releases; ordinary app features remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.UpdateSettingsService
description: When Proxi.cloud requests a settings refresh, older releases use this service to fetch updated SDK settings; later inspected code has no visible action.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud may keep older settings in earlier releases; the rest of the app remains usable.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.services.UploadAnalyticsService
description: When Proxi.cloud queues an analytics upload, older releases use this service to send saved event history; later inspected code has no visible action.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud event history may not be uploaded in older releases; other app features continue to work.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.wifi.WifiLocationReceiver
description: When Proxi.cloud receives a sufficiently recent and accurate location, this receiver queues a nearby Wi-Fi scan for location matching.
disableEffect: Wi-Fi-assisted Proxi.cloud location matching and related content stop updating.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.wifi.jobs.ScanWifiJob
description: When the SDK schedules a scan, this background job collects nearby Wi-Fi network details and passes them to Proxi.cloud proximity processing.
disableEffect: Proxi.cloud can no longer use nearby Wi-Fi observations for location matching; other app features remain available.

name: cloud.proxi.sdk.wifi.receivers.WiFiBackgroundReceiver
description: When a scheduled Proxi.cloud background alarm fires, this receiver checks whether the SDK is enabled and queues a Wi-Fi scan.
disableEffect: Background Wi-Fi scans for Proxi.cloud location matching stop.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.ShopLivePlayerActivity
description: When a host app opens a ShopLive live show or video, this Activity plays the stream and provides playback controls, chat, and sharing.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the ShopLive player screen from opening, so users lose in-app playback and its chat controls.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.common.provider.ShopLiveAuthProvider
description: Android starts this Provider with the app process. It initializes ShopLive's saved guest and client identifiers, then retrieves the device advertising ID for the ShopLive live-commerce SDK.
disableEffect: Disabling it leaves ShopLive without startup identifiers used by its live and video features, which can prevent those features from initializing or making requests.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.common.provider.ShopLiveDeleteCacheProvider
description: After the app's last open screen closes, this Provider removes cached files used by ShopLive in the background.
disableEffect: Disabling it leaves ShopLive cache files behind after the app closes.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.common.provider.ShopLiveSDKVersionProvider
description: Android starts this Provider during app startup, and it writes the ShopLive module name and version to the log.
disableEffect: Users lose no app feature; only the startup SDK version log is omitted.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.editor.cover.ShopLiveCoverPickerActivity
description: The ShopLive short-video creation flow opens this Activity when a creator chooses a cover. It shows frames from a clip for cropping and submits the selected cover through the ShopLive upload service.
disableEffect: Creators cannot choose and submit a custom cover in that ShopLive video-creation flow.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.editor.edit.ShopLiveVideoEditActivity
description: During the older ShopLive video-creation flow, this Activity opens a selected local clip or camera recording for editing before upload. It loads video information and thumbnails for the editing screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the older ShopLive video-editing and upload flow.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.editor.edit.ShopLiveVideoEditorActivity
description: The ShopLive short-video flow opens this Activity to trim and crop a clip, adjust playback speed or volume, and apply filters before submission.
disableEffect: Creators lose these editing controls and cannot complete video creation through this ShopLive editor.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.editor.gallery.ShopLiveGalleryActivity
description: When a ShopLive creator chooses local media, this Activity lists photos and videos so they can select a clip or image for editing or upload.
disableEffect: The ShopLive editor cannot pick local media through its built-in gallery.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.editor.modify.ShopLiveVideoModifyActivity
description: ShopLive opens this Activity to review or change details for an existing short video. It displays the clip with fields for its title, description, and tags.
disableEffect: Creators cannot use this ShopLive screen to review or change short-video details.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.editor.upload.ShopLiveShortformUploaderActivity
description: When ShopLive opens short-video submission, this Activity loads the upload page and connects its controls to the SDK's upload state and errors.
disableEffect: Users cannot submit short videos through ShopLive's uploader.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.editor.upload.ShopLiveVideoUploadActivity
description: After an edited ShopLive video is ready, this Activity sends it to ShopLive and shows upload progress and the result.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the older ShopLive video-upload flow.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.exoplayer.provider.ShopLiveStethoModuleProvider
description: The ShopLive video-playback module starts this Provider with the app. Its setup currently does no visible work and it does not show a screen or provide user content.
disableEffect: Disabling it does not remove a ShopLive playback or host-app feature in the analyzed SDK release.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.network.provider.ShopLiveNetworkStethoContentProvider
description: The ShopLive networking module starts this Provider with the app. Its setup currently does no visible work and it does not provide user content.
disableEffect: Disabling it does not change ShopLive network or host-app features in the analyzed SDK release.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.permission.ShopLivePermissionActivity
description: When ShopLive requests permissions for a live-streaming feature, this Activity presents the Android permission flow and returns the user's decision to the SDK.
disableEffect: Disabling it breaks ShopLive permission requests, so features that need camera or microphone access cannot continue.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.shorts.ShopLiveShortformDetailTypeForIdsActivity
description: When a host app opens a ShopLive short-video feed from a supplied list of IDs, this Activity displays the clips in a swipeable feed and requests more clips when needed.
disableEffect: The ID-based ShopLive short-video feed will not open or load additional clips.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.shorts.ShopLiveShortformDetailTypeNormalActivity
description: When a user opens a ShopLive short video, the SDK shows a full-screen swipeable feed starting at that clip, with related-video and shuffle options.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the ShopLive short-video detail and feed screen.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.webrtc.ShopLiveWebRTCDirectStreamerActivity
description: When the host app starts a direct ShopLive broadcast, this Activity opens the camera and streaming controls and sends the live video.
disableEffect: Users cannot start or control this direct ShopLive broadcast.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.webrtc.ShopLiveWebRTCPlayerActivity
description: When the host app opens a ShopLive real-time video stream, this Activity initializes the WebRTC player and displays the incoming stream and its status.
disableEffect: Users cannot watch ShopLive real-time video through this player.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.webrtc.ShopLiveWebRTCStreamerActivity
description: When the host app starts a ShopLive broadcast with streamer settings, this Activity sets up camera, audio, and connection controls, then starts or stops the stream.
disableEffect: Users lose the ShopLive camera-broadcast flow.

name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.webrtc.provider.ShopLiveWebRTCStethoModuleProvider
description: The ShopLive WebRTC module starts this Provider with the app. Its setup currently does no visible work and it does not provide user content.
disableEffect: Disabling it does not remove a ShopLive streaming or host-app feature in the analyzed SDK release.

name: cn.android.service.JTransitActivity
description: JPush (Jiguang) opens this brief screen when a push notification is tapped, passes the notification to the app, and then closes.
disableEffect: Tapping JPush notifications will no longer reach the app through this screen.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.AppScanLoginActivity
description: Authing Guard shows a confirmation page when a user signs in to an app by scanning a login code. It identifies the signed-in account and target app, then sends the user’s confirm or cancel choice.
disableEffect: The scanned-app login confirmation cannot open, so this sign-in route cannot finish.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.ApplicationActivity
description: Authing Guard lists the applications connected to the signed-in account, showing each app’s name and identifier from the account profile.
disableEffect: The connected-app list cannot open from the Authing account profile.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.AuthActivity
description: Authing Guard opens the sign-in screen selected by the app’s authentication flow and handles results from supported social and passkey sign-in methods.
disableEffect: Configured Authing sign-in flows that use this screen cannot open or return a completed login.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.AuthorizedResourcesActivity
description: Authing Guard displays the resources granted to the signed-in account, including each resource’s code and type.
disableEffect: The account’s authorized-resource list cannot open from the Authing profile.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.BaseAuthActivity
description: Authing Guard routes its sign-in link entry through this page and uses it to prepare the shared appearance of account screens.
disableEffect: Authing Guard’s link-based sign-in entry may not open correctly.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.BindEmailActivity
description: Authing Guard opens an email-binding form when the account flow asks a user to add or verify an email. If an email is already stored, the page fills it in and locks the field.
disableEffect: Email binding or verification cannot open from the Authing account flow.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.BindPhoneActivity
description: Authing Guard opens a phone-binding form when the account flow asks a user to add or verify a phone number. If a number is already stored, the page fills it in and locks the field.
disableEffect: Phone binding or verification cannot open from the Authing account flow.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.ChangePasswordActivity
description: Authing Guard opens the password-change form from the account profile. The user enters the old and new passwords, and the page submits the change.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the Authing password-change screen from their account profile.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.DeleteAccountActivity
description: Authing Guard displays the account-deletion verification page. It shows an SMS-code section when the account has a phone number, or a password field when the account has a password.
disableEffect: The Authing account-deletion verification page cannot open.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.DeveloperActivity
description: Authing Guard’s developer page displays access, ID, and refresh-token details. It can show decoded token data, copy values, and request a refreshed access token.
disableEffect: The token-inspection and refresh page will not open from the Authing profile.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.FeedbackActivity
description: Authing Guard opens its feedback form from the feedback link and lets the user choose an image attachment.
disableEffect: The in-app Authing feedback form cannot open from its feedback link.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.IndexAuthActivity
description: Authing Guard opens this sign-in entry from login or password-reset actions and displays the authentication flow configured by the app.
disableEffect: Authing sign-in or password-reset routes that use this entry cannot open.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.OrganizationActivity
description: Authing Guard lists the organizations associated with the signed-in account in the account profile.
disableEffect: The account’s organization list cannot open from the Authing profile.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.RolesActivity
description: Authing Guard lists the roles assigned to the signed-in account, including each role’s code, namespace, and description.
disableEffect: The account’s role list cannot open from the Authing profile.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.UpdateUserProfileActivity
description: Authing Guard lets a signed-in user edit a standard or custom profile field and save it to the account.
disableEffect: Profile fields that use this editor cannot be changed from the Authing account flow.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.UserProfileActivity
description: Authing Guard displays the signed-in user’s profile and account controls. It also returns a chosen picture to the profile page for avatar upload.
disableEffect: The Authing profile page, avatar update, and its account controls cannot open through this screen.

name: cn.authing.guard.activity.WebActivity
description: When an Authing Guard flow opens a policy or notice link, this page shows its supplied title and loads the page inside the app.
disableEffect: Policy or notice pages launched through this Authing screen will not load in the app.

name: cn.authing.guard.ddauth.DDAuthActivity
description: Authing Guard uses this callback page when DingTalk returns a social-sign-in result. It passes the result back to the sign-in flow and then closes.
disableEffect: DingTalk sign-in cannot return its authorization result to Authing Guard.

name: cn.authing.guard.push.GuardPushServer
description: Authing Guard provides this background push-service entry in a separate app process for its push-based authentication features.
disableEffect: Authing Guard’s background push-service entry will not run, so push-based authentication messages cannot use it.

name: cn.authing.guard.push.PushLoginServer
description: When Getui delivers an authentication request for the currently signed-in user, Authing Guard checks the target account and opens the configured sign-in flow.
disableEffect: Push-based Authing sign-in requests cannot be processed or opened.

name: cn.authing.guard.social.web.WebAuthActivity
description: Authing Guard opens a web authorization page for its LinkedIn social sign-in flow, follows the provider redirect, and returns the authorization result and profile.
disableEffect: The Authing web-based LinkedIn sign-in flow cannot finish.

name: cn.authok.android.provider.AuthenticationActivity
description: The Authok Android authentication SDK opens a browser tab for sign-in and returns the result to the app when the user finishes or cancels.

description: A provider of downloaded cover art images. Cover art images are downloaded from remote devices and are promised to be "good" for the life of a connection. Android applications are provided a Uri with their MediaMetadata and MediaItem objects that points back to this provider. Uris are in the following format: content://com.android.bluetooth.avrcpcontroller.AvrcpCoverArtProvider/<device>/<image-handle> It's expected by the Media framework that artwork at URIs will be available using the ContentResolver#openInputStream and BitmapFactory#decodeStream functions. Our provider must enable that usage pattern.

name: com.android.bluetooth.avrcpcontroller.BluetoothMediaBrowserService

The applications are expected to use MediaBrowser (see API) and all the music browsing/playback/metadata can be controlled via MediaBrowser and MediaController. The current behavior of MediaSessionCompat exposed by this service is as follows: 1. MediaSessionCompat is active (i.e. SystemUI and other overview UIs can see updates) when device is connected and first starts playing. Before it starts playing we do not activate the session. 1.1 The session is active throughout the duration of connection. 2. The session is de-activated when the device disconnects. It will be connected again when (1) happens.

name: com.android.bluetooth.hfp.HeadsetService
description: Provides Bluetooth Headset and Handsfree profile, as a service in the Bluetooth application. Three modes for SCO audio: Mode 1: Telecom call through #phoneStateChanged(int, int, int, String, int, String, boolean) Mode 2: Virtual call through #startScoUsingVirtualVoiceCall() Mode 3: Voice recognition through #startVoiceRecognition(BluetoothDevice) When one mode is active, other mode cannot be started. API user has to terminate existing modes using the correct API or just #disconnectAudio() if user is a system service, before starting a new mode. #connectAudio() will start SCO audio at one of the above modes, but won't change mode #disconnectAudio() can happen in any mode to disconnect SCO When audio is disconnected, only Mode 1 Telecom call will be persisted, both Mode 2 virtual call and Mode 3 voice call will be terminated upon SCO termination and client has to restart the mode. NOTE: SCO termination can either be initiated on the AG side or the HF side TODO(b/79660380): As a workaround, voice recognition will be terminated if virtual call or Telecom call is initiated while voice recognition is ongoing, in case calling app did not call #stopVoiceRecognition(BluetoothDevice) AG - Audio Gateway, device running this HeadsetService, e.g. Android Phone HF - Handsfree device, device running headset client, e.g. Wireless headphones or car kits

This will open a WebView for the carrier website to allow the user to complete the premium capability purchase. The carrier website can get the requested premium capability using the JavaScript interface method @code SlicePurchaseWebInterface.getRequestedCapability(). If the purchase is successful, the carrier website shall notify the slice purchase application using the JavaScript interface method @code SlicePurchaseWebInterface.notifyPurchaseSuccessful(duration), where @code duration is the optional duration of the performance boost. If the purchase was not successful, the carrier website shall notify the slice purchase application using the JavaScript interface method @code SlicePurchaseWebInterface.notifyPurchaseFailed(code, reason), where @code code is the SlicePurchaseController.FailureCode indicating the reason for failure and @code reason is the human-readable reason for failure if the failure code is SlicePurchaseController#FAILURE_CODE_UNKNOWN. If either of these notification methods are not called, the purchase cannot be completed successfully and the purchase request will eventually time out.

name: com.android.ims.rcs.uce.eab.EabProvider
description: This class provides the ability to query the enhanced address book databases(A.K.A. EAB) based on both SIP options and UCE presence server data. There are 4 tables in EAB DB: Contact: It stores the name and phone number of the contact. Common: It's a general table for storing the query results and the mechanisms of querying UCE capabilities. It should be 1:1 mapped to the contact table and has a foreign key(eab_contact_id) that refers to the id of contact table. If the value of mechanism is 1 ( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability#CAPABILITY_MECHANISM_PRESENCE), the capability information should be stored in presence table, if the value of mechanism is 2( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability#CAPABILITY_MECHANISM_OPTIONS), it should be stored in options table. Presence: It stores the information ( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability) that queried through presence server. It should be *:1 mapped to the common table and has a foreign key(eab_common_id) that refers to the id of common table. Options: It stores the information ( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability) that queried through SIP OPTIONS. It should be *:1 mapped to the common table and it has a foreign key(eab_common_id) that refers to the id of common table.

name: com.android.providers.settings.SettingsProvider
description: This class is a content provider that publishes the system settings. It can be accessed via the content provider APIs or via custom call commands. The latter is a bit faster and is the preferred way to access the platform settings. There are three settings types, global (with signature level protection and shared across users), secure (with signature permission level protection and per user), and system (with dangerous permission level protection and per user). Global settings are stored under the device owner. Each of these settings is represented by a com.android.providers.settings.SettingsState object mapped to an integer key derived from the setting type in the most significant bits and user id in the least significant bits. Settings are synchronously loaded on instantiation of a SettingsState and asynchronously persisted on mutation. Settings are stored in the user specific system directory. Apps targeting APIs Lollipop MR1 and lower can add custom settings entries and get a warning. Targeting higher API version prohibits this as the system settings are not a place for apps to save their state. When a package is removed the settings it added are deleted. Apps cannot delete system settings added by the platform. System settings values are validated to ensure the clients do not put bad values. Global and secure settings are changed only by trusted parties, therefore no validation is performed. Also there is a limit on the amount of app specific settings that can be added to prevent unlimited growth of the system process memory footprint.

name: com.android.providers.telephony.CarrierIdProvider

Each row in carrier identification db consists of matching rule (e.g., MCCMNC, GID1, GID2, PLMN) and its matched carrier id & carrier name. Each carrier either MNO or MVNO could be identified by multiple matching rules but is assigned with a unique ID (cid). This class provides the ability to retrieve the cid of the current subscription. This is done atomically through a query. This class also provides a way to update carrier identifying attributes of an existing entry. Insert entries for new carriers or an existing carrier.

name: com.android.providers.telephony.MmsSmsProvider

A virtual column, MmsSms.TYPE_DISCRIMINATOR_COLUMN, may be requested in the projection for a query. Its value is either "mms" or "sms", depending on whether the message represented by the row is an MMS message or an SMS message, respectively. This class also provides the ability to find out what addresses participated in a particular thread. It doesn't support updates for either of these. This class provides a way to allocate and retrieve thread IDs. This is done atomically through a query. There is no insert URI for this. Finally, this class provides a way to delete or update all messages in a thread.

description: Activity that handles system CALL actions and forwards them to CallIntentProcessor. Handles all three CALL action types: CALL, CALL_PRIVILEGED, and CALL_EMERGENCY. Pre-L, the only way apps were were allowed to make outgoing emergency calls was the ACTION_CALL_PRIVILEGED action (which requires the system only CALL_PRIVILEGED permission). In L, any app that has the CALL_PRIVILEGED permission can continue to make outgoing emergency calls via ACTION_CALL_PRIVILEGED. In addition, the default dialer (identified via TelecomManager#getDefaultPhoneApp() will also be granted the ability to make emergency outgoing calls using the CALL action. In order to do this, it must call startActivityForResult on the CALL intent to allow its package name to be passed to UserCallActivity. Calling startActivity will continue to work on all non-emergency numbers just like it did pre-L.

name: com.android.settings.slices.SettingsSliceProvider
description: A SliceProvider for Settings to enabled inline results in system apps. SettingsSliceProvider accepts a Uri with #SLICE_AUTHORITY and a @code String key based on the setting intended to be changed. This provider builds a Slice and responds to Slice actions through the database defined by SlicesDatabaseHelper, whose data is written by SlicesIndexer. When a Slice is requested, we start loading SliceData in the background and return an stub Slice with the correct Uri immediately. In the background, the data corresponding to the key in the Uri is read by SlicesDatabaseAccessor, and the entire row is converted into a SliceData. Once complete, it is stored in #mSliceWeakDataCache, and then an update sent via the Slice framework to the Slice. The Slice displayed by the Slice-presenter will re-query this Slice-provider and find the SliceData cached to build the full Slice. When an action is taken on that Slice, we receive the action in SliceBroadcastReceiver, and use the com.android.settings.core.BasePreferenceController indexed as SlicesDatabaseHelper.IndexColumns#CONTROLLER to manipulate the setting.

If preselected images are not provided, the default avatar will be shown instead, in a range of colors. This activity should be started with startActivityForResult. If a photo or a preselected image is selected, a Uri will be returned in the data field of the result intent. name: com.android.smspush.WapPushManager
description: The WapPushManager service is implemented to process incoming WAP Push messages and to maintain the Receiver Application/Application ID mapping. The WapPushManager runs as a system service, and only the WapPushManager can update the WAP Push message and Receiver Application mapping (Application ID Table). When the device receives an SMS WAP Push message, the WapPushManager looks up the Receiver Application name in Application ID Table. If an application is found, the application is launched using its full component name instead of broadcasting an implicit Intent. If a Receiver Application is not found in the Application ID Table or the WapPushManager returns a process-further value, the telephony stack will process the message using existing message processing flow, and broadcast an implicit Intent.

This Activity runs in its own separate process to isolate memory intensive image editing from SysUI process. TODO(b/267309532): Polish UI and animations.

name: com.android.systemui.screenshot.appclips.AppClipsTrampolineActivity
description: A trampoline activity that is responsible for: Performing precondition checks before starting the actual screenshot activity. Communicating with the screenshot activity and the calling activity. As this activity is started in a bubble app, the windowing for this activity is restricted to the parent bubble app. The screenshot editing activity, see AppClipsActivity, is started in a regular activity window using Intent#FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK. However, Activity#startActivityForResult(Intent, int) is not compatible with Intent#FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK. So, this activity acts as a trampoline activity to abstract the complexity of communication with the screenshot editing activity for a simpler developer experience. disableEffect: Users can no longer sign in to the BingoGame account needed by the SDK's account features.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoNoticeWebActivity
description: During BingoGame SDK initialization, the server's configured notice address opens in this screen as an in-app announcement with controls to return to the game.
disableEffect: Configured announcements will not open, and SDK initialization can fail when it tries to launch the notice screen.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoRetainedWebActivity
description: BingoGame opens this account-specific web screen for a configured mini-game or retained game page after checking the signed-in account.
disableEffect: BingoGame's account-specific mini-game and retained web pages will not open.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoSideActivity
description: BingoGame's Android SDK opens this in-game side panel to show configured game links and content actions such as web pages, sharing, and media previews.
disableEffect: The BingoGame side panel and its configured links and content actions will no longer be available.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoSplashActivity
description: The BingoGame SDK declares this as the app's launcher screen; when opened, it shows a brief splash and then starts the app's configured main destination.
disableEffect: The app's launcher handoff through BingoGame will no longer reach its main screen.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoUpdateActivity
description: When BingoGame's update check returns a new version, this screen displays the update details and download progress, including required updates.
disableEffect: The SDK cannot show or apply updates, and a configured forced update can prevent users from continuing.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoVoucherActivity
description: BingoGame opens this screen when the user views available game vouchers; it shows their details and expiration status.
disableEffect: Users can no longer view their BingoGame vouchers or expiration status.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoWebActivity
description: BingoGame opens this web screen for configured community pages, mini-games, and other SDK web content, with in-page navigation controls when enabled.
disableEffect: BingoGame community, mini-game, and other web pages will not open.

name: com.bingo.sdk.activity.BingoWebPayActivity
description: BingoGame opens this checkout screen with an order and payment address; it handles WeChat or Alipay handoffs and reports reward-ad results from the page.
disableEffect: Web purchases through BingoGame cannot complete, and rewards for watching ads in this payment flow will no longer be granted.

name: com.bingo.sdk.pictureselector.SelectorSupporterActivity
description: BingoGame opens this media-selection screen when a web page requests a file; the user can choose media for the page.
disableEffect: BingoGame media selection and web upload controls will no longer work.

name: com.bingo.sdk.provider.BingoFileProvider
description: BingoGame's installer uses this file provider to give Android access to a downloaded APK with the app's configured file paths.
disableEffect: BingoGame cannot give the system installer access to downloaded APKs, so its package-install flow fails.

name: com.bingo.sdk.service.InstallBroadCastReceiver
description: When BingoGame receives an internal request to install a downloaded package, this receiver opens its installer screen with the file details.
disableEffect: BingoGame installation requests will no longer open the installer screen.

name: com.bingzer.android.driven.dropbox.app.DropboxActivity
description: The Bingzer Driven storage library opens Dropbox authorization, lets the user approve access, and returns the sign-in result to the app.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect a Dropbox account through Driven.

name: com.bingzer.android.driven.gdrive.app.GoogleDriveActivity
description: The Bingzer Driven storage library lets the user choose a Google account and authorize access to Google Drive, then returns the result to the app.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect Google Drive through Driven.

name: com.bingzer.android.driven.local.app.ExternalDriveActivity
description: The Bingzer Driven storage library validates a local external-storage folder supplied by the app and returns whether the connection succeeded.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect this local folder through Driven.

name: com.birjuvachhani.locus.LocationBroadcastReceiver
description: Locus, Birju Vachhani's Android location library, receives updates from Android's location service and delivers the latest position to the app. It runs when the app has requested ongoing location updates.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops those location updates from reaching the app, which can break features that rely on current location or location tracking.

name: com.birjuvachhani.locus.LocusActivity
description: Locus, Birju Vachhani's Android location library, opens this Activity when the app requests location access. It asks for the required permissions and, if needed, guides the user to turn on location or open the app's permission settings.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Locus from completing its permission and location setup, so location features that use the library may not work.

name: com.blankj.molihuan.utilcode.util.MessengerUtils$ServerService

disableEffect: App features that rely on messages between processes may stop receiving updates or callbacks.

name: com.blankj.molihuan.utilcode.util.UtilsFileProvider
description: MoliHuan’s general utility library uses this provider to initialize its helpers when the app starts and to grant controlled access to files through content links.

name: com.blankj.molihuan.utilcode.util.UtilsTransActivity
description: MoliHuan’s general utility library opens this transparent helper activity when a task needs an activity context, including permission prompts. It returns task updates to the calling feature.

name: com.blankj.molihuan.utilcode.util.UtilsTransActivity4MainProcess
description: MoliHuan’s general utility library uses this transparent helper activity for tasks that must run through the app’s main process. It returns the task updates to the calling feature.
disableEffect: Features that rely on these main-process helper tasks may not complete.

name: com.blankj.utilcode.util.MessengerUtils$ServerService
description: The Blankj AndroidUtilCode messaging service starts when the app sends a message between processes or another process connects through the app-specific messaging action. It forwards messages to registered parts of the app.
disableEffect: App features that use this service will stop receiving messages from other processes.

name: com.blankj.utilcode.util.UtilsFileProvider
description: The Blankj AndroidUtilCode file provider initializes the utility library when the app starts and makes app files available through shareable content links.
disableEffect: Sharing or opening files through the utility library may fail, and the library may not initialize as expected.

name: com.blankj.utilcode.util.UtilsTransActivity

disableEffect: Permission requests and other utility operations that rely on this Activity may fail or lose their results.

name: com.blankj.utilcode.util.UtilsTransActivity4MainProcess
description: This is the Blankj AndroidUtilCode main-process variant of its transparent helper Activity; app code can use it for short tasks that need an Activity and return permission or activity results.
disableEffect: Utility operations that rely on this main-process Activity may fail or lose their returned results.

name: com.ble.ble.BleService
description: When the TTC Android BLE SDK connects to a nearby supported device, this background Service manages the Bluetooth LE connection, exchanges device data, and reports connection changes to the app.
disableEffect: The app cannot connect to or exchange data with supported Bluetooth devices through this SDK.

name: com.blitzllama.androidSDK.webView.WebViewActivity
description: When a Blitzllama survey has a call-to-action link, this Activity opens the link in an in-app browser and lets the user navigate back.
disableEffect: Links in Blitzllama surveys will no longer open inside the app.

name: com.bluebillywig.bbnativeplayersdk.ModalActivity
description: The Blue Billywig Native Player SDK opens this screen when a video player or shelf is expanded; it displays the selected player in a full-screen modal and responds to orientation changes.
disableEffect: The app’s expanded video player and shelf playback screen will no longer open.

name: com.bluecats.sdk.BlueCatsSDKService
description: The BlueCats Android SDK starts this service while its beacon engine is active. It initializes Bluetooth scanning, handles beacon-site updates and network changes, and keeps the beacon engine running.
disableEffect: Bluetooth beacon discovery and any app actions driven by nearby BlueCats beacons will stop.

name: com.blueshift.BlueshiftPermissionsActivity

name: com.blueshift.batch.AlarmReceiver

name: com.blueshift.batch.BulkEventJobService
description: When Android runs a scheduled Blueshift event job, this Service queues collected events for network delivery.
disableEffect: Blueshift’s scheduled event batches will not be queued for delivery.

name: com.blueshift.core.schedule.network.BlueshiftNetworkChangeJobService

disableEffect: Queued Blueshift events and requests will not be flushed by this connectivity job.

name: com.blueshift.httpmanager.request_queue.RequestQueueJobService

disableEffect: Blueshift requests waiting for network delivery may remain queued.

name: com.blueshift.inbox.BlueshiftInboxActivity
description: When the app opens the Blueshift message inbox, this Activity displays the SDK’s inbox screen and its list of messages.
disableEffect: The Blueshift in-app message inbox will not open.

name: com.blueshift.pn.BlueshiftNotificationEventsActivity
description: When a user opens a Blueshift push notification or taps one of its actions, this Activity processes the selected action and then closes.
disableEffect: Blueshift notification taps will no longer open their linked app content or be recorded by the SDK.

name: com.blueshift.receiver.NetworkChangeListener
description: On Android versions where it is registered, this Blueshift Receiver runs after a connectivity-change broadcast and retries queued network requests.
disableEffect: Blueshift queued requests will not be retried when network connectivity changes.

name: com.blueshift.rich_push.NotificationActivity
description: When an older Blueshift rich push uses an alert dialog, this Activity shows the message and lets the user open the app or dismiss the alert.
disableEffect: Blueshift alert-style push messages will no longer show their open and dismiss dialog.

name: com.blueshift.rich_push.NotificationWorker

name: com.blueshift.rich_push.ScheduledPushReceiver
description: When the app-specific Blueshift scheduled-push broadcast arrives, this Receiver reads the scheduled message and asks the SDK to display it.
disableEffect: Locally scheduled Blueshift notifications will not be displayed.

name: com.blukii.sdk.discovery.BootReceiver
description: After a supported boot or reboot broadcast, this blukii Receiver restores saved discovery settings and restarts nearby-device discovery when those settings exist.
disableEffect: blukii background device discovery will not resume automatically after a reboot.

name: com.blukii.sdk.discovery.DeviceDiscoveryJobService
description: When Android runs a scheduled blukii discovery job, this Service starts a worker that scans for nearby devices using the saved scan settings.
disableEffect: Scheduled blukii nearby-device scans will stop running.

name: com.blukii.sdk.discovery.DeviceDiscoveryService
description: When the blukii SDK starts nearby-device discovery, this foreground location Service hosts the scan worker and keeps the discovery session active.
disableEffect: blukii foreground nearby-device scanning and its discovery results will stop.

name: com.blukii.sdk.discovery.TriggerNearbyReceiver
description: When Google Nearby delivers a subscribed-device trigger, this blukii Receiver checks location access and starts the discovery listener for a valid nearby trigger.
disableEffect: Nearby-device triggers will no longer start a blukii discovery session.

name: com.blukii.sdk.info.DeviceDiscoveryService

name: com.blukii.sdk.monitoring.MonitoringJobService

disableEffect: blukii will stop uploading beacon battery and activity statistics.

name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.CallingPageFullNativeTransActivity

disableEffect: BNC GIMAC pages that use this screen base may fail to open or return correctly.

name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.FlutterBaseStatusBarTransActivity

name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.FlutterBoostNativeActivity

disableEffect: The app may be unable to open the requested Flutter page or receive its result.

name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.FlutterBoostNativeTransActivity
description: When a native screen opens a transparent BNC GIMAC Flutter page, this Activity shows it over the existing screen and closes back to the caller. Disabling it can interrupt that navigation flow.
disableEffect: The app may be unable to display or close the transparent Flutter page correctly.

name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.service.FloatMeetingFullWindowServices

name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.util.sp.PreferenceProvider

disableEffect: BNC GIMAC screens may lose saved preferences or fail when they try to read or update them.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltActiveBookingListActivity
description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this screen from the active-bookings area and loads the user's current charger bookings. Selecting a booking opens its charging controls.
disableEffect: Users cannot review or open active bookings from this list.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltAddPaymentAccountActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot add a bank account for Bolt payments or payouts.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltApplyCouponActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot choose a coupon during charger checkout.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltBannerActivity

disableEffect: The SDK launch flow may stop before the main Bolt screen opens.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltBookChargerActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot book a charging session or continue from checkout to its controls.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltBookingHistoryActivity

disableEffect: Users lose access to their Bolt booking history and its expense summary.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltBuyChargerActivity

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltChargerSyncInfoActivity

disableEffect: Charger readings may not be synchronized with Bolt booking records.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltChargerUpdateActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot install firmware updates on the charger through Bolt.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltCustomerSupportDetailsActivity

disableEffect: Users lose the in-app support contact page and its call and email shortcuts.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltEarningsActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot view their Bolt earnings and charging summary.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltEditChargerDetailsActivity

disableEffect: Owners cannot update the charger listing and its payment or contact details through Bolt.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltEnterUserPhoneEmailForPaymentActivity

disableEffect: Users may be unable to provide the contact details required to continue charger payment.

name: com.boltCore.android.activities.BoltMainActivity

name: com.boswelja.watchconnection.wearos.message.WearOSMessageReceiver

disableEffect: The app will no longer receive messages from the watch if this service is disabled.
