name: com.drivebuddyapp.drivebuddysdk.DriveBuddyService
description: During older DriveBuddy setup, this foreground service registers vehicle activity transitions. When the phone detects entering or leaving a vehicle, it starts or stops drive tracking.
disableEffect: DriveBuddy's automatic trip start and stop detection may not work.

name: com.drivebuddyapp.drivebuddysdk.DriveBuddyTransitionReceiver
description: When Google Activity Recognition reports a recent vehicle transition, this Receiver forwards it to DriveBuddy's trip tracker so it can start or stop a drive.
disableEffect: DriveBuddy can miss vehicle transitions and record trip boundaries incorrectly.

name: com.drivebuddyapp.drivebuddysdk.DriveBuddyUploaderService
description: When DriveBuddy has queued trip, crash, or log files, it starts this foreground service to send sensor files and related records to its server when the network and an access token are available.
disableEffect: Trip and crash records may remain on the device instead of reaching DriveBuddy's service.

name: com.drivebuddyapp.drivebuddysdk.DriveBuddyWifiReceiver
description: When Android reports a Wi-Fi state change and a connection becomes available, this Receiver checks DriveBuddy setup and queues stored files for upload.
disableEffect: DriveBuddy will miss this automatic setup and upload step after Wi-Fi reconnects.

name: com.drivemetadata.InstallReferrerProvider
description: When DriveMetaData or app code queries the install-referrer path, this provider checks Facebook, Instagram, and Facebook Lite referrer sources, saves campaign details it can read, and returns an available referrer record.
disableEffect: DriveMetaData can no longer provide these social install-attribution details to its tracking code.

name: com.drivemode.timberlorry.buffer.BufferProvider
description: When Drivemode TimberLorry's log-collection SDK receives log records for later collection, this private Provider stores them in the app's local database.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents TimberLorry from saving or reading pending logs, while the host app's own features continue to work.

name: com.drivemode.timberlorry.collector.CollectorService
description: Android starts this Drivemode TimberLorry log-collection service in a background sync process when the scheduled job runs; it collects the app's pending logs.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops TimberLorry's scheduled log collection, while the host app's features continue to work.

name: com.drivemode.timberlorry.internal.authenticator.StubAuthenticatorService
description: Android connects to this Drivemode TimberLorry service while setting up scheduled log syncing, making the SDK's log-collection job available to the system.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents TimberLorry's sync account from being set up for log collection, but does not affect the host app's own features.

name: com.droidkit.pickers.file.FilePickerActivity
description: DroidKit Pickers opens this Activity when the host app requests file selection; it browses folders and returns the files the user selects.
disableEffect: The app cannot use this picker to choose files for importing or attaching.

name: com.droidkit.pickers.map.MapPickerActivity
description: DroidKit Pickers opens this Activity when the host app requests a location; it shows a searchable map and nearby places and returns the selected place and coordinates.
disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to select a map location.

name: com.dropbox.client2.android.AuthActivity
description: The Dropbox Android SDK opens this screen when an app starts Dropbox account authorization, handing the user to the Dropbox app or web sign-in and receiving the return. The GroundUpWorks Wings Dropbox integration uses it to connect an account for photo sharing.
disableEffect: Users cannot link or reauthorize a Dropbox account, so Wings photo sharing to Dropbox may fail.

name: com.dsideal.logreport.upload.UploadService
description: When the Livery log-report library is asked to upload diagnostics, this service checks for crash reports, packages them with logs, and sends the archive through the configured uploader.
disableEffect: Crash reports and accompanying logs collected by Livery will remain on the device instead of being uploaded.

name: com.dsly.weblib.download.AgentWebFileProvider
description: DSly Android WebLib declares this support-library FileProvider to expose app files as content links for external file handoffs.
disableEffect: Any file handoff that relies on this provider will fail.

name: com.dsly.weblib.view.X5WebViewActivity
description: When an app opens an HTTPS link with the VIEW action, DSly Android WebLib displays it in an X5 web screen with page navigation, progress, and video support.
disableEffect: Links routed to this screen will no longer open inside the app.

name: com.dtf.face.nfc.ui.NfcInfoInputActivity
description: The Ant Digital identity-verification SDK opens this form when passport verification uses manual entry; users enter the passport number, birth date, and expiry date before the NFC step. Disabling it blocks that verification route.
disableEffect: Passport verification in manual-entry mode cannot proceed to the NFC read.

name: com.dtf.face.nfc.ui.NfcReadActivity
description: The Ant Digital identity-verification SDK opens this screen for NFC document checks; it guides users through positioning a passport or ID card and reading its chip. Disabling it prevents the SDK from completing that document check.
disableEffect: Passport and ID-card verification that requires NFC cannot read the document or return its result.

name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OCRLandActivity
description: The Ant Digital OCR SDK opens this landscape screen when an identity-document scan requires the wide layout; it captures and reads the document image. Disabling it prevents that scan from completing.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete document OCR in the landscape verification flow.

name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OCRPortActivity
description: The Ant Digital OCR SDK opens this portrait screen for identity-document scans on the standard layout; it captures and reads the document image. Disabling it prevents that scan from completing.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete document OCR in the portrait verification flow.

name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OcrGuideBackActivity
description: In the older Ant Digital OCR flow, this screen explains how to photograph the back of an identity document and opens the camera when the user continues. After the photo is accepted, the flow proceeds to face verification.
disableEffect: The back side of a document cannot be captured in this OCR flow, so verification may not finish.

name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OcrGuideBaseActivity
description: In the older Ant Digital OCR SDK, this general screen presents document-capture guidance and handles camera permission and photo review; the normal flow opens separate front- and back-side guides. Disabling this entry prevents the general screen from opening directly.
disableEffect: Only direct launches of this general guide are blocked; the SDK's separate front- and back-side guide screens remain available.

name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OcrGuideFaceActivity
description: After document photos are accepted, the older Ant Digital OCR flow shows this transition screen and then opens the configured face-verification step. Disabling it interrupts the document-to-face verification handoff.
disableEffect: The OCR flow cannot continue from document capture to its required face-verification step.

name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OcrGuideFrontActivity
description: The older Ant Digital OCR flow opens this screen before capturing the front of an identity document; continuing opens the camera, and the accepted photo advances the document flow. Disabling it blocks that capture step.
disableEffect: Users cannot begin the front-side document capture in this OCR flow.

name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OcrTakePhotoActivity
description: The Ant Digital OCR SDK opens this camera screen from its document guides to capture the front or back of an ID or passport and return the selected image. Disabling it stops document-photo capture.
disableEffect: The required identity-document photo cannot be captured or returned to the verification flow.

name: com.dtf.face.ui.AuthDegradeActivity
description: When Ant Digital face verification enters its fallback authorization route, this browsable screen lets the user exit or continue with Alipay-based verification and returns the outcome. Disabling it removes that authentication path.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete the Alipay fallback verification route.

name: com.dtf.face.ui.LandFaceLoadingActivity
description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK uses this landscape loading screen while preparing a face check, requesting camera access, loading verification models, and showing any required authorization page. Disabling it can stop the landscape verification flow before capture.
disableEffect: Landscape face verification may fail before the face check begins.

name: com.dtf.face.ui.LandOpaqueFaceLoadingActivity
description: This is the Ant Digital face-verification SDK's opaque landscape loading screen; the manifest marks it as a compatibility variant for Android 8.0. It prepares the face check, camera permission, verification models, and authorization page.
disableEffect: The landscape compatibility route may not be able to start face verification.

name: com.dtf.face.ui.PortFaceLoadingActivity
description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK uses this portrait loading screen while preparing a face check, requesting camera access, loading verification models, and showing any required authorization page. Disabling it can stop the portrait verification flow before capture.
disableEffect: Portrait face verification may fail before the face check begins.

name: com.dtf.face.ui.PortOpaqueFaceLoadingActivity
description: This is the Ant Digital face-verification SDK's opaque portrait loading screen; the manifest marks it as a compatibility variant for Android 8.0. It prepares the face check, camera permission, verification models, and authorization page.
disableEffect: The portrait compatibility route may not be able to start face verification.

name: com.dtf.face.ui.ToygerLandActivity
description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK opens this landscape camera Activity when the verification settings or device layout call for landscape mode; it runs the live-face check and returns the result. Disabling it blocks that face-verification route.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete landscape face verification.

name: com.dtf.face.ui.ToygerPortActivity
description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK opens this portrait camera Activity for its standard live-face check and returns the result to the calling flow. Disabling it blocks portrait face verification.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete portrait face verification.

name: com.dtf.wish.evidence.EvidenceService
description: During an Aliyun WishVerify real-person check, this background service starts or stops screen and voice evidence recording and returns the recordings to the verification flow.
disableEffect: The verification flow cannot collect and return required screen and voice evidence, so checks that rely on it will fail.

name: com.dudu.ads.lib.activity.BaseWebActivity
description: Dudu Ads Library opens a web link supplied by the app inside an in-app page with a title bar and a close control.
disableEffect: Links that use this Dudu Ads page will no longer open inside the app.

name: com.duitku.sdk.DuitkuTransaction
description: The Duitku Android payment SDK opens this Activity during checkout, requests a transaction, displays Duitku's payment page in the app, and handles the payment response.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete Duitku checkout or receive its transaction result.

name: com.duitku.sdk.ListPaymentMethodDuitku
description: The Duitku Android payment SDK opens this Activity when checkout begins; it loads available payment methods and opens the payment page after the user chooses one.
disableEffect: Users cannot choose a Duitku payment method to start checkout.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.bdpass.DKAccountContainerActivity
description: Duoku Single SDK opens this account page when the game's Duoku login flow requests account interaction.
disableEffect: Duoku account sign-in and account-management flows that use this page will fail.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.gameplus.service.GPDownloadService
description: Duoku GamePlus binds this background Service when a game requests queued game downloads. It tracks progress and responds to network changes so downloads can pause or resume.
disableEffect: Game packages and updates managed by Duoku GamePlus will no longer download; the host game's own play features remain available.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.permission.GamePermissionActivity
description: Duoku GamePlus opens this screen when its account or download flow requests phone or file access, then returns the permission result to the SDK.
disableEffect: Duoku account or download steps that require these permissions can fail.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.receiver.PushMessageReceiver
description: Duoku's Baidu-backed push SDK receives message, delivery, and notification-click callbacks, then forwards them to the game or opens the requested page.
disableEffect: Duoku push messages and notification actions will stop working; the host game remains available.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.ui.DKContainerActivity
description: Duoku Single SDK opens the requested GamePlus platform screen in its shared page window when a game invokes that screen.
disableEffect: Duoku platform screens that use this Activity, including account or service pages, will not open.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.ui.DKLotteryDrawActivity
description: Duoku Single SDK opens a turntable draw and draw-history screen when the game requests a lottery event. It loads draw counts, entries, and results from the Duoku service.
disableEffect: Players will lose access to the Duoku draw event and any game rewards delivered through it.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.ui.DKRecommendActivity
description: Duoku GamePlus opens its recommended-games page or its download and installed-game update manager when requested.
disableEffect: Duoku game recommendations and its separate game-download/update pages will not open; the host game remains playable.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.ui.DKStartDownloadActivity
description: Duoku GamePlus displays a download prompt when a player starts downloading a recommended game or package.
disableEffect: The Duoku download prompt and the game-package download it starts will not work.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.ui.DKVerifyActivity
description: Duoku Single SDK loads a real-name verification page when its game-account or cashier flow requires an identity check.
disableEffect: Real-name checks required by the Duoku game platform or cashier will fail, which can prevent account access or purchases.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.view.DKPrevtAdcateActivity
description: Duoku's anti-addiction service opens this screen when age or play-time rules block game entry. It handles real-name results and lets the SDK resume or close the game.
disableEffect: Required age and anti-addiction checks can be bypassed or left incomplete, and the game may not be allowed to continue through the Duoku platform.

name: com.duoku.platform.single.view.NetworkErrorActivity
description: Duoku GamePlus shows this error page when a game download cannot continue because of a network problem.
disableEffect: The Duoku download error and retry screen will not appear; the host game's own features remain available.

name: com.duoku.sdk.download.receiver.DownloadStateReceiver
description: Duoku's download SDK receives download-state broadcasts and updates the status of queued packages.
disableEffect: Download progress and completion updates for Duoku-managed packages may stop.

name: com.duoku.sdk.download.receiver.InstallReceiver
description: Duoku GamePlus listens for Android package-added and package-removed events to update the installed status of downloaded games.
disableEffect: Duoku's game-download manager may show stale installed-game status.

name: com.duoku.sdk.download.receiver.NetworkReceiver
description: Duoku's download manager listens for network-connectivity changes to pause or resume package downloads.
disableEffect: Duoku downloads may not respond correctly when the network disconnects or returns.

name: com.duoku.sdk.download.ui.DKDownloadManagerActivity
description: Duoku GamePlus opens a screen where users can view and manage downloaded games, active downloads, and available upgrades.
disableEffect: The Duoku download manager and its separate game-install/update controls will not open.

name: com.dvmms.dejapay.terminals.DvPaymentActivity
description: The DejaPay (iPOS Systems/Dejavoo) payment SDK opens this Activity for terminal transactions, sends payment details to the selected Dejavoo terminal app, and returns the result; Dejavoo can also open it for terminal registration.
disableEffect: The app cannot start or complete Dejavoo terminal payments or handle registration through this integration.

name: com.dylanc.activityresult.launcher.ActivityLauncherFileProvider
description: Dylan Cai’s ActivityResultLauncher includes this private provider for camera output files. Its photo and video capture helpers use it when the app configures the library to use this provider.
disableEffect: If the app uses this provider for camera output, disabling it prevents the camera from opening the photo or video file.

name: com.dynatrace.android.sessionreplay.core.executor.services.MessengerService
description: The Dynatrace Session Replay SDK declares this service disabled by default. If enabled, it coordinates when replay data is ready and when a recording should stop.
disableEffect: If the SDK enables this service, blocking it prevents replay coordination; the host app's own features are unaffected.

name: com.dynatrace.android.sessionreplay.core.executor.services.SecondaryProcessService
description: Dynatrace Session Replay starts this background service to process session replay data separately from the app's main work.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops background Session Replay tasks from running in the separate process, but leaves host-app features working.

name: com.dynatrace.android.sessionreplay.core.executor.services.UseCaseQueueJobIntentService
description: When Dynatrace Session Replay schedules background work, Android starts this service to process session replay data.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops Dynatrace Session Replay tasks from being processed, while the host app continues to work.

name: com.eartho.one.provider.AuthenticationActivity
description: Eartho One opens a browser for authentication when the app starts a sign-in or sign-out flow, then returns the result to the app.
disableEffect: Browser-based Eartho One sign-in and sign-out flows will not complete.

name: com.eartho.one.provider.RedirectActivity
description: Eartho One receives the app-specific browser return link after authentication and forwards it to the authentication screen to finish the flow.
disableEffect: The browser will not be able to return Eartho One authentication results to the app.

name: com.easebuzz.library.AlertMessage
description: Swapnil Huddar's AlertDemo Android library opens this screen to show an app-supplied title and message in a dialog, then closes when the user responds. An app may use it for a checkout notice.
disableEffect: A checkout or status notice that uses this dialog may no longer appear.

name: com.easebuzz.payment.kit.PWEBankPageActivity
description: Easebuzz's payment gateway opens this Activity for bank-page payment confirmation. It displays the bank page, supports the OTP step, and returns the transaction result to the app.
disableEffect: Payments that use this bank confirmation flow may fail or remain incomplete.

name: com.easebuzz.payment.kit.PWECheckoutActivity
description: Easebuzz's payment gateway opens this Activity to show its checkout payment page. It processes the user's payment choice and returns the transaction result to the host app.
disableEffect: Payments that rely on this checkout screen cannot be completed.

name: com.easebuzz.payment.kit.PWECouponsActivity
description: Easebuzz's payment gateway opens this Activity during checkout to show payment methods, cashback offers, and discount codes. It applies the selected offer and submits the payment.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose a payment method or complete checkout through this Easebuzz flow.

name: com.easebuzz.payment.kit.PWETimerService
description: While an Easebuzz payment is pending, this Service counts down the transaction session and sends updates so the checkout can show remaining time and handle expiry.
disableEffect: The checkout can lose its countdown and may not end an expired payment cleanly.

name: com.eason.permissionmanager.PermissionActivity
description: Eason's AndroidUtils permission library opens Android's permission prompt when the app requests access, then returns which permissions were granted or denied.
disableEffect: The permission request cannot complete through this screen, so app features that need those permissions may stop working.

name: com.easygames.platform.account.GameAgreementActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen from sign-in and account-linking pages to display the configured service agreement. Players can scroll through it and close the page to return to the account flow.
disableEffect: If disabled, players cannot read the service agreement from the SDK's sign-in or account-linking flow.

name: com.easygames.platform.account.GameChannelBindActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when a player links a game account to a sign-in channel or verifies a phone number or email address. It handles the selected account provider and confirmation code.
disableEffect: Players cannot link sign-in accounts or add and update verified contact details through the SDK.

name: com.easygames.platform.account.GameCheckRulesActivity
description: Before a new player signs in, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK shows the service agreement and, for some regional settings, the privacy policy. It waits for the player to accept before continuing.
disableEffect: New players cannot complete the SDK's consent step, so sign-in cannot continue.

name: com.easygames.platform.account.GamePolicyActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when a player chooses the privacy-policy link in an account flow. It displays the configured policy text for reading.
disableEffect: Players cannot review the privacy policy from the SDK's account screens.

name: com.easygames.platform.account.GameRetrieveActivity
description: From the forgotten-password option on the sign-in screen, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK lets a player request a password reset after confirming their registered email or phone number with a one-time code.
disableEffect: Players lose the SDK's email and phone account-recovery path.

name: com.easygames.platform.account.GameSignInActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when the game asks a player to sign in or switch accounts. It presents the available account and social sign-in choices, registration, and saved-player options.
disableEffect: Players cannot sign in, register, or switch accounts through this SDK.

name: com.easygames.platform.others.GameOperationActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen for optional app-rating, Facebook promotion or sharing, and LINE promotion activities requested by the game. It presents configured images or links and returns whether the player completed or cancelled the activity.
disableEffect: The SDK's rating and social-promotion screens stop working, while the game's other screens remain available.

name: com.easygames.platform.payment.GamePurchaseActivity
description: When the game requests a purchase, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK displays the product and order details and starts the configured payment route, including supported in-app, carrier, and web payments.
disableEffect: Players cannot complete purchases started through this SDK.

name: com.easygames.platform.usercenter.GameAuthenticationActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when real-name verification is requested during sign-in or account management. It asks for the player's legal name and identity number, submits them for verification, and returns the result.
disableEffect: Players cannot complete real-name verification through the SDK.

name: com.easygames.platform.usercenter.GameInfoBindActivity
description: From account security settings, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen to bind or change a phone number or email address after code verification.
disableEffect: Players cannot add or change verified phone and email contacts for the account.

name: com.easygames.platform.usercenter.GameUserCenterActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen from its account-center option. It shows the player's profile, security contacts, recharge records, and controls such as password change and sign-out.
disableEffect: Players cannot view or manage their account details through the SDK.

name: com.easygames.support.activities.GameBrowserAcitivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens this embedded browser for SDK web pages, external return links, and web-payment or promotion flows. It also accepts browsable links such as the configured Twitter return link.
disableEffect: Players cannot complete web-based payments or return through links handled by the SDK browser.

name: com.easygames.support.activities.GamePermissionActivity
description: When the host app opens the EGLS (EasyGames) permission-information screen, it shows the app name, version, icon, and configured explanation on the first run. It also forwards any permission results delivered to this screen.
disableEffect: Players cannot see the SDK's first-run permission guidance or return permission results through this screen.

name: com.easygames.support.facebook.FacebookAssociateActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) support library receives the return link for Facebook account association, forwards its token to the game's account flow, and then closes.
disableEffect: Facebook account association cannot return its result to the game.

name: com.easygames.support.facebook.FacebookGameInvitationActivity
description: When the game asks to invite friends, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens Facebook's game-request dialog. It returns the selected invitees' profile details or a cancellation or error result.
disableEffect: Players cannot invite Facebook friends through the game's SDK integration.

name: com.easygames.support.facebook.FacebookShareActivity
description: When the game asks to share an image or link, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens Facebook's sharing dialog. It returns whether sharing succeeded, was cancelled, or failed.
disableEffect: Players cannot share game images or links through Facebook using the SDK.

name: com.easygames.support.facebook.FacebookSignInActivity
description: When the game requests Facebook sign-in, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library obtains the player's Facebook account details after the requested permissions are granted and returns them to the game.
disableEffect: Players cannot sign in to the game with Facebook.

name: com.easygames.support.google.signin.GoogleApiClientActivity
description: When the game starts Google sign-in through the EGLS (EasyGames) support library, this screen checks for an existing session or opens Google sign-in. It returns the player's account details and an authentication token or code.
disableEffect: Players cannot use this Google sign-in flow to access the game.

name: com.easygames.support.google.signin.GoogleSignInClientActivity
description: When launched for Google sign-in, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library checks for an existing Google account or asks the player to choose one. It returns the account details and an authentication token or code.
disableEffect: Players cannot use this Google sign-in flow to access the game.

name: com.ebay.api.client.auth.oauth2.ui.OAuthActivity
description: The eBay OAuth Android Client opens this Activity to start browser-based account authorization, then handles the returned authorization code or error.
disableEffect: Apps using eBay OAuth cannot complete authorization or receive its result.

name: com.ebay.api.client.auth.oauth2.ui.OAuthRedirectActivity
description: When the browser redirects an eBay authorization response back to the app, this Activity forwards the returned link to the OAuth flow for processing.
disableEffect: The eBay authorization response cannot be delivered to the app's OAuth flow.

name: com.ech0s7r.android.log.service.WriterService
description: The ech0s7r androidlog library binds this service when file logging receives messages; it queues them and appends them to the current daily log file.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops androidlog from writing file logs, while the host app's features continue to work.

name: com.echat.matisse.internal.ui.AlbumPreviewActivity
description: When a user taps a photo in EChatSoft's EChat media picker, this Activity previews images from the selected album before the user chooses one.
disableEffect: The user cannot preview album photos before attaching them to an EChat conversation.

name: com.echat.matisse.internal.ui.SelectedPreviewActivity
description: When the user reviews media already selected in EChatSoft's EChat picker, this Activity shows the selected items in a preview and returns them to the picker.
disableEffect: The user cannot review selected media before attaching it to an EChat message.

name: com.echat.matisse.ui.MatisseActivity
description: When an EChat attachment flow opens the EChatSoft media picker, this Activity lists media albums, lets the user choose photos or videos, and returns the selection.
disableEffect: Users cannot choose photos or videos to attach to an EChat message.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.agentweb.ActionActivity
description: When an EChatSoft embedded web page requests a permission or asks to attach a file, photo, or video, this Activity opens the matching Android prompt or chooser and returns the result.
disableEffect: Embedded EChat pages may be unable to request permissions or select files and media for upload.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.broadcast.DownloadUpdateReceiver
description: After an EChat attachment finishes downloading, this Receiver records its saved location in the chat's local file record.
disableEffect: A downloaded attachment may not be linked to its chat message or available to open.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.core.utils.UtilsFileProvider
description: At app startup and when EChatSoft needs to share a local file with Android or another app, this Provider initializes SDK utilities and supplies a safe file link.
disableEffect: EChat startup or sharing and opening chat files may fail.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.core.utils.UtilsTransActivity
description: When EChatSoft needs an Android runtime permission, it opens this short-lived Activity to show the system prompt and return the user's choice to the requesting feature.
disableEffect: EChat features that need a system permission may be unable to request or receive it.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.core.utils.provider.MultiProcessSharedPreferences
description: EChatSoft's EChat SDK uses this Provider to share saved settings and user information between the app and its chat process.
disableEffect: EChat settings or account information may not be available across processes, disrupting chat features.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.cp.CCContentProvider
description: EChatSoft diagnostic tools use this exported Provider to read SDK version and log information and to change diagnostic switches.
disableEffect: External EChat version and diagnostic controls will no longer be available through this Provider.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.download.DownloadFileProvider
description: When an EChat download is opened, Android uses this Provider to give the file viewer safe access to the downloaded file.
disableEffect: Opening downloaded EChat attachments in a file viewer or another app may fail.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.imagebrowserlibrary.ImageBrowserActivity
description: When EChatSoft's image browser is opened for a set of images, this Activity displays them full screen so the user can swipe, zoom, and save an image.
disableEffect: Full-screen image preview and saving from EChat's image browser will not work.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.service.EChatCancelService
description: On Android 4.4 through 7.0, EChatSoft briefly starts this Service to remove its temporary chat-service notification after startup.
disableEffect: On Android 4.4 through 7.0, EChat's temporary service notification may remain visible.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.service.EChatCoreJobService
description: Android runs this scheduled EChatSoft Service to restore the chat connection and respond to network changes while the app is in the background.
disableEffect: Background chat reconnection may stop, so new messages or updates can be missed until EChat is opened again.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.service.EChatDownloadService
description: When the EChat SDK queues an incoming chat attachment, this Service downloads it and reports progress to the conversation.
disableEffect: Incoming chat attachments may not download or become available to open.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.service.EChatFasionCoreService
description: When EChatSoft starts its background chat session, this Service maintains the connection and tries to restore it after network changes.
disableEffect: EChat may miss new messages and chat updates while the app is in the background.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.service.EChatMProcessService
description: EChatSoft starts this Service in the app's main process alongside its chat services to coordinate their startup and shutdown.
disableEffect: Background chat coordination may fail, making message delivery and other chat updates less reliable.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.service.EChatThirdFastbootService
description: EChatSoft briefly starts this Service to warm the separate web-page process before an EChat page is opened, then stops it.
disableEffect: The first EChat web page may take longer to open.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.service.EChatUploadService
description: When a user sends a file or media attachment in an EChat conversation, this Service uploads it and reports progress or failure.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to send file and media attachments in EChat conversations.

name: com.echatsoft.echatsdk.ui.box.MessageBoxActivity

name: com.edna.android.push_lite.NotificationHandlingActivity

description: The PrivacyStreams framework’s accessibility Service runs after the user enables it in Android settings; it forwards accessibility changes and the current window’s content to PrivacyStreams handlers.
disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop receiving accessibility event data, while the app’s other screens remain available.

disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop receiving notification content and change events; the app’s other features remain available.

name: com.github.privacystreams.notification.PSNotificationListenerService

disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop receiving notification events; the app’s other features remain available.

name: com.github.privacystreams.utils.PSFileProvider

disableEffect: Photo capture may fail because the camera cannot access the requested output file.

name: com.github.privacystreams.utils.PSPermissionActivity

name: com.github.shadowsocks.bg.ProxyService

disableEffect: The proxy connection handled by this service will stop.

name: com.github.shadowsocks.bg.TransproxyService

name: com.github.shadowsocks.bg.VpnService

disableEffect: Shadowsocks VPN connections cannot start or remain active.

name: com.github.shadowsocks.subscription.SubscriptionService

disableEffect: Subscription-linked server lists will no longer refresh, so their saved profiles may become outdated.

name: com.github.shenyuanqing.zxingsimplify.zxing.Activity.CaptureActivity

name: com.github.venom.VenomService

name: com.github.venom.service.VenomService

name: com.github.zhangjianli.stallbuster.ui.ReportListActivity

name: com.glance.gamecentersdk.view.GameContainerActivity

name: com.hannesdorfmann.debugoverlay.DebugOverlayService

disableEffect: The debug message panel will not appear; the app's other screens continue to work.

disableEffect: Disabling it has no visible effect in the analyzed version because it does not restart tracking or perform another task.

name: com.haochezhu.ubm.detectors.gms.activity.DetectedActivityReceiver

disableEffect: Automatic trip detection may miss or fail to record trips.

name: com.haochezhu.ubm.detectors.gms.geofence.GeofenceBroadcastReceiver

disableEffect: UBM may stop responding to monitored location boundaries and may miss related trip events.

disableEffect: Dynamically supplied full-screen pages that use this screen will not open.

disableEffect: Users lose this SDK screen for opening a room or starting a broadcast.

disableEffect: Users lose the SDK’s live and tools tabs.

name: com.immomo.molive.hello.gui.activity.MainActivity

name: com.immomo.molive.hello.gui.activity.WelcomeActivity

disableEffect: Disabling this activity prevents the launcher route from reaching the SDK entry screen.

name: com.immomo.molive.hello.modulelive.molive.lua.LuaViewLiveActivity
description: This Momo Live SDK screen hosts pages supplied at runtime for the live area. The page shown depends on what the user opens.
disableEffect: Live-area pages that use this screen will not open.

name: com.immomo.molive.hello.modulelive.molive.ui.search.MoliveSearchActivity

name: com.immomo.molive.hello.modulelive.molive.ui.search.MoliveSearchTagActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot open the tag or recent-host results page.

name: com.immomo.molive.hello.modulelive.molive.webview.activity.MomoMKWebActivity

disableEffect: Web pages that use this screen will not open or complete their in-page flows.

name: com.immomo.molive.hello.modulelive.molive.webview.activity.WebviewActivity

disableEffect: Web pages and deep links routed to this screen cannot be opened.

name: com.immomo.molive.personal.ProfileUserActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot edit these profile details through this flow.

name: com.immomo.molive.personal.TestActivity
description: This Momo Live SDK test screen displays a simple sample greeting. It has no account or live controls.
disableEffect: Disabling it only removes the sample greeting screen.

name: com.immomo.molive.social.radio.foundation.screenrecoder.CaptureScreenService

disableEffect: Live sessions that share the screen cannot keep screen capture running through this service.

name: com.immomo.molive.teenager.TeenagerActivity

disableEffect: The video screen used by that flow will not open.

name: com.immomo.momo.luaview.LuaViewActivity

disableEffect: Dynamically supplied SDK pages that use this screen cannot be shown.

name: com.immomo.momo.luaview.LuaViewNearbyLivelActivity

disableEffect: Nearby-live pages that use this screen will not open.

name: com.immomo.plugin.sample.runtime.PluginDefaultProxyActivity

disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

name: com.immomo.plugin.sample.runtime.PluginSingleInstance1ProxyActivity
description: When the MOMO plugin SDK opens a page loaded at runtime, this Activity provides a screen slot for that plugin page.
disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

name: com.immomo.plugin.sample.runtime.PluginSingleTask1ProxyActivity
description: When the MOMO plugin SDK opens a page loaded at runtime, this Activity provides a screen slot for that plugin page.
disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

name: com.immomo.plugin.sample.runtime.PluginSingleTop1ProxyActivity
description: When the MOMO plugin SDK opens a page loaded at runtime, this Activity provides a screen slot for that plugin page.
disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

name: com.imojiapp.imoji.sdk.ui.ImojiCreateService

name: com.incentive.common.CPIAliveActivity

name: com.incentive.cpi.receiver.CPIReceiver

name: com.incentive.download.service.DownloadService

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.IncodeFileProvider

disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent result files from opening or being shared from the verification flow.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.IncodeWelcomeInitProvider

disableEffect: Disabling it skips SDK initialization, so identity verification may fail before its first screen opens.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.commons.VideoUploadJobService

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents required video evidence from uploading, so a video-based verification cannot finish.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.commons.video_upload.VideoUploadJobService
description: Android starts this background service when MetaMap schedules video upload or cleanup; it sends recorded verification videos to MetaMap.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents required video evidence from uploading, so a video-based verification cannot finish.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.h
description: The MetaMap identity verification SDK shows this brief transition screen while moving between verification steps.
disableEffect: Disabling it can stop a configured verification flow while it is moving to the next screen.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.o
description: The MetaMap identity verification SDK shows this brief transition screen while moving between verification steps.
disableEffect: Disabling it can stop a configured verification flow while it is moving to the next screen.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.accept_video_selfie.AcceptVideoSelfieActivity
description: When a configured verification flow requires a video selfie, this screen explains the recording step and asks the user to accept it before recording begins. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from accepting the video-selfie step when the flow requires one.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.aes.AESActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing document-signing flows that require it.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.antifraud.AntifraudActivity
description: The MetaMap SDK opens this screen for an anti-fraud check selected by the verification flow and presents the check's progress or outcome.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent a verification that requires the anti-fraud check from continuing.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.approve.ApproveActivity
description: This screen confirms the selfie or face-approval step when a MetaMap verification flow requests it, and displays the resulting approval state.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the user from completing a flow that requires this approval step.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.bio_consent.BiometricConsentActivity
description: Before a verification flow captures a face or other biometric information, this screen asks the user to review and provide biometric consent. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from giving the required biometric consent, so that verification flow cannot proceed.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.id_validation.DocumentValidationActivity
description: When the flow asks for an identity document, this screen opens the camera to capture the document image and check the scan. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing document capture when this screen is selected.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.id_validation.ProcessIdActivity
description: After an identity document is captured, this screen processes the selected document type and advances the user through the document-review step. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the configured document-verification flow from processing the captured ID.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.id_validation.ReferredToExecutiveActivity
description: This screen shows the identity-document scan summary, including whether the front or back image passed or failed, and offers the next step. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing and continuing from the document-scan outcome when this step is required.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.id_validation.ValidationActivity
description: When selected by the verification flow, this screen opens a full-screen camera for an identity-document or age-assurance scan and checks the captured image. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the configured camera-based identity check from completing.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.qr_code.QRCodeScanActivity
description: When a verification step requires a QR code, this screen uses the camera to scan it and return the result to the flow. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification steps that require a QR-code scan.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.qr_code.QRCodeScanTipsActivity
description: Before the QR-code camera opens, this screen explains how to position and scan the code. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the QR-scan path from showing its required instructions and may interrupt that path.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.review_photo.ReviewPhotoActivity
description: After a document photo is taken, this screen lets the user inspect it and choose to scan again or continue. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the photo-review choice, preventing the user from confirming or retaking a required document image.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.selfie.SelfieActivity
description: When the flow requests a selfie, this screen uses the front camera to capture the user's face and gives guidance when the face image needs another try. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents selfie-based identity checks from collecting the required face image.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.video_selfie.VideoSelfieActivity
description: When a flow requests a video selfie, this screen records the user on camera and uploads the recording for verification. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents video-selfie verification from recording and submitting the required video.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.video_selfie.video_selfie_checks.VideoSelfieChecksActivity
description: Before video recording, this screen lists the checks the user must complete, such as showing an ID, looking at the camera, and speaking a prompt. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from seeing and completing the required video-selfie instructions.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.captcha.CaptchaActivity
description: When the verification service requests a code challenge, this screen shows the code and accepts the user's answer, with an option to try again if it is incorrect. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification flows that require this challenge.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.combined_consent.CombinedConsentActivity
description: When a flow requests combined consent, this screen displays the supplied consent text and records the user's choice. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the user from giving or declining the consent required by that verification flow.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.curp_validation.CurpValidationActivity
description: This screen collects or generates the user's CURP identifier and submits it for validation during identity verification. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing a verification flow that requires CURP validation.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.custom_watchlist.CustomWatchlistActivity
description: When the flow includes a custom-watchlist check, this screen submits the user's information and shows the check's progress and result. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents identity checks that rely on the configured custom watchlist from completing.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.delayed_onboarding.DelayedOnboardingIntroActivity
description: When the MetaMap flow defers onboarding, this screen introduces the later verification step to the user.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching the deferred-onboarding introduction when the flow uses it.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.document_scan.SelectDocumentSourceActivity
description: When identity documents are needed, this screen lets the user choose how to provide the requested document and whether to show the scan tutorial. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from selecting a document path required by the verification flow.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.dynamic_forms.DynamicFormsActivity
description: When the verification flow supplies a dynamic form, this screen displays its requested fields and collects the user's answers. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from submitting information required by a flow that uses dynamic forms.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.ekyb.EKYBActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents business-verification flows from collecting and submitting the required details.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.ekyc.EKYCActivity
description: When a flow verifies an individual, this screen collects personal details such as name, date of birth, contact information, and tax ID, then submits them for checking. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents individual-verification flows from collecting and submitting the required details.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.email_address.EmailAddressActivity
description: When email verification is part of the flow, this screen collects the user's email address and can verify it with a code sent by email. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing required email collection or email-code verification.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.geolocation.GeolocationActivity
description: When location is required for verification, this screen requests location access and guides the user through providing it. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents verification flows that require the user's location from completing.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.global_watchlist.GlobalWatchlistActivity
description: When the flow includes a global-watchlist check, this screen collects identifying details such as name, birth date, and country, then shows the screening result. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification flows that require global-watchlist screening.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.government_validation.GovernmentValidationActivity
description: When the flow checks a user's identity against government data, this screen presents the check and whether the submitted face matches the government record. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from seeing or completing a required government identity check.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.id_capture.IdCaptureActivity
description: When a configured identity scan begins, this screen requests camera permission and guides the user into document capture. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.id_info.IdInfoActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing or correcting document details required for verification.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.intro.IntroActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from starting flows that require this introduction screen.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.ml_consent.MachineLearningConsentActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from responding to the machine-learning consent required by that flow.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.name.NameActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from submitting a required name in flows that use this step.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.phone_number.PhoneNumberActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing required phone collection or SMS-code verification.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.process_id.ProcessIdV2Activity

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.qes.QESActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the qualified-signature step in flows that require it.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.results.ResultsActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from seeing the final verification result or opening its result document.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.selfie_result.FaceMatchActivity
description: When a flow checks a selfie against the face on an identity document, this screen presents the face-match step and its outcome. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing flows that require this face comparison.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.selfie_scan.SelfieScanActivity
description: When a flow requests a selfie scan, this screen guides and captures the user's face according to the supplied scan instructions. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from submitting a selfie scan required by the verification flow.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.signature_form.SignatureFormActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing document-signing flows that require this signature.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tax_id_validation.TaxIdValidationActivity
description: When a flow needs a tax identifier, this screen collects the user's tax ID and submits it for validation. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing flows that require tax-ID validation.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tutorial.IDTypeChooserActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from selecting a document type when the configured flow uses this choice.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tutorial.TutorialBackActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching the back-side capture step when this tutorial is required.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tutorial.TutorialDocumentScanActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching document capture when this tutorial is required.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tutorial.TutorialFrontActivity

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tutorial.TutorialPassportActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching passport capture when this tutorial is required.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tutorial.TutorialSelfieActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching selfie capture when this tutorial is required.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.tutorial.TutorialSelfieV2Activity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching selfie capture when this version of the tutorial is required.

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.user_consent.UserConsentActivity

name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.video_conference.VideoConferenceActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it breaks phone verification and account phone-binding changes.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHCertificateFinishActivity
description: After xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk real-name verification succeeds, this screen confirms that the identity check is complete.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the verification flow from opening its completion screen and may interrupt that account-verification task.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHCertificateNoActivity
description: When a player starts real-name verification from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center or account web page, this screen collects and submits the identity details.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the SDK's real-name verification flow.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHChLanVerifyActivity
description: During xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account sign-in or registration, this page loads a web verification challenge and returns its result to the account flow.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the SDK from completing account verification and signing in.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHChangePasswordActivity
description: When a player changes an xgvlsdk XiGuSdk account password from the account center, this screen validates the change and asks the user to sign in again after success.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the password-change flow and can prevent account security updates.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHChooseAccountActivity
description: After xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk signs in to an account with linked game subaccounts, this screen lets the player choose or add the account to use.
disableEffect: Disabling it can block account selection or adding a subaccount during sign-in.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHCommunicateActivity
description: When a player opens the community-contact tab in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk help area, this screen opens the SDK's QQ customer-support chat.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes this QQ support shortcut; the game's other screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHControlResActivity
description: After WeChat or QQ returns an authorization result to xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk, this transparent screen passes the result back to the account flow and closes.
disableEffect: Disabling it can break third-party sign-in callbacks and leave WeChat or QQ login unfinished.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHCouponAllActivity
description: When a player opens the coupon area in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk or switches to the full coupon list, this screen displays available coupons for the account.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes coupon browsing and can interrupt coupon selection during checkout.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHCouponMyActivity
description: During xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk checkout, this screen lists the player's coupons and returns the chosen coupon and discount to the payment screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it breaks coupon selection in the SDK payment flow.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHDiscountRebateActivity
description: When a player opens the rebate entry in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen loads the account's rebate information as a web page.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to the SDK rebate page and its discount information.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHForgetPasswordActivity
description: When a player chooses forgot password from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk sign-in screen, this page handles account recovery through verification.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from recovering an account through the SDK's password-reset flow.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHFunctionPopActivity
description: When a player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk functions menu, this screen provides shortcuts to account, gift, coupon, welfare, support, and purchase-history pages.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK shortcut menu and can hide access to account, coupon, and payment-related pages.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHGameRecordActivity
description: When an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens the recharge-history page, this screen loads and lists past top-ups for the signed-in game account.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to the account's recharge history.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHGiftDetActivity
description: When a player selects a package in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk gift center, this screen loads its details, validity, instructions, and claim information.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents players from viewing or claiming the selected SDK gift package.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHListViewActivity
description: When a player opens the common-questions tab in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk help area, this screen lists answers and support contacts.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes this SDK FAQ list and its support links; other game screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHManagementAccountActivity
description: When a player opens account management in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen manages the linked game accounts.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from managing or switching linked game accounts.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHMoneyRecordActivity
description: After a player opens transaction history from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk platform-credit payment screen, this page lists the account's credit records.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes transaction-history access for the SDK credit balance.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHMsgActivity
description: When a player opens the activities and messages entry in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk menu, this screen fetches notices; selecting one opens its details.
disableEffect: Disabling it hides the SDK activity and message list, while the game's other screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHMsgDetActivity
description: When a player selects an item from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk notice list, this screen loads the selected notice as a web page.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening notice details; the game's other screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHNoticeDialogActivity
description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk presents a notice, this dialog displays its title and content and lets the player move between notices.
disableEffect: Disabling it hides these SDK popup notices; the game's other screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHPacksActivity
description: When a player opens the gift center in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk menu, this screen fetches regular and VIP gift packages; selecting one opens its details.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK gift center and prevents access to its package details.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHPayActivity
description: When the host game starts a purchase through xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk, this screen presents payment choices and returns the payment result to the game.
disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the SDK checkout flow and can prevent in-game purchases.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHPayPTBActivity
description: When a player chooses XiGuSdk platform-credit payment, this screen handles the purchase and can open web checkout or the credit transaction history.
disableEffect: Disabling it can break platform-credit purchases and their payment result flow.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHPayRecordActivity
description: When a player opens game bills from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk menu, this screen loads the account's purchase records.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to in-game purchase history and billing details.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHShareActivity
description: When a player opens sharing from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen lets them choose to share with a WeChat friend or to Moments.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK share chooser and can break the app's share flow.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHSocialActivity
description: When an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens its social and help area, this screen presents tabs for common questions and community messages.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK FAQ and community area; gameplay and account screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHThirdLoginActivity
description: During xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk WeChat sign-in, this screen sends the authorization request to WeChat and returns control to the account flow.
disableEffect: Disabling it can break WeChat account sign-in.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHTransparencyActivity
description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens account sign-in over the game, this transparent screen hosts the login and registration dialog.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the SDK login dialog from opening or closing cleanly, breaking sign-in and registration.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHUserCenterActivity
description: When a signed-in player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen shows account details and links to balance, password, phone, email, and identity settings.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK account center and can block account-management and security tasks.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHVisitorUpdateInfo
description: When a guest player upgrades an xgvlsdk XiGuSdk account, this screen collects the details needed to bind the guest profile to a permanent account.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent guest-account upgrades and account binding.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHWapPayActivity
description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk checkout uses a web payment page or a payment-provider redirect, this screen loads the page and opens payment links.
disableEffect: Disabling it can break web-based checkout and external payment handoffs.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHWeChatShareActivity
description: After a player chooses a WeChat destination in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk share screen, this screen sends the configured webpage to a friend or Moments.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the SDK from completing WeChat shares.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHWebviewActivity
description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens an account or service web page, this screen loads it and routes phone, email, or identity links to the matching account screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it can break SDK web pages and account-verification or binding flows.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHWelfareActivity
description: When a player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk welfare page, this screen displays its check-in and ad-related welfare entries.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK welfare page and its listed reward entries.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHelperCenter
description: When a player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk customer-service center, this screen shows the available chat, QQ group, phone, and email contacts.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK customer-service contact page; gameplay and account screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.MCHelperDetActivity
description: When a player selects a help topic in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk support area, this screen displays the selected answer.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents access to SDK help-topic details; gameplay and account screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.activity.WXEntryActivity
description: When WeChat returns to an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk after sign-in or sharing, this callback screen reads the result and returns authorization data to the SDK.
disableEffect: Disabling it can break WeChat sign-in and sharing callbacks.

name: com.mchsdk.paysdk.utils.MCHLolly
description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk diagnostic controls request it, this service displays a movable log viewer with filtering and save controls.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes this optional diagnostic panel and log saving; ordinary game and account screens remain available.

name: com.mchsdk.plugin.qg.utils.UpVersionDialog
description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk updater finds a newer SDK version, this dialog shows its version, download size, and change notes with update choices.
disableEffect: Disabling it can block the SDK update prompt and leave a required update flow unavailable.

name: com.mchsdk.plugin.vip.activity.MCHGradeActivity
description: When an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens its VIP-level page, this screen shows the current and next membership levels and their benefits.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK VIP-level and benefits page.

name: com.mda.coordinatetracker.CoordinateService
description: When the app requests its current location, an address lookup, or ongoing tracking, Android Coordinate Tracker runs the request and returns the result to the app.
disableEffect: The app loses the location lookups and tracking provided by this library.

name: com.mdsoftware.trackingsystemsdk.data.TSContentProvider

disableEffect: The SDK's local tracking store and user-identifier persistence stop working, while the host app's main features remain available.

name: com.me.autosize.InitProvider
description: osarms AutoSize initializes the app's screen-size adaptation at startup so layouts use the app's chosen design size.
disableEffect: Screens that rely on AutoSize may have incorrect sizing or spacing.

name: com.mechdome.aboutmechdome.AboutMechDomeActivity
description: When a user opens the MechDome About screen, this Activity displays MechDome information, an ad, and controls to buy or restore the ad-free option.
disableEffect: The MechDome About screen, its ad-free purchase, and its purchase-restore controls cannot be opened.

name: com.mechdome.aboutmechdome.DonateMechDomeActivity
description: When a user opens the MechDome donation screen, this Activity shows donation choices and the button that starts the selected donation purchase.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the MechDome donation page or start a donation purchase.

name: com.medallia.digital.mobilesdk.MedalliaFullFormActivity
description: When the Medallia Digital SDK opens a full-screen feedback survey, this Activity hosts the form and its back controls.
disableEffect: The full-screen survey cannot be shown or submitted, so the app’s Medallia feedback flow may fail.

name: com.medallia.digital.mobilesdk.MedalliaModalFormActivity
description: When the Medallia Digital SDK opens a survey configured as modal, this Activity hosts the form in a compact layout with a close control.
disableEffect: The modal survey cannot be shown or submitted, so the app’s Medallia feedback flow may fail.

name: com.media.PictureFileProvider
description: photo_select_lib (Roofroot) registers a file-sharing provider for the photo-selection flow, exposing configured image files as content links when the app requests them.
disableEffect: Photo capture, editing, or sharing steps that need image links from this provider can fail.

name: com.mediapicker.library.activities.MediaPickerActivity
description: Pardeep MG MediaPicker opens this Activity when an app requests media selection; users can browse photos and videos or use its camera-only photo and video options.
disableEffect: The app loses this media-selection and camera-capture flow.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.agrement.AgreementActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE opens this page when a user chooses the agreement link during face verification. It displays the supplied agreement page inside the app and provides refresh and back controls.
disableEffect: Users cannot review the FaceEE agreement from the face-verification flow.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.auth.AuthManagementActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE shows the user's enrolled sign-in methods and available face, device-biometric, and one-time-code enrollment options. Users can change their default method here.
disableEffect: Users cannot manage the FaceEE sign-in methods used by the app's authentication flow.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.auth.FastPassNotSupportActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE uses this screen to report when the device cannot use its quick device-authentication sign-in option. Closing it returns an unsupported result to the calling flow.
disableEffect: The FaceEE flow cannot show its unsupported-device message or return the expected result.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.auth.RegisterFastPassAfterVerifyActivity
description: After the user verifies their account, Face++ FaceEE offers to enroll the phone's biometric or device credential for quicker future sign-in. It reports whether setup succeeds or fails.
disableEffect: Users cannot enroll or activate this FaceEE quick sign-in option on the device.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.login.LoginLoadingActivity
description: When Face++ FaceEE receives a sign-in or registration response, this screen processes it and moves the user to available credential setup or a success or failure page.
disableEffect: The FaceEE sign-in or registration flow may stop before it returns to the app.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.otp.FaceEEOfflineOTPActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE displays a time-limited offline sign-in code generated from a key retrieved earlier, together with the linked device name and expiry time.
disableEffect: Users who sign in with FaceEE offline codes lose access to this code screen.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.otp.FaceEEOtpActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE requests a one-time sign-in code, shows its countdown, and lets users request an offline code for their enrolled device.
disableEffect: FaceEE one-time-code sign-in and access to the offline-code flow are unavailable.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.qrcode.VerifyActivity
description: During Face++ FaceEE sign-in or credential activation, this screen presents the available face, device-biometric, and one-time-code checks and continues the selected verification.
disableEffect: The app cannot finish the FaceEE verification or credential activation that opens this screen.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.register.RegisterActivity
description: When Face++ FaceEE asks a user to verify or enroll sign-in credentials, this screen starts face verification or device-authentication setup and can open the related agreement page.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete the FaceEE verification and credential-setup choices offered here.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.register.RegisterVerifyTypeActivity
description: After Face++ FaceEE registration, this screen shows the available face and device-authentication options, the current one-time-code status, and a way to skip setup.
disableEffect: Users cannot continue FaceEE registration through credential setup or skip this step.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.result.ResultFailedActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE shows this screen after a failed sign-in or verification. It displays the error and offers the relevant retry, return, or credential-management action.
disableEffect: Users lose the explanation and recovery actions for a failed FaceEE flow.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.result.ResultSuccessActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE shows this screen after sign-in, registration, or credential setup succeeds, then sends the user to any remaining setup or back to the app.
disableEffect: A successful FaceEE flow cannot show its completion or continue to the next setup step.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.view.RegisterVerifyLoadingActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE displays progress while checking a registration or credential-verification result. It then returns the result to the calling screen or opens the appropriate success or failure page.
disableEffect: FaceEE cannot finish or return the registration-verification result.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.view.VerifyLoadingActivity
description: Face++ FaceEE displays progress while checking a sign-in verification result, then returns the result or opens a success or failure page.
disableEffect: FaceEE cannot finish the sign-in verification that uses this screen.

name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.zxinglibrary.android.QrCodeScanActivity
description: During Face++ FaceEE QR sign-in, this Activity uses the camera or a selected image to read a code, checks it with FaceEE, and opens the next verification screen.
disableEffect: FaceEE QR-code sign-in cannot scan the code or continue to verification.

name: com.megvii.lv5.sdk.detect.action.ActionLivenessActivity

disableEffect: Face-based identity verification may fail because this action check cannot be completed.

name: com.megvii.lv5.sdk.detect.color.FlashLivenessActivity
description: Megvii's v5 liveness screen opens the camera and uses changing light or color cues while it checks the user's face.
disableEffect: Face-based identity verification that uses this light-assisted check cannot be completed.

name: com.megvii.lv5.sdk.detect.guide.GrantActivity
description: Before a Megvii face-liveness check, this screen displays guidance and requires agreement to the liveness terms before opening the selected camera check.
