name: com.megvii.lv5.sdk.detect.guide.UserAgreementActivity
description: During Megvii face verification, this Activity opens the applicable liveness agreement in a web page; the user can read it and close the page to return.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the liveness agreement from this verification flow.

name: com.megvii.meglive_sdk.detect.action.ActionLivenessActivity
description: When Megvii's face-verification flow selects an action challenge, this screen uses the camera to guide and check the user's face movements.
disableEffect: The Megvii action-based face check will fail to open, so verification using this challenge may not complete.

name: com.megvii.meglive_sdk.detect.agreement.UserAgreementActivity
description: When the user opens the agreement from Megvii's liveness guide, this screen displays the face-check terms in a web page.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to review the terms required by the Megvii face-verification flow.

name: com.megvii.meglive_sdk.detect.color.FmpColorfulActivity

name: com.megvii.meglive_sdk.detect.fmp.FmpLivenessActivity

name: com.megvii.meglive_sdk.detect.guide.GrantActivity
description: Before Megvii face detection, this screen presents the liveness instructions and agreement option, then starts the selected camera check when the user continues.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to accept the face-check terms or enter Megvii's liveness verification.

name: com.meili.moon.sdk.permission.internal.PermissionActivity

disableEffect: Moon permission requests and recovery after denial will stop working; app features that need those permissions may fail.

name: com.meiqia.core.MQInitializeContentProvider

name: com.meiqia.core.MeiQiaService

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQCollectInfoActivity

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQConversationActivity

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQInquiryFormActivity

disableEffect: The Meiqia routing menu cannot open, so users may not reach the support team selected by the app.

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQMessageFormActivity

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQPhotoPickerPreviewActivity

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQPhotoPreviewActivity

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQWebViewActivity

name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.util.MQFileProvider

name: com.meizu.cloud.pushsdk.SystemReceiver

disableEffect: The Meizu push channel may no longer register or receive messages.

name: com.meizu.customizecenter.frame.activity.CustomizeCenterActivity

disableEffect: The app icon disappears from the launcher.

name: com.meizu.flyme.appcenter.activitys.SplashAdActivity
description: Splash screen advertisement shown when the app starts.

name: com.melegy.linkester.DeepLinksTestActivity

name: com.melegy.redscreenofdeath.internal.RedScreenOfDeathActivity

name: com.memfault.bort.reporting.MetricsInitProvider
description: At app startup, the Memfault Bort reporting SDK gives its metrics service the app context needed to report metrics and events.
disableEffect: Memfault Bort metric and event reporting will not be initialized.

name: com.mercadopago.CardVaultActivity

name: com.mercadopago.CheckoutActivity

name: com.mercadopago.CongratsActivity

name: com.mercadopago.CustomerCardsActivity

name: com.mercadopago.DiscountsActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot open or save chat images through the image viewer.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.chatkit.ui.page.WatchVideoActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit plays a video message when a user opens it from a chat or search result. The viewer also offers a save action.
disableEffect: Users cannot play or save chat videos through this viewer.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.ui.activities.BrowseActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK opens this screen when the app shows a web page in its in-app browser. It provides a title bar and back navigation, and sends other kinds of links to an app that can open them.
disableEffect: Web pages that rely on the Yunxin in-app browser will not open.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.ui.photo.TransferHelperActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK starts this Activity when it opens the camera or image picker, or shows an Android permission prompt. These actions are used by its photo capture, image selection, and cropping features.
disableEffect: Photo capture, image selection, and Yunxin permission requests that use this Activity will not complete.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.ui.photo.crop.CropImageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK opens this portrait screen when a photo needs to be selected or cropped. The user can adjust the crop and save the resulting image for the app to use.
disableEffect: Photo flows that require Yunxin cropping will not return a cropped image, so uploads that depend on that result can fail.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.utils.CommonFileProvider
description: NetEase Yunxin's shared IM library turns a local chat file into a link that app screens can open or share. ChatKit and QChat use it for images, videos, and other message attachments.
disableEffect: Sending, opening, or sharing local chat attachments may fail because the app cannot create the file links it expects.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.addfriend.FunAddFriendActivity
description: When a user opens Add Friend and looks up an account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK finds that person and opens their profile so the user can decide whether to add them.
disableEffect: Users can no longer look up an account or open its profile through ContactKit's Add Friend flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.ai.FunAIUserListActivity
description: When a user opens the AI user list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the app's available AI accounts and lets the user open an account's profile.
disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit screen for browsing AI accounts and opening their profiles.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.blacklist.FunBlackListActivity
description: When a user opens the blocked-people list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows blocked contacts and lets the user remove someone from the list.
disableEffect: Users can no longer review or unblock contacts through ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.contact.FunContactActivity
description: When a user opens Contacts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the friend list, shows online status, and provides contact-related shortcuts.
disableEffect: Users can no longer open the ContactKit contact list or its related shortcuts.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.robot.FunRobotBindActivity
description: When the app opens its AI-account binding screen, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists available AI accounts and binds the selected account; the screen can also lead to account creation.
disableEffect: Users can no longer bind an AI account through ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.robot.FunRobotCreateActivity
description: When a user chooses to create an AI account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK accepts a name and avatar and submits the new account; a binding flow can continue afterward.
disableEffect: Users can no longer create an AI account from the ContactKit screens.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.robot.FunRobotEditActivity
description: When a user edits an existing AI account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them change its name or avatar and save the updated profile.
disableEffect: Users can no longer update an AI account's name or avatar through ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.robot.FunRobotEditNameActivity
description: When a user taps an AI account's name while creating or editing it, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK opens a page to change that name and return it to the previous screen.
disableEffect: Users can no longer enter or change an AI account's name in the create and edit flows.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.robot.FunRobotInfoActivity
description: When a user opens an AI account from the list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows its profile and offers actions to chat, edit it, view its connection details, refresh its credential, or delete it.
disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit page for viewing and managing an AI account.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.robot.FunRobotListActivity
description: When a user opens the AI-account list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the accounts and lets the user open details or start creating an account.
disableEffect: Users can no longer browse AI accounts or open the ContactKit creation flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.robot.FunRobotViewConfigActivity
description: When a user chooses to view an AI account's connection details, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK displays a copyable setup string and hides part of it on screen.
disableEffect: Users can no longer view or copy the AI account's setup string through ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.search.FunSearchActivity
description: When a user enters a keyword in ContactKit search, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK searches friends and teams or groups, then opens a selected result.
disableEffect: Users can no longer search for friends or teams through ContactKit's search screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.selector.FunContactSelectorActivity
description: When an app feature asks the user to choose contacts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows the friend list and returns the selected people to that feature.
disableEffect: Features that rely on this picker can no longer receive selected contacts from ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.selector.ai.FunAIContactSelectorActivity
description: When an app feature asks the user to choose people or AI accounts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows friend and AI-account tabs and returns the selection.
disableEffect: Features that rely on this picker can no longer receive the selected people or AI accounts.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.selector.forward.FunForwardSelectorActivity
description: When a user chooses recipients for a forwarding action, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them select recent conversations, friends, or teams and returns the chosen destinations.
disableEffect: Users can no longer choose forwarding destinations through ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.team.FunTeamListActivity
description: When a user opens the team list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the teams and lets the user open a team or select one for another app feature.
disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit screen for browsing or selecting teams.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.team.FunTeamProfileActivity
description: When a user opens a team's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows its name, introduction, ID, and owner; it offers chat for a team the user can enter or a request to join when needed.
disableEffect: Users can no longer view team details, open its chat, or request to join through this ContactKit page.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.team.FunTeamSearchActivity
description: When a user searches for a team by its ID, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK looks it up and opens its profile when found.
disableEffect: Users can no longer look up a team by ID through ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.userinfo.FunCommentActivity
description: When a user edits a contact's note from that person's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them change the name shown for that contact and returns the result.
disableEffect: Users can no longer change a contact's note through the ContactKit profile page.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.userinfo.FunUserInfoActivity
description: When a user opens a person's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads contact or AI-account details and offers actions such as chatting, adding a friend, blocking, or removing a friend.
disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit page for viewing a person's details and using its contact actions.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.verify.FunContactVerifyActivity
description: When a user opens contact requests, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows friend requests and team-join requests so they can review and respond to them.
disableEffect: Users can no longer review and respond to friend or team requests through this ContactKit page.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.verify.FunFriendVerifyActivity
description: When a user opens friend requests, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists incoming friend applications and lets the user accept or reject them.
disableEffect: Users can no longer review or respond to friend applications through ContactKit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.verify.FunVerifyListActivity
description: When a user opens verification messages in the older ContactKit UI, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists friend applications and team invitations or join requests, with accept, reject, and clear-all actions.
disableEffect: Users can no longer review, respond to, or clear ContactKit friend and team verification messages.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.local.ui.fun.page.FunLocalConversationActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin IM Local Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled inbox, where users scan recent chats and open a conversation.
disableEffect: Users cannot open this version of the local conversation inbox.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.local.ui.normal.page.LocalConversationActivity
description: When users open the local inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Local Conversation Kit shows recent conversations and lets them continue into a chat.
disableEffect: Users cannot open this local conversation list or continue to chats from it.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.fun.page.FunConversationActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled inbox, where users scan recent chats and open a conversation.
disableEffect: Users cannot open this version of the conversation inbox.

description: When users add chats to a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled picker for choosing recent conversations.
disableEffect: Users cannot add conversations to a group through this screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.fun.page.FunConversationGroupManageActivity
description: When users organize the inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled page for creating, showing, hiding, and reordering conversation groups.
disableEffect: Users cannot manage conversation groups from this version of the inbox.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.fun.page.FunConversationGroupSettingActivity
description: When users edit a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled settings page for renaming it, adding or removing chats, or deleting it.
disableEffect: Users cannot change or delete a conversation group through this screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.normal.page.ConversationActivity
description: When users open the inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit shows recent conversations and lets them continue into a chat.
disableEffect: Users cannot open this conversation list or continue to chats from it.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.normal.page.ConversationSelectActivity
description: When an app flow asks users to choose conversations, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit displays a selectable list and returns their choices to that flow.
disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to let users choose conversations for the current flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.page.ConversationGroupAddConversationActivity
description: When users add chats to a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens a picker for choosing recent conversations to include.
disableEffect: Users cannot add conversations to a group through this screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.page.ConversationGroupManageActivity
description: When users organize the inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens a page for creating, showing, hiding, and reordering conversation groups.
disableEffect: Users cannot organize or change the visibility of conversation groups from the inbox.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.page.ConversationGroupNameActivity
description: When users create a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens a form for entering its name.
disableEffect: Users cannot create a named conversation group through this screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.conversationkit.ui.page.ConversationGroupSettingActivity
description: When users edit a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens settings for renaming it, adding or removing chats, or deleting it.
disableEffect: Users cannot change or delete a conversation group through this screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.corekit.startup.InitializationProvider
description: NetEase Yunxin CoreKit runs this provider when the app starts to find declared Yunxin startup entries and initialize their kits. The analyzed manifests attach ChatKit, AI Search, ContactKit, and ConversationKit services to this startup process.
disableEffect: The declared Yunxin kits may not initialize when the app starts, so their chat, contact, conversation, or AI search features can fail.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.locationkit.LocationPageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin IM Location Kit opens a map where users can search for and select a place to send in chat, or view a location already shared in a message.
disableEffect: Users cannot select, send, or view shared locations through the chat location screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.login.CommonBrowseActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens this in-app browser to load the URL supplied by a login flow, with back navigation through the page history.
disableEffect: Login or account pages that use this embedded browser cannot open.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.login.EmailRegisterActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens the email-registration form for users creating an account with an email address.
disableEffect: Users cannot register by email through this login kit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.login.EntranceActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin Login shows its sign-in and registration entry screen when the login-home route is opened.
disableEffect: Users cannot enter the login or registration flow through this screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.login.ForgetPasswordActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens its password-recovery form when the email password-reset route is requested.
disableEffect: Users cannot recover an account password through this reset screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.login.LoginActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens the configured phone, email, or phone-area sign-in flow when the app requests login.
disableEffect: The login screen cannot open, preventing sign-in through this kit.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.login.area.AreaCodeActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin Login shows available phone calling codes and returns the selected code to phone sign-in.
disableEffect: Users cannot choose a phone calling code for phone sign-in.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.meeting.ui.NEChatroomHistoryMessageActivity
description: When the app opens a meeting's chat history, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays earlier messages from that meeting room.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting chat history screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.meeting.ui.NEFeedbackActivity
description: When the app requests the meeting feedback page, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays a form for users to send feedback.
disableEffect: Users cannot submit meeting feedback through the SDK's feedback page.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.meeting.ui.NEMeetingActivity
description: When users start or return to an active meeting, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays the meeting and its call controls; the screen can shrink into picture-in-picture.
disableEffect: Users cannot enter or return to the meeting screen, so the app's meeting feature stops working.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.meeting.ui.NEMeetingRealtimeRecorderActivity
description: After users start the NetEase Meeting real-time recording feature, this screen opens for that meeting's recorder session.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting's real-time recorder screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.meeting.ui.NEWebAppActivity
description: When users open a meeting web app, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays the selected web app within the meeting experience.
disableEffect: Users cannot open meeting web apps through the SDK.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.announce.ManagerEditActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a server owner selects an announcement manager. It lets the owner change that person's permissions to post, edit the announcement channel, delete messages, manage members, and use emoji, or remove the person.
disableEffect: The server owner cannot change or remove individual announcement managers through the built-in QChat screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.announce.ManagerListActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this list from announcement settings. The server owner can add announcement managers, inspect a manager's permissions, or remove a manager.
disableEffect: The server owner cannot manage the announcement manager list through the built-in QChat screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.announce.ServerMemberListActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from announcement settings to list members of the announcement server. Users with permission can invite or remove members and open a member's profile.
disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage announcement server members through the built-in QChat screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.announce.SettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from an announcement conversation's settings entry. It shows announcement server settings and lets users copy its sharing information, change the icon or emoji access, edit its name or topic, manage members and managers, and leave or dismiss the server.
disableEffect: Users lose the built-in controls for managing announcement settings and for leaving or dismissing the announcement server.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.announce.UpdateInfoActivity

disableEffect: Permitted users cannot edit the announcement server name or topic through the built-in QChat screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.QChatChannelTypeSelectActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot choose a channel's visibility in the built-in QChat channel creation flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.add.QChatChannelAddMemberActivity

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.add.QChatChannelAddRoleActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot add server roles to a QChat channel through the built-in permission flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.blackwhite.QChatBlackWhiteActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot change the channel's member allow or block list through the built-in QChat screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.permission.QChatChannelPermissionActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from channel settings to show the members and roles with channel access. Users can add or remove them and open their channel permission settings.
disableEffect: Users cannot manage member and role access to a QChat channel through the built-in permission screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.permission.QChatMemberPermissionActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits an individual's access to a channel. It controls whether that member can send messages, manage the channel or roles, and manage the channel's member lists.
disableEffect: Users cannot change an individual's QChat channel permissions through the built-in screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.permission.QChatRolePermissionActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits a role's access to a channel. It lets the user set which channel actions members with that role may perform.
disableEffect: Users cannot change a role's QChat channel permissions through the built-in screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.setting.ChannelSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel's settings entry. It lets users edit the channel name or topic, manage channel permissions and member allow/block lists, or delete the channel.
disableEffect: Users cannot use the built-in QChat screen to configure or delete the channel.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.common.WatchImageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user taps an image in a QChat message. It displays a larger preview of that image.
disableEffect: Users cannot open this single-image preview from a QChat message.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.common.photo.crop.CropImageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen after a user chooses a photo for a QChat server or announcement icon. It provides a square crop and returns the cropped image for upload.
disableEffect: Users cannot crop a selected photo before setting a QChat server or announcement icon.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.image.QChatWatchImageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from message media viewing to browse attached images in a swipeable gallery. Users can save the currently displayed image to the device.
disableEffect: Users cannot browse or save images through the built-in QChat message gallery.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.message.ChannelMemberActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel conversation's member entry. It lists channel members, lets users open member profiles, and provides a route to channel settings.
disableEffect: Users cannot view a QChat channel's member list through the built-in screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.message.ChannelMessageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user selects a QChat channel. It displays that channel's conversation and message history, with header entries for its members or announcement settings.
disableEffect: Users cannot open QChat channel conversations through the built-in QChat UI.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.message.QChatChannelMessageActivity
description: In NetEase Yunxin QChat UI versions that declare this screen, selecting a channel opens its conversation. The page displays channel messages and provides a side panel with members and their profiles.
disableEffect: Apps using these QChat UI versions cannot open the built-in channel conversation screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatCreateBySelfActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this form when a user chooses to create a QChat server or announcement server. The user enters a name and selects an icon; the SDK creates the server and its initial channel.
disableEffect: Users cannot create a QChat server or announcement server through the built-in flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatCreateWayActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this chooser when a user starts a server setup flow. It offers creating a server or joining an existing one, including the corresponding announcement-server choices.
disableEffect: Users cannot start the built-in QChat server creation or joining flow from this chooser.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatJoinOtherServerActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen in the join-server flow. A user enters a server ID, sees the matching server, and can join it or follow the announcement-server join flow.
disableEffect: Users cannot look up and join an existing QChat server through the built-in flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatMemberSelectorActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a server or channel workflow needs users selected from the server's members. The selection is used for tasks such as assigning role members, adding channel members, or choosing announcement managers.
disableEffect: Users cannot select server members for these built-in QChat management flows.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatRoleCreateActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user creates a server role. The user enters a role name and can select members to assign to the new role.
disableEffect: Users cannot create server roles through the built-in QChat role flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatRoleListActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from server settings to list server roles. Users with permission can create a role, edit one, or change role order.
disableEffect: Users cannot manage server roles through the built-in QChat role list.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatRoleMemberActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a server role's settings. It lists members assigned to that role and lets an authorized user add or remove members.
disableEffect: Users cannot view or change membership for a QChat server role through the built-in screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatRoleSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits a server role. It lets the user rename the role, change its permissions, and open its member list.
disableEffect: Users cannot edit a QChat server role's name or permissions through the built-in screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatRoleSortActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen to arrange server roles by priority. A permitted user can reorder the roles or delete one.
disableEffect: Users cannot reorder or delete server roles through the built-in QChat screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatServerMemberInfoActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user selects a server member. It shows the member's profile and roles; authorized users can edit a nickname, change role membership, or remove the member from the server.
disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage a selected member's server details through the built-in QChat screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatServerMemberListActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from server settings to browse server members. The screen can invite members, load their roles, and open an individual member's details.
disableEffect: Users cannot browse or manage server membership through the built-in QChat member list.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatServerSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen for server settings. Users can change the server name, topic, or icon; open member and role management; and, when allowed, leave or delete the server.
disableEffect: Users cannot configure the QChat server or reach its built-in member and role management from this screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.searchkit.ui.page.GlobalSearchActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin Search UI SDK opens this screen from its global-search route. As the user types, it searches friends, groups, and teams; tapping a result opens the matching profile or conversation.
disableEffect: Users cannot use the built-in global search to find friends, groups, or teams.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.smslogin.CommonBrowseActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this in-app browser for links configured on its login and registration screens, such as terms or privacy pages. It displays web pages inside the app and hands non-web links to another app when available.
disableEffect: Users cannot open configured terms, privacy, or other login-screen links through this in-app browser.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.smslogin.ForgetPasswordActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this screen from the login page's password-recovery option. It requests and verifies an SMS code, collects a replacement password, and submits the recovery details through the configured callback.
disableEffect: Users cannot reset a forgotten password through the built-in SMS login flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.smslogin.LoginActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this screen when the app starts its login flow. Users can sign in with a phone verification code or a password, and move to registration or password recovery.
disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through the app's built-in SMS Login screens.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.smslogin.RegisterActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this screen when a user chooses registration from login. It collects a phone number, verification code, and password, verifies the code, and submits the registration details through the configured callback.
disableEffect: Users cannot create an account through the built-in SMS registration flow.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.smslogin.country.CountryCodeActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this indexed list from the SMS-code login form. It displays available country and region dialing codes for the user to select.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the country and region dialing-code list from SMS-code login.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamInfoActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens a team information page where users can view its name, picture, and introduction and open the editors for those details.
disableEffect: Users cannot view a team’s basic details in this page or open its detail editors from here.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamManagerActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens team-management controls for who may invite members or edit team details, group-join approval, and member mention or pin permissions; it also opens the manager list.
disableEffect: Owners and managers lose this page’s controls for team permissions, joining rules, and managers.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamManagerListActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lists a team’s administrators; the owner can select members to add or remove administrators.
disableEffect: The team’s administrator list cannot be opened or edited here.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamMemberListActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity shows the people in a team and lets users search the member list.
disableEffect: Users cannot open or search the team member list here.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamMemberSelectActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets a team owner search the team roster and select members to add as administrators.
disableEffect: The owner cannot use this TeamKit screen to select new administrators.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens a team chat’s settings page, with controls for chat notices, muting and pinning, team details, members, and manager settings. Owners can also leave or dismiss the team from the available controls.
disableEffect: Users lose this page’s team-chat settings and its shortcuts to member, manager, and team details.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamUpdateIconActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets an authorized team member choose a new group picture from the available images or a photo and save it.
disableEffect: Users cannot change the team picture through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamUpdateIntroduceActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot change the team introduction through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamUpdateNameActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets an authorized team member change and save the team’s name.
disableEffect: Users cannot change the team’s name through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.fun.activity.FunTeamUpdateNicknameActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets a member change and save their own nickname for this team.
disableEffect: Members cannot change their team nickname through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamInfoActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens a team information page where users can view its name, picture, and introduction and open the editors for those details.
disableEffect: Users cannot view a team’s basic details in this page or open its detail editors from here.

disableEffect: Owners and managers lose this page’s controls for team permissions, joining rules, and managers.

disableEffect: The team’s administrator list cannot be opened or edited here.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamMemberListActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot open or search the team member list here.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamMemberSelectActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets a team owner search the team roster and select members to add as administrators.
disableEffect: The owner cannot use this TeamKit screen to select new administrators.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens a team chat’s settings page, with controls for chat notices, muting and pinning, team details, members, and manager settings. Owners can also leave or dismiss the team from the available controls.
disableEffect: Users lose this page’s team-chat settings and its shortcuts to member, manager, and team details.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamUpdateIconActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets an authorized team member choose a new group picture from the available images or a photo and save it.
disableEffect: Users cannot change the team picture through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamUpdateIntroduceActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets an authorized team member edit and save the team’s introduction.
disableEffect: Users cannot change the team introduction through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamUpdateNameActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets an authorized team member change and save the team’s name.
disableEffect: Users cannot change the team’s name through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamUpdateNicknameActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets a member change and save their own nickname for this team.
disableEffect: Members cannot change their team nickname through this editor.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.nertcvideocall.service.NotificationBroadcastReceiver
description: NetEase Yunxin CallKit uses this Receiver when an incoming-call notification is dismissed, then rejects the invitation associated with that call.
disableEffect: Dismissing an incoming-call notification may leave its call invitation active.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.pstn.ui.PstnP2PCallAudioActivity
description: During a NetEase Yunxin PSTN one-to-one audio call, this Activity opens the call screen and lets the user answer, reject, mute, switch speaker, or hang up.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from opening or answering PSTN audio calls.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.base.TransferHelperActivity
description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit requests camera or microphone access, or asks the user to confirm a call-type change from the floating call window, this temporary Activity runs the request and returns its result.
disableEffect: Permission requests or audio/video call-type changes may fail because their results cannot return to the call screen.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.group.GroupCallActivity
description: When a user starts or joins a NetEase Yunxin CallKit group call, this Activity opens the group-call screen and provides participant, audio, and video controls.
disableEffect: The SDK cannot open this group-call screen, so starting or joining group calls may fail.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.p2p.P2PCallActivity
description: When a user starts or answers a NetEase Yunxin CallKit one-to-one voice or video call, this Activity shows the call screen and its answer, reject, mute, camera, speaker, and hang-up controls.
disableEffect: One-to-one calls routed to this screen may not open, preventing users from placing or answering them.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.p2p.P2PCallFragmentActivity
description: When the app routes a NetEase Yunxin CallKit one-to-one call to this Activity, it displays the incoming, outgoing, or active voice and video call screen.
disableEffect: Calls routed to this screen may not open, preventing users from placing or answering them.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.permission.PermissionActivity
description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit requests runtime permissions, this Activity explains why access is needed, displays the system permission prompt, and returns the result to the calling screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from requesting microphone or camera access needed for calls.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.service.AudioCallForegroundService
description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit keeps an audio call running outside the visible call screen, this Service posts a foreground notification so the conversation can continue while the app is in the background.
disableEffect: Audio calls may be interrupted when the user leaves the call screen or locks the phone.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.service.CallForegroundService
description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit background-call support is enabled during an active call, this Service displays an ongoing notification and keeps the call running while the app is not visible.
disableEffect: The SDK may be unable to keep audio or video calls running after the user leaves the app.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.service.VideoCallForegroundService
description: When a NetEase Yunxin CallKit video call continues outside the visible call screen, this Service posts a foreground notification for the camera and microphone.
disableEffect: Video calls may lose camera or microphone use when the user leaves the app.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.service.foregroundservice.AudioForegroundService
description: When a NetEase Yunxin CallKit audio session needs to continue in the background, this Service posts a notification and keeps microphone use in the foreground.
disableEffect: Audio sessions that rely on this service may be interrupted when the app is no longer visible.

name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.service.foregroundservice.VideoForegroundService
description: When a NetEase Yunxin CallKit video session needs to continue in the background, this Service posts a notification and keeps camera and microphone use in the foreground.
disableEffect: Video sessions that rely on this service may lose camera or microphone use when the app is no longer visible.

name: com.netease.yunxin.vce.ui.NEVCEActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin VCE opens this full-screen Activity for a requested call and presents its in-app calling screen.
disableEffect: The app cannot open the VCE calling screen to start or handle a call.

name: com.netposa.commonsdk.core.ContextProviderInitializer
description: At app startup, this Netposa CommonSDK provider prepares shared SDK components by giving them access to the app information they need to run.
disableEffect: Without this setup, Netposa components that later need the app information may fail when they run.

name: com.netposa.component.location.service.AMapLocationService
description: When the app requests AMap location through Netposa's location SDK, this service collects a high-accuracy location and address and sends the result back to the app.
disableEffect: AMap-based location results will stop, which can break app screens or tasks that rely on that location source.

name: com.netposa.component.location.service.GpsLocationService
description: When the app requests GPS location through Netposa's location SDK, this service watches for GPS changes and location fixes, then sends coordinates and an address back to the app.
disableEffect: The app will lose this GPS location source, which can break location-based screens or tasks.

name: com.netposa.component.mqtt.service.MqttPushService
description: When Netposa MQTT messaging starts, this service connects or reconnects to the configured server, listens to the app's configured topics, and passes new messages into the app.
disableEffect: Incoming MQTT messages and updates delivered through this Netposa service will stop.

name: com.neura.android.authentication.PushRequestJobService
description: The Neura Android SDK runs this job for a queued push request and sends it to Neura, reporting whether it succeeded.
disableEffect: Queued Neura push requests will not be sent by this background job.

name: com.neura.android.authentication.PushRequestReceiver
description: When a retry alarm for a Neura Android SDK push request fires, this receiver submits the request again.
disableEffect: Failed Neura push requests will no longer be retried.

name: com.neura.android.bt.BluetoothStateReceiver
description: When enabled, it reacts to Bluetooth adapter and device connection changes and records the connected device for the Neura Android SDK.
disableEffect: Neura will stop recording Bluetooth connection changes and device details.

name: com.neura.android.coordinate.CoordinatorJob
description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to start or stop its background coordination work.
disableEffect: Neura's scheduled background coordination will stop.

name: com.neura.android.coordinate.CoordinatorService
description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service, it starts or stops the SDK's background coordination work.
disableEffect: Neura's background coordination will not run through this service.

name: com.neura.android.database.provider.NeuraContentProvider
description: This Neura Android SDK provider initializes native SDK support and opens its local database at app startup; SDK code also uses it to read and write stored records.
disableEffect: Neura initialization or database access may fail, breaking app features that rely on the SDK.

name: com.neura.android.receiver.DeviceStateMonitorReceiver
description: When enabled, it handles startup, app updates, battery, airplane mode, location, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth changes to refresh the Neura Android SDK's data collection and device-state records.
disableEffect: Neura's device-state updates and recovery after restarts may stop.

name: com.neura.android.receiver.NeuraReceiver
description: The Neura Android SDK routes account authentication, logout, data-sync, and notification-action broadcasts through this receiver; it can open the dialer or messaging app for a Neura person notification.
disableEffect: Neura sign-in updates, data synchronization, and actions on its notifications may stop working.

name: com.neura.android.receiver.RunningModeBroadcastReceiver
description: When the Neura Android SDK broadcasts a running-mode change, this receiver forwards the start or stop value to a background service or scheduled job.
disableEffect: Neura will stop recording changes to its running mode.

name: com.neura.android.receiver.ScanRequestReceiver
description: It responds to Neura Android SDK Bluetooth or Wi-Fi scan requests and starts the matching device scan.
disableEffect: Neura will stop collecting nearby Bluetooth and Wi-Fi scan data.

name: com.neura.android.service.CommandJob
description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to process a queued server command and pass it to the SDK command handler.
disableEffect: Queued Neura background commands will not run through this job.

name: com.neura.android.service.CommandService
description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a command, it processes the command and dispatches the requested SDK action.
disableEffect: Neura background commands will not run through this service.

name: com.neura.android.service.DataSyncJobService
description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to upload queued data, using a regular or overnight sync window.
disableEffect: Neura data may remain unsent.

name: com.neura.android.service.DeviceIdleService
description: When started, it watches doze, power-saving, and boot changes so the Neura Android SDK can update its idle-state records.
disableEffect: Neura will stop recording device idle and power-saving changes.

name: com.neura.android.service.GeofenceIntentService
description: When Google Play services reports a Neura geofence exit or dwell, this service asks the Neura Android SDK to process and sync the event.
disableEffect: Neura will stop responding to those geofence events.

name: com.neura.android.service.InternetConnectivityService
description: When enabled and started, it registers for network changes so the Neura Android SDK can detect restored connectivity, resume queued work, and record Wi-Fi details.
disableEffect: Neura's network monitoring and background work may not resume when connectivity returns.

name: com.neura.android.service.KeepAliveSyncIntentService
description: After Neura Android SDK background work starts this service, it checks collection services and restarts coordination when needed.
disableEffect: Neura's background collection may lose its recovery path and scheduled-job cleanup.

name: com.neura.android.service.NetworkDiscoverIntentService
description: The Neura Android SDK runs this scan only while connected to Wi-Fi and charging, then waits for the network-discovery scan to finish.
disableEffect: Neura will no longer perform this charging-time Wi-Fi discovery.

name: com.neura.android.service.NetworkDiscoverJobService
description: A scheduled Neura Android SDK job starts nearby Wi-Fi network discovery and finishes when the scan-complete broadcast arrives.
disableEffect: Neura will no longer run this scheduled network discovery.

name: com.neura.android.service.RunningModeJob
description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to record whether its running mode has started or stopped.
disableEffect: Neura will stop recording running-mode changes from scheduled jobs.

name: com.neura.android.service.RunningModeService
description: When started with a Neura Android SDK running-mode change, this service records whether the mode started or stopped.
disableEffect: Neura will stop recording running-mode changes handled by this service.

name: com.neura.android.service.ScanJobService
description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to scan available device data and completes it after the scan finishes.
disableEffect: Neura's scheduled device-data scans will stop.

name: com.neura.android.service.ScanService
description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a scan request, it runs the scan on a background worker and stops when scanning finishes.
disableEffect: Neura's requested background scans will stop.

name: com.neura.android.service.StateAlertJob
description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to pass a permission or sensor state alert to its alert handler.
disableEffect: Neura state-alert requests will not be processed, and existing alerts may not be removed when requested.

name: com.neura.android.service.StateAlertService
description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a state alert, it passes the alert details to the SDK alert handler.
disableEffect: Neura state-alert requests will not be processed, and existing alerts may not be removed when requested.

name: com.neura.android.service.StepDetectionService
description: The Neura Android SDK uses this service to read the phone's step sensor, store step totals, and switch to its custom detector when needed.
disableEffect: Neura step counts and activity insights will stop updating.

name: com.neura.android.service.StopCustomStepDetectorServiceWithWakeLock
description: After its scheduled timeout, this Neura Android SDK job asks the custom step detector to stop.
disableEffect: Neura's scheduled stop for its custom step detector will no longer run.

name: com.neura.android.service.SyncJobService
description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to collect device-state and diagnostic data, then sync queued monitoring and command data.
disableEffect: Neura's scheduled background synchronization and device-state reports will stop.

name: com.neura.android.service.SyncRawDataService
description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service for a data sync, it uploads queued SDK data.
disableEffect: Neura's queued data will not be synchronized by this service.

name: com.neura.android.service.SyncSecondaryCollectionsIntentService
description: During a scheduled Neura Android SDK sync, this service uploads diagnostic logs, device-state records, and general commands.
disableEffect: Those Neura records and commands may remain unsent.

name: com.neura.android.service.location.LocationHandlerJob
description: The Neura Android SDK runs this job for a location update, records the location, and may sync it based on the update source.
disableEffect: Neura location updates and related insights may stop.

name: com.neura.android.service.location.LocationHandlerService
description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a location update, it records the location and may request a sync based on its source.
disableEffect: Neura location updates and related insights may stop.

name: com.neura.android.service.stepdetection.CustomStepDetectorServiceWithWakelock

name: com.rokid.glass.kaleido.service.KaleidoWindowService
description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK exposes this service in its AR process for apps that request a separate glasses window. It manages the extra display where an app appears and routes input to that display.
disableEffect: Apps using Rokid Kaleido lose their separate glasses windows and the input controls directed to them.

name: com.rokid.glass.kaleido.ui.BlackDummyActivity
description: If a Rokid Kaleido integration opens this activity, it shows a black screen on the extra glasses display while the related app is paused and closes when that app resumes.
disableEffect: The generic black pause screen is unavailable, while Kaleido’s landscape and portrait pause screens remain available.

name: com.rokid.glass.kaleido.ui.BlackDummyLandscapeActivity
description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK opens this landscape black screen on the extra glasses display while a shown app is paused; it closes when that app resumes.
disableEffect: Kaleido cannot cover a paused landscape app window with its black screen during display switching.

name: com.rokid.glass.kaleido.ui.BlackDummyPortraitActivity
description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK opens this portrait black screen on the extra glasses display while a shown app is paused; it closes when that app resumes.
disableEffect: Kaleido cannot cover a paused portrait app window with its black screen during display switching.

name: com.rokid.glass.kaleido.ui.DummyActivity
description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK opens this activity to launch an app on a separate glasses display and keep that app window in step with the display’s pause and resume state.
disableEffect: Apps using Rokid Kaleido cannot open or manage their screens on the extra glasses display.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.answer.AnswerActivity
description: When a Rokid glasses meeting invitation arrives, this screen shows the incoming call and lets the user answer or decline.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to answer or decline incoming glasses meetings through this screen.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.answer.RKReceiveCallService
description: This background service listens for incoming Rokid glasses meeting invitations and starts the incoming-call flow.
disableEffect: Incoming glasses meetings may not be monitored or presented to the user.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.call.CallingActivity
description: When users start a glasses collaboration call, this screen contacts the selected participants and shows the outgoing-call state.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to place Rokid glasses collaboration calls through this screen.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.chat.ChatActivity
description: During a glasses meeting, this screen displays the conversation and lets participants use meeting chat.
disableEffect: Participants will not be able to open the glasses meeting chat.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.document.DocumentListActivity
description: When users open shared documents during a glasses meeting, this screen lists available files and opens a selected document.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or select meeting documents here.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.document.DocumentShowActivity
description: When a document is selected for a glasses meeting, this screen displays it for the participants and supports session navigation controls.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to display or navigate shared documents in the meeting.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.menu.BackMenuActivity
description: When users open the glasses meeting’s back menu, this screen handles device commands for leaving the session and returning to the home screen.
disableEffect: The meeting’s back-menu and device-command exit flow will not be available.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.menu.MenuActivity
description: During a glasses meeting, this menu provides access to screen sharing, chat, documents, and meeting audio and video controls.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the glasses meeting menu or its sharing controls.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.room.CameraDetailActivity
description: When a participant’s camera is opened in a glasses meeting, this screen shows the live view and provides remote camera, pointing, annotation, and document controls.
disableEffect: The participant’s detailed camera session and its collaboration controls will not open.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.room.RoomActivity
description: This is the main glasses collaboration screen, showing the live meeting and controls for participants, chat, documents, screen sharing, and spatial collaboration.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or operate the main glasses meeting screen.

name: com.rokid.glass.luban.slam.SlamActivity
description: During an augmented-reality glasses session, this screen displays the camera scene and shared spatial marks for remote collaboration.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the augmented-reality glasses collaboration view.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.CallingActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this incoming-call screen when another participant calls. It lets the user accept with audio or video, or reject the call, and opens the meeting after a successful join.
disableEffect: Incoming calls have no screen for accepting or rejecting them, so users cannot join calls from the app.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.CameraDetailActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page when a participant's camera is selected in a meeting. It shows that participant's video and provides camera controls, shared annotations, and document upload for the call.
disableEffect: Users cannot open a participant's camera detail page or use its camera, annotation, and document-sharing controls.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ConferenceMainActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this screen after a user joins a meeting. It shows the participants and meeting status, provides call controls, and opens screen sharing, whiteboard, or camera views.
disableEffect: Users cannot enter or stay in the meeting screen, so Rokid Remote Cooperation calls and meetings are unusable.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ConferenceSettingActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this pre-meeting screen when the user creates or joins a meeting. It lets the user check the camera, microphone, and speaker before starting or joining the call.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete the create-or-join setup, so they may be unable to start or join a meeting.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ConferenceSlamActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this camera-based augmented-reality view when spatial marking starts during a meeting. Participants can place, undo, or clear marks in the shared scene.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the shared augmented-reality scene or place spatial marks during a meeting.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ContactActivity
description: After login, Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this directory with separate group and contact tabs. It also provides access to the user's account page and saved meeting entry points.
disableEffect: Users cannot browse the Remote Cooperation groups and contacts or reach its account and meeting entry points.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ContactDetailActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this profile when a user selects someone from a contact or group list. It shows the person's account and availability details and can start a meeting with an available contact.
disableEffect: Users cannot view contact details or start a meeting from a person's profile.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.DoodleShareActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this shared whiteboard during a meeting. Participants can draw, clear marks, and view a shared snapshot while their whiteboard changes are sent to the meeting.
disableEffect: Users cannot start or view the shared whiteboard and its meeting annotations.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.GroupMemberActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page from a group entry to show the group's members. Users can open a member's details or start a meeting with available group members.
disableEffect: Users cannot view the group roster or start a meeting from the group page.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.InviteContactActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this picker from an active meeting so the user can select contacts who are not already in the meeting and invite them to join.
disableEffect: Users cannot select and invite additional contacts to an ongoing meeting.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.LoginActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this sign-in screen to collect the company, account, and password details needed to authenticate the user. On successful login it opens the contacts page.
disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to Remote Cooperation, so its contacts, calls, and meetings cannot be used.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ModifyPwdActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this screen from the account menu when the user chooses to change their password. It checks the entered passwords and submits the change to the account service.
disableEffect: Users cannot change their Remote Cooperation password from the app.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.PersonalCenterActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this account center from its contact page. It shows company and account details and provides password, logout, binding-QR, and meeting-resolution settings.
disableEffect: Users cannot reach the Remote Cooperation account details, password and logout controls, binding QR code, or resolution settings.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.RenewRemindActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this reminder when the company account has expired or is within 14 days of expiry. It shows the expiry date and links to the account center.
disableEffect: Users no longer see this expiry reminder or its shortcut to the account center.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ScreenShareActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page when a meeting participant starts sharing a screen. It shows the shared screen and manages starting, stopping, or switching the share.
disableEffect: Users cannot start or view screen sharing during a Remote Cooperation meeting.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.service.InConferenceService
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this service while a meeting is active to listen for live meeting messages. It syncs the current whiteboard state for a new participant and rejects another incoming call while the user is already in a meeting.
disableEffect: Late participants may not receive the current whiteboard state, and incoming meeting requests may not be handled correctly.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.service.RKHeartbeatService
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this foreground service to keep its account presence current during background use. It sends periodic heartbeat updates and displays an ongoing Remote Cooperation notification.
disableEffect: Remote Cooperation stops sending these background heartbeat updates and no longer shows its ongoing status notification.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.service.ReceiveCallMessageService
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this service for a signed-in account to listen for call and logout messages. It opens the incoming-call screen for a new call and returns to sign-in after a logout.
disableEffect: Incoming calls and logout messages can no longer open their required screens, disrupting the Remote Cooperation call and account flows.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.utils.AliveJobService
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this background keep-alive service to schedule a short job and show an ongoing meeting notification.
disableEffect: Remote Cooperation loses this background keep-alive job and its ongoing meeting notification.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.utils.qrcode.ConferenceShareActivity
description: When the user shares a meeting invitation QR code, Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page and Android's share chooser to send the QR image to another app.
disableEffect: Users cannot send the meeting QR image to another app from this sharing flow.

name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.utils.qrcode.google.zxing.activity.CaptureActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this QR scanner when the app asks the user to scan a code. It reads a code from the camera or a selected album image and returns the decoded text to the app.
disableEffect: Workflows that require scanning a QR code cannot be completed in the app.

name: com.rokid.glass.ui.autosize.InitProvider

disableEffect: Glass UI layouts that rely on this startup scaling may no longer fit the display correctly.

name: com.rokid.meeting.xpert.sdk.server.RKMeetCoreProvider
description: Rokid Xpert Meeting creates this provider automatically during app startup to register its meeting engine, meeting, device, and contact services.
disableEffect: The meeting SDK cannot register these services, so its meeting, device, and contact functions cannot be initialized.

name: com.rokid.mobile.air.web.AirWebActivity

disableEffect: The app’s Rokid web pages will not open, and renewal payments requested from those pages may fail.

name: com.rokid.mobile.media.videoplay.VideoPlayActivity

disableEffect: Video previews that use this player will not open or play, and its sharing option will be unavailable.

name: com.rokid.mobile.media.videoplay.VideoPlayerV2Activity
description: Older Rokid Media versions open this screen for a video playback request. It can play a local file or an online video and can provide sharing when requested.
disableEffect: Older apps that still use this player will not be able to open its video playback screen.

name: com.rokid.mobile.share.ui.ShareEntryActivity
description: Rokid Share opens this screen when the app starts a share request or a share link is opened. It presents sharing options for images, videos, and web pages.
disableEffect: The app’s Rokid sharing screen will not open, so users may be unable to share these items through its share flow.

name: com.rokid.mobile.share.ui.provider.RokidShareProvider
description: Rokid Share uses this provider to expose local images and videos as shareable files, so the selected content can be read during a share.
disableEffect: Sharing local images or videos through Rokid Share may fail when the receiving app needs to read the file.

name: com.rokid.rkfilereader.activity.AudioActivity

disableEffect: Audio files opened through Rokid File Reader can no longer be played in this page.

name: com.rokid.rkfilereader.activity.PdfActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot view or navigate PDF files through Rokid File Reader.

name: com.rokid.rkfilereader.activity.PhotoActivity

disableEffect: Users cannot view image files through Rokid File Reader.

name: com.rokid.rkfilereader.activity.VideoActivity
description: Rokid File Reader opens a video file in this page and starts playback. Voice controls can pause, resume, fast-forward, or rewind the video.
disableEffect: Users cannot play video files through Rokid File Reader.

name: com.rokid.rokit.kit.core.UniversalActivity

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.H5Activity

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.LoadActivity

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.ProcessH5Activity

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.ProcessSceneActivity

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.ProcessSceneH5Activity

disableEffect: AR scenes that use this web content will not open.

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.ProcessWebARH5Activity

disableEffect: Web-based AR experiences assigned to this helper process will not work.

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.SceneActivity

disableEffect: The app’s Rokid AR scenes and their recording, sharing, or linked web features will not work.

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.SceneH5Activity

disableEffect: AR scenes that rely on this web page will not work.

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.WebARH5Activity
description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK opens web-based AR content in a WebView and can grant the page camera or microphone access.
disableEffect: The app’s web-based AR content will not open.

name: com.rokid.sdk.tatooine.lite.tool.LiteFileProvider

name: com.rokid.security.glass3.qrcode.ui.GlassScanActivity

name: com.rokid.security.phone.sdk.bridge.activity.classicbt.ui.BluetoothNoFindActivity

name: com.rokid.sprite.aiapp.ugc.ui.everyonetalking.EveryoneTalkingActivity

name: com.rokid.sprite.aiapp.ugc.ui.official.OfficialConfigActivity

name: com.rokid.sprite.aiapp.ugc.ui.publish.PublishPostActivity

name: com.rokid.sprite.aiapp.ugc.ui.thumbnail.VideoThumbnailSelectorActivity

name: com.rokid.uxr.screenprojection.service.LocalService

name: com.rokid.uxrunityplugin.ForegroundService

name: com.rokid.webrtc.RKMediaProjectionActivity

disableEffect: Screen sharing cannot start without the Android screen-capture permission flow.

name: com.rokid.webrtc.RKMediaProjectionService
description: This foreground service runs while the meeting shares the screen so Android can keep the screen-capture session active.
disableEffect: The meeting cannot start or maintain its screen-capture session.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.chat.ChatActivity
description: RongCloud Global IM UIKit opens this screen for a selected one-to-one or group conversation. It shows the conversation's messages and chat controls.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to open conversations through RongCloud Global IM UIKit.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.chatlist.ChatListActivity

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.camera.CameraActivity

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.core.context.ContextContentProvider

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.picture.PicturePreviewActivity

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.picture.PictureSelectorActivity

disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse and choose local photos or videos to send from this picker.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.picture.PictureVideoPlayActivity
description: RongCloud Global IM UIKit opens this screen to play a local video selected from the media picker. Playback starts when the screen opens and includes standard playback controls.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview local videos in the media picker.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.preview.FilePreviewActivity

disableEffect: Users will lose the in-app download and preview flow for chat file attachments.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.preview.GifPreviewActivity
description: When a user opens a GIF message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen downloads the image if needed and displays it animated.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open and view animated GIF messages in this screen.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.preview.ImagePreviewActivity
description: When a user opens an image message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen loads the full image from local or remote storage for viewing and saving.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open full-size image messages in the UIKit viewer.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.preview.VideoPreviewActivity
description: When a user opens a short video message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen starts the clip in the message viewer.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to play short video messages in the UIKit viewer.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.preview.combineV1.CombineWebViewActivity
description: When a user opens a combined chat message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen displays its content in a web view and can open attached media such as short videos.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the older combined-message viewer or its attached media.

name: com.rongcloud.im.uikit.internal.preview.combineV2.CombinePreviewActivity
description: When a user taps a newer combined-message item in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen displays the included conversation content.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open newer combined-message details.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.client.permission.RequestHealthConnectPermissionsActivity

disableEffect: The app will not be able to request the Health Connect access needed for its Rook health-data features.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.client.permission.RequestReadPermissionsActivity
description: The Rook SDK requests permission to read selected health data from Health Connect.
disableEffect: Rook health-data reading will not be able to obtain the required permissions.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.client.permission.RequestWritePermissionsActivity
description: The Rook SDK requests permission to write selected health data to Health Connect.
disableEffect: Rook will not be able to obtain permission to write the selected health data.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.framework.broadcastreceiver.RookBroadcastReceiver
description: The Rook SDK receives device-boot and app-replacement broadcasts and restarts background health syncing or step counting when the app has enabled them.
disableEffect: Enabled Rook background health syncing and step counting may not resume after a device restart or app replacement.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.framework.broadcastreceiver.StepsCounterAlarmReceiver

disableEffect: Rook’s scheduled step counting may stop or become less reliable.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.framework.broadcastreceiver.WatchdogAlarmReceiver
description: The Rook SDK watchdog alarm restarts background health syncing or step counting when those features are enabled.
disableEffect: Enabled Rook background syncing or step counting may not recover when its scheduled check runs.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.framework.healthconnect.permissions.RequestHealthConnectPermissionsActivity
description: The Rook SDK opens Health Connect permissions for health-data access and background reading, then reports the permission result to the app.
disableEffect: Rook health-data access and background reading will not be able to obtain or report the required permissions.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.framework.permission.RequestAndroidPermissionsActivity

disableEffect: The app’s Rook features will not be able to request or receive the required Android permissions.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.framework.service.StepsCounterService

disableEffect: Rook step counts will stop updating through this service.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.framework.service.StepsService

disableEffect: Rook will stop collecting step-detection events and recording their times.

name: com.rookmotion.rook.sdk.ui.datasources.DataSourcesActivity

disableEffect: Users will lose the Rook screen for viewing and connecting health-data sources.
