description: When a user opens Smartsupp ChatBox, this Activity displays the chat screen and handles file selection for message attachments.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app's embedded support conversation cannot open or attach files.

name: com.smh_digitalassistant_library.activities.MedicActivity
description: SmH Digital Assistant opens this Activity for a medical professional’s workspace, with screens for patients, tasks, patient registration, and individual patient details.
disableEffect: The app’s medical-staff patient and task workflows are unavailable.

name: com.smh_digitalassistant_library.activities.PatientActivity
description: SmH Digital Assistant opens this Activity for a patient workspace with chat, daily tasks, calendar, and health-registration screens.
disableEffect: The app’s patient chat, task, calendar, and registration flows are unavailable.

name: com.smh_medicaldevicescan_library.CameraActivity
description: SmH Medical Device Scan opens this camera Activity to read measurements from a supported health device’s display. It recognizes the reading and returns its values and image to the app screen that started the scan.
disableEffect: The app cannot scan a device display or receive the measurement from this flow.

name: com.smh_medicaldevicescan_library.CameraAssistantActivity
description: SmH Medical Device Scan opens this guided camera Activity to recognize measurements shown on a supported health device. It displays the detected reading and lets the user capture it for the app screen that started the scan.
disableEffect: The guided device-scan result cannot be reviewed or returned to the app.

name: com.smileid.smileidui.SIDIDCaptureActivity
description: During Smile ID verification, this screen uses the camera to capture the front and, when requested, the back of an identity document, then returns the result to the verification flow.
disableEffect: If disabled, identity checks that need an ID image cannot continue.

name: com.smileid.smileidui.SIDReviewActivity
description: After Smile ID captures a selfie, this screen shows the image and lets the user confirm it or retake it.
disableEffect: If disabled, the user cannot review and confirm the selfie, so that verification step cannot finish.

name: com.smileid.smileidui.SIDSelfieCaptureActivity
description: During Smile ID verification, this screen guides automatic selfie capture, then opens the captured image for review.
disableEffect: If disabled, the selfie capture and review flow cannot be completed.

name: com.smileidentity.libsmileid.core.consent.ConsentActivity
description: Before an identity check proceeds, Smile Identity shows the partner's consent explanation, the categories of information involved, and a privacy link here, then records whether the user accepts or cancels.
disableEffect: If disabled, the user cannot respond to this consent request, and the identity-check flow may not proceed.

name: com.smileidentity.libsmileid.core.consent.bvn.ui.activities.ConsentBVNContactMethodActivity
description: During Smile Identity's Nigerian BVN consent flow, this screen shows the contact methods offered for the entered number and sends the selected method to the verification service before OTP confirmation.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot choose where to receive a code, so BVN consent cannot continue.

name: com.smileidentity.libsmileid.core.consent.bvn.ui.activities.ConsentBVNNumberActivity
description: During Smile Identity's Nigerian BVN consent flow, this screen asks for an 11-digit BVN number and starts the consent check.
disableEffect: If disabled, the BVN consent check cannot start from this screen.

name: com.smileidentity.libsmileid.core.consent.bvn.ui.activities.ConsentOTPVerificationActivity
description: After a code is sent to the selected BVN contact, this Smile Identity screen accepts the code, can request another one, and confirms the consent step.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot verify the code, so BVN consent cannot be completed.

name: com.smileidentity.libsmileid.core.services.NetworkService
description: When Smile Identity has verification requests waiting in its upload queue, this retry service submits them when the phone has a connection and schedules another check while upload files remain.
disableEffect: If disabled, delayed identity submissions may remain pending because this retry path cannot send them.

name: com.smileidentity.libsmileid.core.services.UploadLaterJobService
description: When Android runs a scheduled Smile Identity upload job, this service sends saved verification requests if the phone is online and schedules another attempt while files remain.
disableEffect: If disabled, verification uploads waiting for a connection may remain pending.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.X7Provider
description: The X7SY 小7SDK (X7SDK) starts this provider with the app to initialize its interface and permission support and prepare web content storage for other parts of the app. X7 sign-in and plugin pages use this setup.
disableEffect: X7 login, permission prompts or plugin screens may fail to initialize.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.activity.UploadErrorLogActivity
description: When the app requests an X7SY 小7SDK error-log export, this Activity packages crash logs and the NetEase IM log into a file and returns it to the requesting screen.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to export these SDK diagnostic logs through this screen.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.activity.WakeUpActivity
description: The X7SY 小7SDK exposes this Activity for wake-up links; it opens briefly and closes immediately when Android routes a link to it.
disableEffect: Links that use this wake-up entry point may no longer open the app.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.activity.WakeUpCoreProcessActivity
description: The X7SY 小7SDK briefly opens this transparent Activity as a wake-up step for background plugin tasks. It shows an empty screen and closes immediately.
disableEffect: X7SDK flows that rely on this wake-up step may fail to start their plugin work.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.app.manager.MainPluginProcessService
description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this service to show pages and run tasks supplied by plugins loaded while the app is running.
disableEffect: X7 plugin pages or tasks that need this runtime process will not start.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.app.manager.MainPluginServiceProcessService
description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this service for background work supplied by its plugins. It checks that the main part of the app is still running before continuing.
disableEffect: X7 plugin background services that rely on this process may not run.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.login.AuthorizedLoginActivity
description: The X7SY 小7SDK opens this transparent Activity when the app requests sign-in, then returns saved login details or a token to the app.
disableEffect: X7 sign-in requests that use this handoff may fail, leaving the user unable to log in through the SDK.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.plugin.X7SpeedUpProvider
description: At app startup, the X7SY 小7SDK checks whether its game speed-up feature is supported, retrieves the matching settings, and prepares the on-screen speed controls.
disableEffect: X7 game speed-up controls will not initialize in apps that rely on them.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.plugin.translator.X7TranslatorProvider
description: At app startup, the X7SY 小7SDK checks for supported game translation data, downloads text or image translation updates, and prepares its translation features.
disableEffect: Game text or image translation provided by X7SDK will be unavailable.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.x7_plugin_runtime.PluginDefaultProxyActivity
description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this Activity to show pages supplied by plugins when the app opens them. These pages are loaded while the app is running.
disableEffect: X7 plugins that use this Activity slot will be unable to open their pages.

name: com.smwl.smsdk.x7_plugin_runtime.PluginPortraitProxyActivity
description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this Activity to show plugin pages that need portrait orientation. These pages are loaded while the app is running.
disableEffect: X7 plugins that use this portrait Activity slot will be unable to open their pages.

name: com.snail.antifake.jni.EmulatorCheckService
description: The MyEmulator and antifake libraries provide a background check that reports whether the device looks like an emulator when the host app requests it.
disableEffect: The host app can no longer receive an emulator-status result through this service.

name: com.snail.collie.battery.BatteryLevelReceiver
description: When Collie by Happylishang receives a battery-change broadcast through this receiver, it stores the battery level, maximum level, voltage, and whether the device is charging.
disableEffect: Collie's battery-reading helper stops receiving these updates; normal app screens keep working.

name: com.snail.collie.startup.HelpService
description: Collie by Happylishang declares a short-lived helper service that stops itself as soon as it starts and shows no screen.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents this brief helper from starting; its code has no user-facing task.

name: com.snail.collie.startup.LauncherHelpProvider
description: Collie by Happylishang creates this provider as the app process starts and records the start time used by its battery statistics.
disableEffect: Collie's early timing measurement is lost, so its battery statistics may be inaccurate while normal app features keep working.

name: com.snap.adkit.external.InterstitialAdsActivity
description: When Snap Ad Kit (Snap Inc.) opens an ad slot, this Activity displays the requested interstitial, rewarded, or banner placement while the ad session is active.
disableEffect: If disabled, these ad placements cannot be shown; users will not receive rewards for watching rewarded ads.

name: com.snap.camerakit.LegalPrePromptVariantGActivity
description: When Snap CameraKit needs an age-related consent response, this screen asks whether the user is an adult or needs a parent or guardian to continue.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot complete this age and guardian prompt, so the CameraKit flow that requires it may stop.

name: com.snap.camerakit.LegalPromptActivity
description: When Snap CameraKit requests a legal notice, this screen displays the provided title and message and returns whether the user accepts or closes it.
disableEffect: If disabled, a CameraKit flow waiting for this notice cannot receive the user's response and may remain blocked.

name: com.snap.camerakit.diagnostics.DiagnosticsExportActivity
description: When Snap CameraKit exports diagnostic records, this Activity opens Android's save-file picker and returns the chosen location to the SDK.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot save CameraKit diagnostic records; camera and lens features continue to work.

name: com.snap.camerakit.extension.connected.lenses.ConnectedLensesPromptActivity
description: When Snap CameraKit's Connected Lenses extension needs a user prompt, this screen displays its message and returns an accept or dismiss choice.
disableEffect: If disabled, connected-lens prompts cannot be answered, so a flow that requires one may not continue.

name: com.snap.camerakit.extension.lens.p2d.service.PushMenuActivity
description: When Snap CameraKit's PushToDevice extension manages lens delivery, this menu shows the connection status and lets the user connect or disconnect.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot manage the connection used to send lenses from Lens Studio to the app.

name: com.snap.camerakit.support.app.CameraActivity
description: When the app launches Snap CameraKit's capture or lens-play flow, this Activity opens the camera preview, applies selected lenses and controls, and can return captured photos or videos.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the CameraKit camera and lens experience.

name: com.snap.corekit.SnapKitInitProvider
description: When the app process starts, this Snap Kit CoreKit (Snap Inc.) provider triggers automatic initialization a few seconds later for Snap Kit features.
disableEffect: If disabled, Snap Kit features that rely on automatic initialization may fail to start.

name: com.snap.creativekit.internal.SnapCreativeShareResultHandler
description: When an app sends content to Snapchat through Snap CreativeKit (Snap Inc.), the SDK includes this receiver as the target for a follow-up broadcast. In this version, the receiver does not process the result.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app will not receive that follow-up share-result broadcast; the share screen itself is started through a separate Snapchat handoff.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderAgeActivity
description: Snap Camera Kit's Fit Finder opens this screen during its sizing questionnaire so shoppers can enter their age and save it with the profile used for a size estimate.
disableEffect: The Fit Finder flow can no longer collect age here and may not finish a complete size estimate.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderBodyShapeActivity
description: During Fit Finder, this screen asks shoppers to choose a body-shape option for their chest, waist, or hips and saves the choice with the sizing profile.
disableEffect: The body-shape question will be unavailable, so the Fit Finder questionnaire or resulting size estimate may be incomplete.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderClearDataActivity
description: When shoppers choose to clear their Fit Finder profile, this screen asks them to confirm before deleting the saved sizing profile and its related consent record.
disableEffect: Shoppers will lose the in-app option to erase their saved Fit Finder profile and clear its related consent record.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderFinalScreenActivity
description: After Fit Finder processes the sizing answers, this screen presents the product's recommended size options and lets shoppers continue or open profile settings.
disableEffect: Shoppers will not see the Fit Finder size recommendation or its follow-up actions.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderFootWidthActivity
description: In the footwear Fit Finder flow, this screen asks shoppers to choose their foot width and includes that answer in the shoe-size estimate.
disableEffect: The shoe-size flow may stop before it can collect foot width and complete the recommendation.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderLowerBodyReferenceSizeActivity
description: For lower-body clothing, this Fit Finder screen records a size the shopper already wears, its sizing system, and the garment length used for comparison.
disableEffect: Fit Finder may not be able to finish a lower-body size recommendation without this reference size information.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderMeasurementActivity
description: Fit Finder opens this screen to collect the shopper's height and weight, with metric and imperial input choices, before continuing to the body-shape questions.
disableEffect: The sizing questionnaire may stop before collecting measurements and producing a recommendation.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderProductDetailsActivity
description: Snap Camera Kit's Fit Finder product page shows the selected item and starts its sizing flow when the shopper taps the fit button; it can instead show an existing size recommendation.
disableEffect: The product's Fit Finder entry point and its size recommendations will be unavailable.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderReferenceSizeActivity
description: For a bra-size questionnaire, Fit Finder opens this screen so the shopper can select a bra size they already wear as a reference for the estimate.
disableEffect: The bra-size flow may be unable to collect a reference size and complete its recommendation.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderShoesBrandActivity
description: In the footwear questionnaire, this screen lets shoppers search for and choose a shoe brand so Fit Finder can compare their existing shoes with the item being sized.
disableEffect: The shoe-sizing flow may not be able to use the shopper's brand reference or continue to the next question.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderShoesSizeActivity
description: This Fit Finder screen asks shoppers to select the shoe size they usually wear and passes it on to the footwear fit questions.
disableEffect: The shoe-sizing flow will miss the shopper's reference size and may not finish its recommendation.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderShoesTypeActivity
description: During footwear sizing, this screen asks shoppers to choose the shoe category or type so Fit Finder can apply the relevant size questions.
disableEffect: The footwear questionnaire may stop without knowing which shoe type is being sized.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitFinderShoesUsageFrequencyActivity
description: This footwear Fit Finder screen asks how often shoppers wear shoes and saves that frequency with their fit profile before asking about the brand.
disableEffect: The shoe-sizing flow may not collect the usage information needed to continue its recommendation.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.fitfinder.FitPreferenceActivity
description: Fit Finder opens this screen so shoppers can choose how snug or loose they prefer clothing to feel, then uses that preference in the fit result.
disableEffect: Shoppers will not be able to set their fit preference, which can leave the Fit Finder result incomplete.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.ApplyTryOnActivity
description: In the older Snap Camera Kit virtual try-on flow, this screen applies the selected product to the shopper's chosen photo and shows the generated try-on preview.
disableEffect: The older photo-based virtual try-on flow will not be able to generate or show its preview.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.ImageTryOnApplyTryOnActivity
description: After a shopper selects a full-body photo, this screen lets them review or change it, then starts Snap Camera Kit's 2D try-on that generates an image of the selected product on them.
disableEffect: Shoppers will not be able to confirm their photo and generate a 2D try-on result.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.ImageTryOnResultActivity
description: After a 2D try-on finishes, this screen displays the generated image of the shopper wearing the selected product and lets them save it to the phone's photo gallery.
disableEffect: The generated try-on result cannot be viewed or saved through the Camera Kit flow.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.ImageTryOnSelectAvatarsActivity
description: At the start of Snap Camera Kit's 2D try-on flow, this screen previews the selected product on the shopper's Snap avatar and offers an action to upload a personal photo for the next step.
disableEffect: Shoppers will lose the avatar preview and the path from it to selecting a personal photo.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.ImageTryOnSelectPhotoActivity
description: This 2D try-on screen explains the full-length, lighting, and clothing conditions for a useful photo, then opens the phone's image picker so the shopper can choose one.
disableEffect: Shoppers cannot choose a photo for the 2D try-on flow.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.ProductDetailsActivity
description: Snap Camera Kit's shopping product page displays product images and, when 2D try-on is available, the Try It On action opens the shopper's avatar preview and photo-selection flow.
disableEffect: Shoppers will not be able to open Camera Kit's 2D try-on flow from the product page.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.SelectAvatarsActivity
description: In the older Snap Camera Kit virtual try-on flow, this screen shows available Snap avatars for the selected product and then continues to photo selection.
disableEffect: The older virtual try-on flow cannot continue from avatar selection to photo selection.

name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.SelectPhotoActivity
description: In the older Snap Camera Kit virtual try-on flow, this screen opens the image picker so shoppers can choose a photo and pass it to the try-on step.
disableEffect: The older photo-based virtual try-on flow cannot continue without a selected shopper photo.

name: com.snowballtech.transit.rta.context.TransitContentProvider
description: Primer's NOL Pay (Transit) SDK uses this provider at app startup to save the app context and initialize its logging; later Transit SDK calls retrieve that context.
disableEffect: Disabling it withholds the app context that Transit expects at startup, so NOL Pay features may fail to initialize.

name: com.sobot.album.activity.GalleryActivity
description: This optional Sobot album example screen opens a gallery of fixed sample picture links when the user taps its preview button, and it can allow pictures to be selected.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes this example gallery; the Sobot device-media picker uses separate screens.

name: com.sobot.album.activity.SobotAlbumActivity
description: When this optional Sobot album screen is opened, it launches a device photo-and-video picker with camera capture, lets the user choose up to 15 items, and shows the selected items for review.
disableEffect: Disabling this optional album screen removes its standalone picker; the Sobot support widget has a separate attachment picker.

name: com.sobot.album.app.album.AlbumActivity
description: The Sobot album library opens this screen when photo, video, or mixed-media selection starts. It lists matching items on the device, can offer camera capture, and returns the chosen files.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose photos or videos through this Sobot media picker, including its camera fallback.

name: com.sobot.album.app.album.GalleryActivity
description: When a user opens a media item from the Sobot picker, this full-screen gallery lets them browse items and mark which ones to keep in the selection.
disableEffect: Users may lose the ability to preview media or change their selection in the Sobot picker.

name: com.sobot.album.app.album.NullActivity
description: If the Sobot album picker finds no items for the requested media type, this screen shows an empty state and offers photo or video capture when that option is enabled.
disableEffect: Users with no matching local media will lose the camera fallback and may be unable to complete that selection.

name: com.sobot.album.app.gallery.GalleryAlbumActivity
description: The Sobot album library opens this full-screen viewer for a selected set of gallery items so users can inspect them and update the checked selection before returning.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or adjust selections in this Sobot gallery view.

name: com.sobot.album.app.preview.PreviewAlbumActivity
description: When an app requests a standalone Sobot album preview, this screen shows selected pictures one at a time and offers a download action for remote pictures.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse pictures in this full-screen preview or use its download action.

name: com.sobot.album.provider.CameraFileProvider
description: When the Sobot album library captures a photo or video, this provider gives the camera temporary access to the output file.
disableEffect: Camera capture may fail to return its photo or video to the Sobot media picker.

name: com.sobot.callbase.widget.floatwindow.FloatActivity
description: Sobot CallBase, used by the Sobot customer-service call SDK, opens Android’s overlay-access settings when the call flow requests permission for a floating call window. After the user returns, it reports whether permission was granted.
disableEffect: Without this screen, users cannot grant overlay access through the SDK, so its floating incoming or ongoing call window may not appear.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotAddCallPlanActivity
description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this form when an agent creates or edits a scheduled customer call, including its contact, time, reminder, and note. Saving sends the plan to Sobot.
disableEffect: Agents cannot create or update scheduled customer calls from the Sobot call workspace.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotAnswerModeChooseActivity
description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK shows this choice when an agent selects how calls should connect, offering mobile-phone and internet-phone modes and returning the selection to sign-in.
disableEffect: Agents cannot choose the call connection method in this sign-in flow.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallActivity
description: When the host app opens Sobot customer-service calling, this screen loads the agent workspace for the configured call mode. Agents use it to sign in, change availability, place calls, and open call plans, records, and tasks.
disableEffect: The app’s Sobot support-calling workspace and its call-management options will be unavailable.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallCustomerActivity
description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this form when an agent adds or edits a customer connected to a call. It loads existing details by phone number and saves the customer’s name, phone, or email.
disableEffect: Agents cannot add or update customer contact details through the Sobot call screens.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallNumberActivity
description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this keypad when an agent chooses manual dialing. The agent enters a number and the screen starts an outbound call.
disableEffect: Agents cannot place manual calls from the Sobot call workspace.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallPlanActivity
description: When an agent opens scheduled follow-ups, the Sobot customer-service call SDK loads the call-plan list and lets the agent refresh it, edit or delete a plan, or call its customer.
disableEffect: Agents cannot review or manage scheduled customer calls from this screen.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallPlanRemindActivity
description: While an agent creates a call plan, the Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this screen to choose when a reminder should appear and returns that choice to the plan form.
disableEffect: Agents cannot set a reminder time for a scheduled call.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallRecordActivity
description: When an agent opens call history, the Sobot customer-service call SDK loads paged call records and lets the agent open a record for more detail.
disableEffect: Agents cannot browse Sobot call history in the app.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallRecordDetailsActivity
description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens a selected call record to show its call and customer details. From here, an agent can open the customer form or create a follow-up plan.
disableEffect: Agents cannot review call details or use the related customer and follow-up actions from this screen.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallStatusActivity
description: When an Sobot call starts or arrives, this screen shows the number and live call state with answer and hang-up controls. It handles incoming and outgoing call requests.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to place or answer calls managed by the Sobot customer-service call SDK.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotCallTaskDetailsActivity
description: When an agent opens a customer-service call task, the Sobot SDK loads its contacts and task records. The agent can open a customer, schedule a follow-up, or start a call from the task.
disableEffect: Agents cannot review or work through customer-service call tasks from this screen.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotExtensionNumberChooseActivity
description: During Sobot call sign-in, this screen lists the agent’s available extensions and returns the one they select.
disableEffect: Agents cannot select an extension in this sign-in flow.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotLoginChooseActivity
description: When an agent signs in to Sobot customer-service calling, this screen loads phone modes and available extensions and lets the agent choose an answer mode, extension, and availability status.
disableEffect: Agents cannot configure or complete sign-in to the Sobot call service through this screen.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.SobotLoginStatusChooseActivity
description: During sign-in or an availability change, the Sobot customer-service call SDK shows the agent states supplied by the service and returns the selected state.
disableEffect: Agents cannot choose their availability state in this flow.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.activity.WebViewActivity
description: When a Sobot call flow opens a link, this screen displays the page inside the app and supports navigation, retry, downloads, and file selection.
disableEffect: Pages opened from Sobot call flows will not load, which can interrupt any step that depends on them.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.baresip.service.SobotBaresipService
description: When Sobot’s internet-phone call mode is active, this background service keeps the phone connection running, tracks network and audio state, and sends call-state changes to the call screens.
disableEffect: Internet-phone calls may fail to start, receive calls, or maintain audio.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.baresip.service.TaskReceiver
description: When the Sobot call SDK requests an agent’s internet-phone account be registered or removed, this receiver applies that change.
disableEffect: The Sobot call service can no longer change the agent’s internet-phone account status through this receiver.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.janus.SobotJanusService
description: When Sobot call mode starts, this service connects the agent to the online calling service and manages account registration and live call signaling.
disableEffect: Internet-based Sobot calls may not connect or remain active.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.service.SobotJanusService
description: When the newer Sobot call mode starts, this foreground service connects the agent to the online calling service and manages account registration and live calls.
disableEffect: The newer Sobot call mode may not connect or keep agent calls active.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.sipphonelibrary.SobotKeepAliveReceiver
description: While the Sobot phone service is running, this receiver responds to screen-state events and scheduled alarms to refresh the phone account and keep its connection active.
disableEffect: The phone account may expire while the app is in the background, interrupting incoming calls.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.sipphonelibrary.SobotPhoneService
description: The Sobot phone service starts the internet-phone connection and reports incoming, connected, and ended calls plus account-status changes to the call screens. It stays active in the foreground during ongoing calls.
disableEffect: Internet calling and its call-state updates will stop working as expected.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.sipphonelibrary.SobotPhoneService$AssistService
description: The Sobot call SDK starts this service while setting up a background phone call on some Android versions.
disableEffect: The app may not keep calls active in the background on those Android versions.

description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this form when an agent creates or edits a scheduled customer call, including its contact, time, reminder, and note. Saving sends the plan to Sobot.
disableEffect: Agents cannot create or update scheduled customer calls from the Sobot call workspace.

disableEffect: Agents cannot choose the call connection method in this sign-in flow.

disableEffect: Agents cannot add or update customer contact details through the Sobot call screens.

description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this keypad when an agent chooses manual dialing. The agent enters a number and the screen starts an outbound call.
disableEffect: Agents cannot place manual calls from the Sobot call workspace.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.v1.activity.SobotCallPlanActivity
description: When an agent opens scheduled follow-ups, the Sobot customer-service call SDK loads the call-plan list and lets the agent refresh it, edit or delete a plan, or call its customer.
disableEffect: Agents cannot review or manage scheduled customer calls from this screen.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.v1.activity.SobotCallPlanRemindActivity
description: While an agent creates a call plan, the Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this screen to choose when a reminder should appear and returns that choice to the plan form.
disableEffect: Agents cannot set a reminder time for a scheduled call.

name: com.sobot.callsdk.v1.activity.SobotCallRecordActivity
description: When an agent opens call history, the Sobot customer-service call SDK loads paged call records and lets the agent open a record for more detail.

name: com.taptap.sdk.leaderboard.androidx.delegate.LeaderboardDelegateActivity

name: com.taptap.sdk.profile.androidx.internal.ui.UserProfileActivity

name: com.taptap.sdk.profile.support.internal.ui.UserProfileActivity
description: When TapTap opens a player’s profile, this screen loads and displays it.
disableEffect: TapTap player profiles will not open.

name: com.taptap.sdk.relation.internal.ui.landscape.LandscapeMessengerActivity

disableEffect: The landscape TapTap friends and messaging screen will not open.

name: com.taptap.sdk.relation.internal.ui.landscape.MessengerDialogActivity

name: com.taptap.sdk.relation.internal.ui.portrait.PortraitMessengerActivity

name: com.taptap.sdk.relation.lite.internal.RelationDialogActivity

name: com.taptap.sdk.relation.lite.internal.ui.portrait.PortraitMessengerActivity

disableEffect: The lightweight TapTap team-invitation list will not open in portrait mode.

name: com.taptap.sdk.themis.lite.ThemisProvider

disableEffect: Themis Lite will miss this automatic setup, so features that request its device-identification data may stop working.

name: com.taptap.sdk.ui.TapTapActivity
description: When a TapTap Login request opens its authorization flow, this Activity displays the TapTap sign-in interface used to complete account authorization.

name: com.taptap.sdk.update.download.OkDownloadProvider
description: When TapTap’s update downloader is used, this component supplies the app context needed to create its download service.
disableEffect: TapTap update downloads may fail because the downloader cannot initialize its app context.

name: com.taptap.sdk.update.internal.TapUpdateFileProvider
description: When a TapTap update has downloaded an APK, this provider gives Android's installer access to the file.
disableEffect: Android's installer will not receive the downloaded APK for TapTap updates.

name: com.tarkalabs.eaglescan.ui.BarcodeScannerActivity

disableEffect: The app's barcode-scanning flow will not open, so users cannot scan a code with this library.

name: com.tarkalabs.scanner.ui.BarcodeScannerActivity
description: Tarka Labs Barcode Scanner opens a full-screen camera scanner when the app starts its scan flow. It returns the scanned text to the screen that opened it, or returns a cancellation or error result.
disableEffect: The app's barcode-scanning flow will not open, so users cannot scan a code with this library.

name: com.tasomaniac.widget.PermissionCaptureActivity
description: Tasomaniac EmailAutoCompleteTextView opens this translucent screen when its email suggestions need permission to read device accounts. It shows Android's permission prompt and returns the user's choice to the email field.

name: com.taurusx.tax.core.TaurusXProvider
description: TaurusX Ads registers this file-sharing provider for files in its ad-download folder. Android can use it to give another app access to a downloaded file when the SDK hands that file off.
disableEffect: TaurusX file handoffs can fail, including ad-download actions that need another app to open a downloaded file.

name: com.taurusx.tax.mraid.MraidBrowser
description: TaurusX opens this in-app browser when an ad sends the user to a web page. It loads the destination and provides back, forward, refresh, and close controls.
disableEffect: Web pages opened from TaurusX ads will not appear in this in-app browser.

name: com.taurusx.tax.mraid.MraidVideoPlayerActivity
description: TaurusX opens this full-screen player when an ad requests video playback outside the ad page. Playback starts with the video view and returns to the ad flow when the user exits or the video ends.
disableEffect: Videos requested by TaurusX ads will not open in this player.

name: com.taurusx.tax.ui.AppOpenAdActivity
description: TaurusX uses this full-screen page to present an app-open ad when the app displays that ad placement. It shows the ad creative and handles taps and closing the ad.
disableEffect: TaurusX app-open ads will not appear, while the app's other screens remain available.

name: com.taurusx.tax.ui.AppOpenNativeAdActivity
description: TaurusX uses this full-screen page for a native app-open ad. It shows the ad image, app name, title, and call-to-action when that placement is opened.
disableEffect: TaurusX native app-open ads will not appear, while the app's other screens remain available.

name: com.taurusx.tax.ui.TaurusxH5Activity
description: TaurusX uses this page for full-screen or splash ad placements, loading web, video, native, or linked ad content inside the app and responding to ad interactions.
disableEffect: TaurusX full-screen web-based and splash ad placements will not open, while other app screens remain available.

name: com.taurusx.tax.ui.TaxVideoActivity
description: TaurusX opens this full-screen page to show a video ad placement. It plays the ad and handles the ad's on-screen interactions and closing the page.
disableEffect: TaurusX full-screen video ads will not play, while the app's other screens remain available.

name: com.taurusx.tax.ui.TaxVideoListActivity
description: TaurusX opens this page for a multi-item video ad placement. It presents the placement's video and linked ad content and handles the user's ad interactions.
disableEffect: TaurusX multi-item video ads will not open, while the app's other screens remain available.

name: com.taurusx.tax.ui.TaxWebViewActivity
description: TaurusX shows a web page inside the app when an ad destination is opened. It loads the destination and handles links selected within the page.
disableEffect: Web pages opened from TaurusX ads will not appear in this in-app view, while other app screens remain available.

name: com.taurusx.tax.utils.webview.TaxBrowserActivity
description: TaurusX opens this browser for a web destination from an ad. It loads the page in an in-app browser with navigation and close controls.
disableEffect: Web destinations opened from TaurusX ads will not appear in this browser, while other app screens remain available.

name: com.tb.library.tbService.FloatWindowService
description: MrTangBo TbLibrary uses this service when an app requests a floating panel. It places the supplied panel over the screen and lets it move and respond to taps.
disableEffect: The floating panel is unavailable, so app features that rely on it cannot be used.

name: com.tb.library.tbZxingUtil.android.TbCaptureActivity
description: MrTangBo TbLibrary opens this Activity when the app starts a barcode scan. It scans with the camera and can also decode a selected image, then returns the recognized text to the app.
disableEffect: The app can no longer scan QR codes or other barcodes through this library.

name: com.tcl.baselib.VhallFileProvider
description: The TCL VHall live SDK uses this file provider to let its pages and compatible apps open or share local files through temporary access links.
disableEffect: Opening or sharing local files through TCL VHall pages may fail if this provider is disabled.

name: com.tcl.baselib.webview.VhallWebviewActivity

disableEffect: Embedded TCL VHall event pages and voting screens that use this browser will not open if it is disabled.

name: com.tcl.uilibray.chat.biz.ChatActivity

name: com.tcl.uilibray.pictureinpicture.service.FloatingService

name: com.tcl.uilibray.pictureinpicture.service.VodFloatingService
description: When TCL VHall on-demand video is moved out of its page, this service places the player in a movable floating window and keeps its playback position. Tapping the window returns to the video.

name: com.tcl.uilibray.question.ui.MasterQuestionListActivity

name: com.tcl.uilibray.question.ui.QuestionPaperStoreActivity
description: TCL VHall’s live-event question bank lets a host search saved questions and add a chosen question to the event’s question list.
disableEffect: Hosts cannot search the saved question bank or add its questions to an event through this screen if it is disabled.

name: com.tcl.uilibray.question.ui.ViewerQuestionListActivity
description: During a TCL VHall live event, this screen shows the viewer’s question list and opens a selected question or answer page.
disableEffect: Viewers cannot browse and open their event questions through this screen if it is disabled.

name: com.tcl.uilibray.watchverticallive.AnchorDetailActivity
description: TCL VHall opens this page when a viewer selects the event host. It shows the host’s name and portrait with tabbed lists of the host’s live content.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the host profile or browse that host’s content from this page if it is disabled.

name: com.tcl.uilibray.watchverticallive.HeraldActivity
description: TCL VHall uses this page for scheduled live events. It shows event and host details, a countdown, a reservation button, and a replay or room-entry option when available.
disableEffect: Users cannot reserve for or open an event from this preview page if it is disabled.

name: com.tcl.uilibray.watchverticallive.WatchVerticalLiveActivity
description: TCL VHall opens this page to join and display a vertical live room. Leaving the page ends the room session unless picture-in-picture playback is active.
disableEffect: Viewers may lose access to the TCL VHall vertical live-room route if this page is disabled.

name: com.tcl.web.WebViewActivity
description: TCL VHall opens its live portal or a supplied web page inside the app. A sign-in response from the page can start a live room.
disableEffect: The TCL live portal and any room-entry links that use this browser will not open if it is disabled.

name: com.tds.common.provider.CurrentConfigProvider
description: TapTap Common exposes the app's TapTap client settings and selected language to TapTap components that request them.
disableEffect: TapTap components will no longer be able to read these settings from this provider, which can prevent TapTap login and configured features from working.

name: com.tdxtxt.liteavplayer.video.controller.PlayerHeadsetController

name: com.teamapt.monnify.sdk.module.view.activity.SdkActivity
description: The Monnify Android SDK opens this checkout screen with the transaction details and lets a customer choose a payment method such as card, bank transfer, direct debit, USSD, or phone payment.
disableEffect: Customers cannot complete the Monnify checkout flow.

name: com.telefonica.androidlogger.io.provider.AppLoggerFileProvider

name: com.telefonica.mistica.catalog.ui.CatalogMainActivity

name: com.telefonica.mistica.catalog.ui.ComponentCatalogActivity

disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the selected section's component examples in the catalog.

name: com.telefonica.mistica.catalog.ui.classic.activity.EmptyStateScreenCatalogActivity
description: This Mistica Catalog screen displays an empty-state example with the supplied title, message, and button choices.
disableEffect: The catalog's empty-state example will not open.

name: com.telefonica.mistica.catalog.ui.classic.activity.FeedbackScreenCatalogActivity
description: This Mistica Catalog screen displays a feedback-page example with its supplied message, reference details, and button choices.

name: com.telefonica.mistica.compose.catalog.ui.CatalogMainActivity

disableEffect: The Mistica Compose component catalog will not open.

disableEffect: Rewarded ads will not open, so users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

name: com.tencent.ai.tvs.capability.thirdpartyplayer.ThirdPartyVideoService

disableEffect: Disabling it breaks QQ sign-in for apps that use the Yunxiaowei SDK.

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TVS from tracking QQ Music Watch playback changes, so related voice-control features may stop working.

name: com.tencent.android.fcm.XGFcmListenerService

name: com.tencent.android.mipush.XMPushMessageReceiver

disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from receiving Xiaomi-channel messages and registration updates.

name: com.tencent.android.mzpush.MZPushMessageReceiver

disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from receiving Meizu-channel messages and registration updates.

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.TpnsActivity

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.XGPushProvider

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.XGPushReceiver

disableEffect: TPNS message delivery and keep-alive handling can stop, while the app's other features remain available.

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.XGVipPushKAProvider

disableEffect: Disabling it removes this startup path for the TPNS push service, so push delivery or background recovery may stop working.

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.honor.HonorMessageService
description: When Honor Push updates a token or delivers a message, this Tencent TPNS service forwards the token or message into the app's TPNS push handling.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from registering or receiving messages through Honor Push.

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.inappmessage.InAppMessageActivity
description: When Tencent TPNS opens an in-app message, this activity reads its content and displays the supplied text, media, and action buttons inside the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TPNS in-app messages and their action buttons from appearing.

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.rpc.XGRemoteService
description: When the app's push process connects to this Tencent Xinge and TPNS service, it provides the connection used to reach the push service; a start request can also wake that service.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app's separate push process from reaching or waking Tencent's push service, so vendor push messages may stop.

name: com.tencent.android.tpush.service.XGVipPushService
description: Tencent TPNS starts this Service in a separate app process to initialize and handle background push work.
disableEffect: TPNS background message delivery and maintenance will stop; regular app screens can still work.

name: com.tencent.android.vivopush.VivoPushMessageReceiver

name: com.tencent.bugly.beta.ui.BetaActiveAlertActivity

name: com.tencent.bugly.beta.ui.BetaActivity

name: com.tencent.bugly.beta.utils.BuglyFileProvider

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.AuthActivity

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.CompareFaceActivity

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.DualCameraActivity

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.FaceDetectActivity

disableEffect: The SDK's live face-detection example will no longer run.

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.RegWithAndroidCameraActivity

disableEffect: The camera-based face enrollment example will no longer run or save new face profiles.

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.RegWithFileActivity

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.ReplayActivity

disableEffect: The saved-frame face-search replay example will no longer run.

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.RetrieveWithAndroidCameraActivity

disableEffect: The SDK's live-camera face-search example will no longer run.

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.RetrieveWithGalleryActivity

disableEffect: The SDK's photo-based face-search example will no longer run.

name: com.tencent.cloud.ai.fr.RetrieveWithImiCameraActivity
description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example reads color, infrared, and depth streams from a supported IMI camera, checks the face, then searches the saved face library.
disableEffect: The SDK's IMI-camera face-search example will no longer run.

name: com.tencent.components.backtrace.WarmUpService

disableEffect: Matrix cannot prepare native libraries through this service, limiting native crash and call-stack diagnostics.

name: com.tencent.connect.common.AssistActivity
description: Tencent QQ OpenSDK opens this helper Activity during QQ sign-in, authorization, or sharing and returns the result to the calling app.
disableEffect: QQ sign-in, authorization, and sharing flows that use Tencent OpenSDK will fail.

name: com.tencent.klevin.ads.nativ.view.NativeAdDetailActivity

name: com.tencent.klevin.ads.receiver.NotificationBroadcastReceiver

name: com.tencent.klevin.ads.view.AlertDialogActivity

name: com.tencent.klevin.ads.view.InteractiveActivity

name: com.tencent.sqlitelint.behaviour.alert.CheckResultActivity

disableEffect: The list of databases checked by SQLiteLint cannot be opened.

name: com.tencent.tauth.AuthActivity

disableEffect: QQ sharing and other QQ Open SDK flows that use this callback may fail.

name: com.tencent.tbs.one.optional.TBSOneStandaloneService

disableEffect: Background preparation is skipped, so TBS-powered pages and document previews may take longer to open.

name: com.tencent.tcic.TCICFileProvider

disableEffect: TCIC classroom photo capture may stop working.

name: com.tencent.tcic.TCICInitProvider

disableEffect: TCIC classroom setup may fail, affecting classroom features.

name: com.tencent.tcic.core.trtc.ScreenCaptureService

disableEffect: TCIC classroom screen sharing may fail to start or continue.

name: com.tencent.tcic.pages.TCICClassActivity

disableEffect: Users may be unable to enter TCIC classrooms.

name: com.tencent.tcr.ar.activity.ConnectHuaweiAppMarketActivity

disableEffect: Without this Activity, the AR view cannot show its install prompt on devices that need Huawei's AR service, so that AR session may not start.

name: com.tencent.tcr.micro.updatesdk.TinkerResultService

disableEffect: The app can keep using its current features, but patch results will not be handled and a completed update may not be cleaned up or loaded.

name: com.tencent.tddiag.tpns.TpnsPushReceiver

name: com.tencent.timpush.fcm.GoogleFCMMsgService

disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Firebase token updates through this service, so its Google-backed offline-push registration stops refreshing.

name: com.tencent.timpush.fcm.TIMFCMService

name: com.tencent.timpush.fcm.TIMPushFCMMsgService

disableEffect: TIMPush will stop receiving Firebase tokens and message callbacks.

name: com.tencent.timpush.fcm.TIMPushFCMService

disableEffect: The app will no longer initialize or register its Firebase push channel through TIMPush.

name: com.tencent.timpush.honor.TIMPushHonorMessageService

name: com.tencent.timpush.honor.TIMPushHonorService

disableEffect: The app will no longer register or receive push through the Honor channel in TIMPush.

name: com.tencent.timpush.huawei.TIMHuaWeiService

name: com.tencent.timpush.huawei.TIMPushHmsMessageService

disableEffect: TIMPush will stop receiving Huawei token updates and message callbacks.

name: com.tencent.timpush.huawei.TIMPushHuaWeiService

disableEffect: The app will no longer initialize or register Huawei push through TIMPush.

name: com.tencent.timpush.meizu.TIMPushMeiZuReceiver

name: com.tencent.tmdownloader.TMAssistantDownloadService
description: Tencent TMAssistant starts this background service for download tasks; it manages APK downloads and reports their progress and state.
disableEffect: Downloads or updates handled by Tencent TMAssistant will stop, while the game's normal features continue.

name: com.tencent.tpns.baseapi.base.SettingsContentProvider
description: When Tencent TPNS components share settings or short-lived values across app processes, this provider reads and writes those values through the app's TPNS settings store.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TPNS components from sharing these settings and values through the provider, which can disrupt push processing.

name: com.tencent.tpns.mqttchannel.services.MqttService
description: When Tencent TPNS needs its MQTT push channel, it starts this service to initialize the channel that carries push traffic.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the TPNS MQTT channel from starting, so messages delivered through that channel may not arrive.

name: com.tencent.trtc.videocall.VideoCallingActivity
description: The YJJk Video Doctor SDK uses Tencent TRTC to open a call screen, start the local camera and microphone, and join the supplied room to show other participants. Users can switch cameras and mute video or audio.
disableEffect: The app cannot open this screen to join or continue its video calls.

name: com.tencent.trtc.videocall.VideoCallingEnterActivity
description: The YJJk Video Doctor SDK shows a form for entering a user name and room number, then opens its Tencent TRTC call screen when both values are present.
disableEffect: Users cannot enter a call through this room-entry screen.

name: com.tencent.tyic.TYICInitProvider
description: At app startup, Tencent TYIC stores the app context and initializes its classroom SDK, including app details and web support.
disableEffect: TYIC classroom setup may fail.

name: com.tencent.tyic.pages.InClassActivity
description: When a user enters a Tencent TYIC class, this activity handles class links or app-provided class details, requests classroom permissions, and opens the class.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to join TYIC classes or use the microphone and camera in class.

name: com.tencent.ysdk.module.user.impl.freelogin.FreeLoginInfoActivity
description: Tencent YSDK opens this Activity when a free-login handoff returns login information; it saves that information and reports success or failure to the caller.
disableEffect: Tencent YSDK's free-login handoff will fail, so players may be unable to sign in through that path.

name: com.tencent.ysdk.module.user.impl.wx.qrcode.QRActivity
description: Tencent YSDK opens this screen when a player chooses WeChat QR-code sign-in; it starts the QR authentication flow and lets the player cancel it.
disableEffect: WeChat QR-code sign-in through Tencent YSDK will be unavailable.

name: com.tendarts.sdk.communications.NetworkChangeReceiver
description: When Tendarts enables it and connectivity changes to online, this Receiver starts sending queued SDK communications.
disableEffect: Tendarts push and queued messages may not resume automatically when the connection returns.

name: com.tendarts.sdk.communications.PendingCommunicationsService
description: When Tendarts schedules queued work, this Service sends pending SDK communications and schedules another attempt if the app task is removed.
disableEffect: Tendarts messages and reporting events may remain queued or stop sending.

name: com.tendarts.sdk.gcm.DartsReceiver
description: On Tendarts clear, open-push, or open-list broadcasts, this Receiver clears the stored notification list, opens the selected notification or link, or opens the notification list.
disableEffect: Tendarts notification actions and links will stop working, though the app can still open normally.

name: com.tendarts.sdk.gcm.GCMInstanceIdListener
description: When Google Play reports that the push token changed, this 10Darts Android SDK Service starts registering the new token.
disableEffect: Tendarts may stop receiving push notifications after the token changes.

name: com.tendarts.sdk.gcm.GCMListenerService
description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a push, this 10Darts Android SDK Service processes it, reports receipt, and builds the notification shown to the user.
disableEffect: Tendarts push notifications may no longer be received or displayed.

name: com.tendarts.sdk.gcm.GCMRegistrationIntentService
description: When Tendarts sets up push or refreshes a token, this Service obtains the device token, sends it to Tendarts, and subscribes the device to the SDK push topic.
disableEffect: Tendarts push registration and future push delivery may fail.

name: com.tendarts.sdk.monitoring.IntentMonitorService
description: After a user follows a Tendarts push link into the app, this Service measures how long the app stays open and reports that session to Tendarts.
disableEffect: Tendarts will no longer receive session-duration reports after push links; normal app screens still work.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.application.service.CommunicationService
description: When the app binds to this TenKiv TekDAQC service, it accepts board connection, command, and task requests and relays board responses to the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from communicating with TekDAQC boards or running commands and tasks on them.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.application.service.LocatorService
description: When the app's locator manager starts board discovery, this TenKiv service searches for TekDAQC boards and reports when boards appear, respond, or disappear.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops automatic board discovery and updates about which TekDAQC boards are available.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.application.service.TekdaqcCommunicationManager$ComService
description: When TenKiv starts a connection for a board, this service opens an Ethernet session and runs the board commands requested by the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from connecting to a TekDAQC board or sending it commands.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.application.service.TekdaqcLocatorManager$LocatorReceiver
description: When TenKiv broadcasts a board-discovery update, this receiver updates the discovered-board list and notifies the app that a board was found, updated, or lost.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from receiving TekDAQC board discovery and availability updates.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.application.service.TekdaqcLocatorManager$LocatorService
description: When TenKiv's locator manager starts or binds this service, it searches for TekDAQC boards at the requested interval and reports discovery changes to the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops this version of the app's TekDAQC board search and discovery updates.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.content.TekdaqcDataProvider
description: When the app reads or stores TekDAQC measurements, this provider accesses the local database of analog-input readings and calibration data.
disableEffect: Disabling it can make measurement history and calibration records unavailable to the app.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.services.CommunicationService
description: When the app requests a board connection, command, or task, this older TenKiv service opens an Ethernet session, runs the request, and reports connection changes.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops the app from communicating with TekDAQC boards through this service.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.services.DiscoveryService
description: When the app requests a TekDAQC board search, this older TenKiv service searches the network and broadcasts each discovered board to the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from automatically finding TekDAQC boards through this discovery service.

name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.locator.TekdaqcLocatorManager$LocatorReceiver
description: When the TenKiv locator broadcasts a board update, this receiver turns it into app notifications for newly found, updated, or removed TekDAQC boards.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from receiving board discovery and availability changes from the TenKiv locator.

name: com.tenqube.ibk.VisualActivity
description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK SDK opens its finance page when the host app starts this screen. It displays the IBK transaction and receipt experience inside the app.
disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to open the TENQUBE IBK finance and receipt screen.

name: com.tenqube.ibkreceipt.VisualActivity
description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK receipt SDK opens this screen for app requests or incoming receipt links and displays the linked receipt page.
disableEffect: Receipt links and the SDK receipt screen will no longer open.

name: com.tenqube.ibkreceipt.VisualContainerActivity
description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK receipt SDK opens this screen for receipt links and its notification-access flow. It displays the requested page and reports whether notification access is enabled when the user returns from settings.
disableEffect: Receipt links and the SDK notification-access flow will stop working.

name: com.tenqube.ibkreceipt.VisualReceiptActivity
description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK receipt SDK opens this screen from a receipt link or an in-app request, then displays the associated receipt page.
disableEffect: Receipt links and the SDK receipt view will no longer open.

name: com.tenqube.jb.VisualActivity
description: TENQUBE Visual’s JB module opens its bank-specific finance page when the host app starts this screen. The page is displayed inside the app.
disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to open its JB-specific Visual finance page.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.parser.catcher.NotiCatcher
description: TENQUBE Visual listens for new Android notifications after notification access is granted. It filters out ongoing or progress notifications and sends supported message text for transaction parsing.
disableEffect: Transactions announced in notifications will no longer be collected for TENQUBE Visual views.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.parser.catcher.SMSCatcher
description: TENQUBE Visual receives Android’s incoming-SMS broadcast, combines the parts of a message, and sends its text to the transaction parser.
disableEffect: Transactions from supported bank or card SMS alerts will stop being collected, so transaction history may be incomplete.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.parser.catcher.SmsMmsService
description: TENQUBE Visual starts this background service after an SMS or supported notification arrives. It passes the message through the SDK transaction parsers.
disableEffect: Messages queued by TENQUBE Visual will no longer be processed into transaction data.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.presentation.receiver.AlarmReceiver
description: TENQUBE Visual runs this receiver when a scheduled Visual notification fires. It checks whether the saved notification is active, displays it when due, and refreshes the schedule.
disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s scheduled reminder notifications will stop appearing.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.presentation.ui.main.VisualMain
description: The TENQUBE Visual finance SDK opens this screen when the host app requests its main finance experience. It displays the requested Visual page and synchronizes transaction data for that screen.
disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s finance pages and transaction views will no longer open.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.presentation.ui.notiintro.NotiIntroActivity
description: TENQUBE Visual opens this guide after launching Android’s notification-access settings. The guide shows the host app’s name and an animated example of the setting.
disableEffect: Only the guide disappears; Android’s notification-access settings can still be opened.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.presentation.ui.permission.VisualPermissionActivity
description: TENQUBE Visual opens this prompt when its mobile-receipt feature needs permission to appear over other apps. The button takes the user to Android’s overlay-permission settings.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete TENQUBE Visual’s in-app permission flow for mobile-receipt overlays.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.receiver.AlarmReceiver
description: TENQUBE Visual runs this receiver when a scheduled IBK notification fires. It verifies that the saved reminder is active, displays it when due, and refreshes the schedule.
disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s scheduled IBK reminder notifications will stop appearing.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.ui.NotiIntroActivity
description: The TENQUBE Visual LG Pay guide shows the host app’s name and icon with an animated example of notification access. Its Next button closes the guide; it does not itself grant permission.
disableEffect: Only this guidance screen disappears; notification access can still be managed in Android settings.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.ui.TransactionPopupActivity
description: TENQUBE Visual opens this popup after a parsed transaction when popup display is enabled. It shows purchase details and monthly spending information, and can also display an ad.
disableEffect: Purchase-detail and spending-summary popups from TENQUBE Visual will no longer appear.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.ui.VisualPermissionActivity
description: TENQUBE Visual opens this prompt when mobile receipts need permission to appear over other apps. Its button opens Android’s overlay-permission settings and returns the result to the SDK.
disableEffect: The SDK’s mobile-receipt overlay permission flow will be unavailable.

name: com.tenqube.visual_third.ui.VisualWebActivity
description: TENQUBE Visual opens this screen when the host app requests its finance experience. It loads the Visual pages, synchronizes transaction data, and provides related actions such as exporting records.
disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s finance pages, transaction views, and in-app actions will no longer be available.

name: com.tenqube.visualbase.infrastructure.framework.parser.SmsMmsService
description: TENQUBE Visual Base starts this background service with an SMS or a message extracted from a notification, then passes it to the SDK parser.
disableEffect: Messages received by the older Visual Base integration will no longer be processed by its parser.

name: com.tenqube.visualbase.infrastructure.framework.parser.SmsParsingService
description: TENQUBE Visual Base starts this background service after its receiver accepts an SMS or supported RCS message. The service passes that message to the SDK parser.
disableEffect: SMS and RCS messages accepted by Visual Base will no longer be parsed into transaction data.

name: com.tenqube.visualbase.infrastructure.framework.parser.noti.NotiCatchService
description: When enabled and granted notification access, TENQUBE Visual Base receives posted notifications and sends supported message content to its parser. This artifact declares the listener disabled by default.
disableEffect: If enabled, notification-based transaction messages will no longer reach the Visual Base parser.

name: com.tenqube.visualbase.infrastructure.framework.parser.sms.SMSCatchReceiver
description: TENQUBE Visual Base receives Android SMS and supported RCS message broadcasts. When message parsing is enabled, it extracts the message and passes it to the SDK parser.
disableEffect: SMS and RCS transaction messages will no longer be collected by Visual Base.

name: com.tenqube.visualibk.noti.NotiCatchService
description: TENQUBE Visual IBK listens for posted notifications, ignores notifications from the default SMS app, and sends the remaining content to its receipt and transaction parsers.
disableEffect: Notification-based IBK receipt and transaction data will no longer be collected.

name: com.tesera.andbtiles.providers.TilesContentProvider
description: Tesera Andbtiles supplies map data when an app requests it. It reads saved offline maps and can fetch missing map images from the configured server.
disableEffect: Map screens that use Andbtiles will no longer be able to retrieve their tile images or metadata.

name: com.tesera.andbtiles.services.DownloadService
description: Tesera Andbtiles starts this background service when the app requests a map-file download. It saves the file, adds it to the local map list, and shows download progress and results.
disableEffect: Map-file downloads through Andbtiles will fail, so new offline maps cannot be added.

name: com.tesera.andbtiles.services.HarvesterService
description: Tesera Andbtiles starts this service to download map images for a selected area and zoom levels so they are available offline. It shows progress and saves the finished map data.
disableEffect: Tile prefetching and the resulting offline map data will no longer be available.

name: com.tesla.framework.common.util.network.NetworkReceiver
description: FastFramework (Jerry Liu's FastAndroid library) listens for Android connectivity changes and checks whether a network is available. It tells the app's network listener when connectivity appears or disappears.
disableEffect: Features that respond to connection changes may stop updating their online or offline state.

name: com.tesla.framework.component.AccountProvider
description: FastFramework (Jerry Liu's FastAndroid library) declares this account-related Provider when the app starts. In this release its queries return no data and its insert, update and delete requests make no changes.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes an empty Provider; this release exposes no account data or updates through it.

name: com.test.mylibrary.AndroidTestApp
description: Worldline Paynimo's test library opens this Activity when the app asks to show its checkout test screen. It displays the library's checkout interface.
disableEffect: The Paynimo checkout test screen will not open.

name: com.test.schedule.AutoStart
description: When the device finishes starting, the schedule-release library opens its ad screen and schedules recurring ad launches.
disableEffect: The library’s ads will no longer start automatically after the device restarts or be launched by its recurring schedule.

name: com.test.schedule.ShowAds
description: The schedule-release library opens this screen after startup or a scheduled launch. It fetches ad settings and displays Google full-screen ads, with a second ad able to follow the first.
disableEffect: The library’s full-screen ads will no longer appear.

name: com.theagilemonkeys.meets.meetsandroid.request.robospice.MeetsSpiceService
description: The Meets Android SDK from The Agile Monkeys starts this background service for online-store requests. It runs the network requests that load store information and carry out store actions.
disableEffect: Meets-backed store data and actions may fail to load.

name: com.theartofdev.edmodo.cropper.CropImageActivity

disableEffect: Disabling it prevents photo workflows that rely on this library from completing a crop.

name: com.thefinestartist.finestwebview.FinestWebViewActivity

name: com.thejuki.kformmaster.FormActivityTest

disableEffect: Only this built-in form demonstration screen becomes unavailable; the app's other screens and KFormMaster's reusable form controls remain available.

name: com.theoplayer.android.api.fullscreen.FullScreenActivity

name: com.theoplayer.android.internal.pip.PiPActivity

disableEffect: THEOplayer videos will no longer continue playing in a floating picture-in-picture window.

name: com.therouter.InnerTheRouterContentProvider

disableEffect: App navigation routes may remain uninitialized, so screens opened through TheRouter may fail.

name: com.thinkcar.thinkim.core.MainActivity

disableEffect: The ThinkIM sample greeting screen will not open.

name: com.thinkcar.thinkim.core.im.receiver.ScreenBroadcastReceiver

name: com.thinkcar.thinkim.core.im.receiver.TimeZoneReceiver

disableEffect: Chat times may not be corrected after a system date or clock change.

name: com.thinkcar.thinkim.core.im.service.FirebaseService

disableEffect: Firebase messages for ThinkIM will no longer reach this Service.

name: com.thinkcar.thinkim.core.im.service.IMService
description: When the ThinkCar ThinkIM chat client binds to this Service, it opens the chat connection, sends periodic pings, reconnects after failures or network changes, and forwards incoming messages.
disableEffect: The app's ThinkIM chat will not be able to connect, send messages, or receive messages through this Service.

name: com.thirteen.fileselector.FilePickerActivity
description: When an app asks users to choose files, this fileSelector Activity displays folders and files, supports single or multiple selection, and returns the chosen items to the app.

name: com.thk.im.android.media.picker.FileProvider
description: THK-IM’s media picker uses this provider to share captured or selected files with the app as content links, without exposing their file paths.
disableEffect: Photo and video attachment flows that rely on these links will fail to return captured or selected files.

name: com.thk.im.preview.IMMediaPreviewActivity
description: THK-IM opens this screen with chat messages so users can swipe through their images and videos and play videos.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or browse image and video messages in THK-IM chat.

name: com.thk.im.preview.IMRecordPreviewActivity

name: com.threeline.librarysdk.ui.EmvEntryActivity

name: com.xlythe.service.weather.WeatherUndergroundService

disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Weather Underground weather and astronomy updates.

name: com.xlythe.textmanager.text.SendService$SmsSentReceiver

name: com.xlythe.textmanager.text.receiver.MmsReceiver

disableEffect: Background beacon or location activity may stop or fail to resume after Android closes the app.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.android.BackgroundService
description: ProxSee's beacon SDK starts this background Service for SDK work; Android may restart it if the app process ends.
disableEffect: Background beacon or location activity may stop or fail to resume after Android closes the app.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.android.jobs.BackgroundJob
description: ProxSee schedules this job to provide a short background run window; after it starts, the job reports completion after about 40 seconds.
disableEffect: ProxSee loses this scheduled background window, so some background beacon updates may be delayed.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.android.wakeup.StartupBroadcastReceiver
description: ProxSee's beacon SDK receives startup, power-connection, and alarm broadcasts here; the analyzed receiver records each event for diagnostics.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes these diagnostic event records; its code performs no other work.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.api.job.ActiveBeaconsNetworkJob
description: When a network connection is available, ProxSee runs this job to refresh active beacon data used by its beacon SDK.
disableEffect: ProxSee may stop refreshing active beacon data, so beacon-based tracking updates can be missed.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.api.job.HandshakeNetworkJob
description: ProxSee schedules this network job to perform its server handshake, immediately or on a recurring schedule when a connection is available.
disableEffect: The SDK may not complete or refresh its background connection handshake.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.api.job.NetworkJob
description: The ProxSee network scheduler runs this job when it has queued beacon entry or exit events to send to its service.
disableEffect: Without this job, queued beacon entry or exit events may not reach ProxSee, leaving visit data incomplete.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.core.detection.ble.core.intent.BLEScannerBroadcastReceiver
description: When Android delivers Bluetooth beacon scan results, ProxSee passes them to its beacon detector for processing.
disableEffect: ProxSee will stop receiving these scan results, so nearby beacons may not be detected by the SDK.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.core.detection.virtual.geofence.GeofenceBroadcastReciever
description: When ProxSee receives a geofence transition, this receiver reads the triggering location and passes it to the SDK's location processing.
disableEffect: ProxSee will stop processing geofence alerts, so location enter and exit events may be missed.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.core.detection.virtual.job.LocationJob
description: Android starts this ProxSee job with a queued location so the SDK can process a background location update.
disableEffect: ProxSee will stop processing these background location jobs, so location-based updates may be delayed or missed.

name: io.proxsee.sdk.core.detection.virtual.location.LocationManagerBroadcastReciever
description: When Android delivers a location update to ProxSee, this receiver extracts the latest location and passes it to the SDK.
disableEffect: ProxSee will not process these delivered locations, so location-based tracking may stop.

name: io.purchasely.huawei.PLYHuaweiActivity
description: Purchasely opens this Activity for Huawei AppGallery purchase or update results; it reads the result and returns the purchase state to Purchasely.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Huawei purchase outcomes from reaching Purchasely, so Huawei-billed subscriptions may fail to complete or update.

name: io.purchasely.providers.InitializerProvider
description: Purchasely's subscription SDK uses this provider during app startup to give its manager the application context needed by later SDK features.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely from receiving its startup context, so paywall and subscription features may fail to initialize.

name: io.purchasely.views.PLYActivity
description: Purchasely opens this Activity for a linked or selected presentation, such as a paywall or offer screen, and displays that presentation in the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely presentations and paywalls from opening, which can block the purchase flow shown there.

name: io.purchasely.views.PLYTVLinkActivity
description: Purchasely uses this Activity to show a URL and its QR code on a TV screen so the user can open the link on another device.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the Purchasely TV link screen, so users cannot scan that link from the TV.

name: io.purchasely.views.PLYWebViewActivity
description: When a Purchasely presentation opens a web page, this Activity displays the supplied URL in an in-app browser and routes ordinary web links outward.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely web pages or checkout links from opening, which can block part of a subscription flow.

name: io.purchasely.views.flows.PLYFlowActivity
description: Purchasely opens this Activity to display a presentation or request as an in-app flow with its own screens.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely flows from opening, so users may be unable to finish a subscription offer or purchase shown there.

name: io.purchasely.views.subscriptions.tv.PLYSubscriptionsActivity
description: On Android TV, Purchasely opens this Activity to show subscription details or the subscription cancellation screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from viewing or cancelling subscriptions through Purchasely on Android TV.

name: io.puremetrics.sdk.AppUpdateReceiver
description: When Android reports that the app package was replaced, PureMetrics checks whether the app was updated and records the installation state.
disableEffect: PureMetrics may miss app-update measurements, leaving version-change reporting incomplete.

name: io.puremetrics.sdk.NetworkAvailableReceiver
description: When network connectivity returns, PureMetrics schedules its queued measurement data for syncing.
disableEffect: Queued PureMetrics measurement data may not sync promptly when the network returns.

name: io.pushnode.android.internal.receiver.NotificationActionBroadcastReceiver
