disableEffect: Notification buttons and click or dismissal handling will not run, so linked screens and notification actions may fail.

name: ir.metrix.notification.push.NotificationAppInstaller$DownloadCompleteNotificationClickReceiver
description: Metrix starts this receiver when a user taps the notification that says an app download is complete. It opens Android’s installer for the downloaded app.
disableEffect: Tapping a completed-download notification will no longer open the installer.

name: ir.metrix.notification.push.NotificationAppInstaller$DownloadCompleteReceiver
description: When Android reports that an app file has finished downloading, Metrix checks the result and records the download. Depending on the message settings, it starts installation or posts a completion notification.
disableEffect: Metrix will not process completed app downloads, so automatic installation or the completion notification may be skipped.

name: ir.metrix.notification.push.ScheduledNotificationReceiver
description: Android triggers this Metrix receiver when a scheduled notification is due. It reads the stored message and asks Metrix to display it.
disableEffect: Scheduled Metrix notifications will not appear when they are due.

name: ir.metrix.notification.receivers.BootCompletedIntentReceiver
description: After Android finishes rebooting, this receiver tells Metrix Notification to resume its notification lifecycle and restore scheduled message handling.
disableEffect: Scheduled Metrix notifications may not resume after the device restarts.

name: ir.metrix.notification.ui.PopupDialogActivity
description: Metrix opens this Activity for a notification dialog. It displays the message, optional input fields, and buttons supplied with that message.
disableEffect: Metrix in-app notification dialogs and their button actions will not appear.

name: ir.metrix.notification.ui.TrampolineActivity
description: When a user taps a Metrix notification, this short-lived Activity forwards its action to Metrix’s notification handler and then closes.
disableEffect: Tapping a Metrix push notification will no longer run its action.

name: ir.metrix.notification.ui.WebViewActivity
description: When Metrix opens a notification link inside the app, this Activity loads the supplied web page in a browser view.
disableEffect: Web pages opened from Metrix notifications will no longer open inside the app.

name: ir.metrix.referrer.cafebazaar.communicators.broadcast.ClientReceiver
description: Metrix's referrer SDK receives Cafe Bazaar's app-install referrer response and passes it to Metrix for attribution.
disableEffect: Metrix will lose Cafe Bazaar install source data used for attribution.

name: ir.tapsell.core.internal.init.Initializer
description: Tapsell runs this provider when the app starts to initialize its core ad modules before the app requests ads.
disableEffect: Tapsell ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

name: ir.tapsell.internal.init.Initializer
description: This older Tapsell provider initializes the SDK’s ad components when the app starts, before the app requests ads.
disableEffect: Tapsell ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

name: ir.tapsell.mediation.billboard.ad.FullScreenAdActivity
description: Tapsell Billboard opens this Activity to display a full-screen ad creative and report when it closes or finishes.
disableEffect: Billboard full-screen ads will not display; rewards for watching rewarded placements will no longer be granted.

name: ir.tapsell.mediation.core.internal.init.InitProvider
description: Android runs this Tapsell Mediation provider when the app starts. It builds the mediation SDK’s core services so ad networks can be set up.
disableEffect: Tapsell mediation ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

name: ir.tapsell.mediation.core.internal.init.Initializer
description: Tapsell Mediation runs this provider at app startup to initialize its core and registered ad network modules.
disableEffect: Tapsell mediation ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

name: ir.tapsell.sdk.advertiser.TapsellAdActivity
description: Tapsell opens this Activity to show video or banner ads and lets viewers follow an ad’s web page or app action. It reports whether rewarded video was completed or closed.
disableEffect: Tapsell ads will not display; rewards for watching Tapsell rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

name: is.leap.android.aui.AUIControlReceiver
description: Leap AUI receives control messages from Leap Creator to start or stop a preview and apply project, locale, or developer-mode changes to the app’s interface.
disableEffect: Leap Creator will not be able to control AUI previews or apply these live interface changes.

name: is.leap.android.aui.LeapAUIProvider
description: Android runs this provider when the app starts to initialize the Leap AUI runtime and make its interface preview controls available.
disableEffect: Leap AUI will not initialize at startup, so screens or live previews that depend on it may fail.

name: is.leap.android.creator.LeapCreatorProvider
description: Android runs this provider at app startup to initialize Leap Creator, which supplies the app’s project-preview and connection tools.
disableEffect: Leap Creator setup will not run, so its sign-in, QR pairing, or live-preview flows may fail.

name: is.leap.android.creator.receiver.BroadcastActionReceiver
description: The Leap Creator Android SDK receiver runs when Leap's developer platform matches the app's API key, then starts a Creator session. The SDK registers this receiver at runtime; its manifest entry has no intent filter.
disableEffect: Blocking the manifest entry does not remove the runtime pairing listener or affect the app's normal screens.

name: is.leap.android.creator.receiver.NotificationActionReceiver
description: When a user chooses End Preview or Disconnect in a Leap Creator session notification, this receiver updates the notification and Creator session.
disableEffect: The notification’s session-ending action will not be handled, so a live preview or connection may not stop normally.

name: is.leap.android.creator.service.LeapCreatorService
description: Leap Creator runs this foreground service during a preview or connection session and shows an ongoing notification with a session action.
disableEffect: The Creator session may lose its ongoing notification and its normal stop or disconnect controls.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.activity.LeapOtpActivity
description: Leap Creator opens this screen when a one-time code is needed to sign in or validate a Creator account.
disableEffect: The in-app one-time-code step will not open, so Leap Creator sign-in may not complete.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.activity.LeapScannerActivity
description: Leap Creator opens this screen to scan a project or pairing QR code with the camera and connect to a preview or shared session.
disableEffect: QR-code pairing and camera-based preview setup in Leap Creator will not work.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.activity.ScannerActivity
description: The earlier Leap Creator Android SDK preview flow explicitly opens this camera activity to scan a project or sample-app QR code, fetch its preview setup, and begin on-device preview.
disableEffect: Leap Creator's QR-based developer preview sessions will no longer start through this scanner.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.debug.developer.DeveloperModeActivity
description: The Leap Creator Android SDK developer screen opens from its debug dashboard and lets developers edit SDK connection settings, project and locale details, and custom user properties. It also controls diagnostic logging and links to saved logs.
disableEffect: The SDK's developer settings and custom-property controls become unavailable; the app's regular screens remain available.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.debug.home.activity.DebugToolsActivity
description: The Leap Creator Android SDK debug dashboard opens from the SDK's developer controls and shows connection details and diagnostic-log status. It also opens setup and user-data pages and can upload SDK logs.
disableEffect: Leap Creator's troubleshooting dashboard and log-sharing controls become unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.debug.home.activity.NetworkApiDetailActivity
description: When a developer selects an API check in Leap Creator's network diagnostics, this screen shows its success or error message and the related HTTP log.
disableEffect: Developers can no longer open the selected request's diagnostic details; the app's own network requests continue.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.debug.logging.LiveLoggingActivity
description: From Leap Creator's developer settings, this screen displays recent SDK diagnostic logs and lets developers refresh the list or filter entries by type.
disableEffect: Leap Creator's saved-log viewer becomes unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.debug.projects.activity.ProjectActivity
description: This Leap Creator Android SDK screen opens the project list from the developer tools so developers can inspect the available projects.
disableEffect: The SDK's project list will no longer open; the app's regular screens remain available.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.debug.userProps.activity.UserPropertiesActivity
description: Leap Creator's user-data page shows the SDK user ID and lets developers switch between custom and default user-property lists.
disableEffect: The SDK's user-property diagnostic views become unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.preview.activity.LeapQrSecretActivity
description: Leap Creator's preview-pairing flow opens this screen when a developer enters a one-time secret instead of scanning a QR code. The screen can also open the camera scanner and submits the secret for authentication.
disableEffect: Secret-based pairing and preview setup through this screen will no longer work.

name: is.leap.android.creator.ui.preview.activity.LeapScannerActivity
description: Leap Creator's developer preview flow opens the camera scanner to read a project or sample-app QR code, fetch the preview setup, and connect the app to that preview.
disableEffect: QR-based preview setup and sample-app connection through Leap Creator will no longer work.

name: is.leap.android.logging.WfxLogContentProvider
description: The Leap Logging Android SDK provider opens a local database for SDK log entries and log-session records when Android starts the app. Leap Creator's diagnostic screens use it to read and share saved logs.
disableEffect: Leap's saved diagnostic logs and log-viewing or export tools become unavailable.

name: it.czerwinski.android.hilt.fragment.testing.HiltFragmentScenario$EmptyFragmentActivity
description: When Hilt-based fragment tests run, this Dagger Hilt testing library launches a blank host Activity with the requested theme and hosts the fragment under test.
disableEffect: Tests that use this library can no longer launch their fragment; regular app screens are unaffected.

name: it.polimi.spf.lib.AppDeregistrationReceiver
description: The SPF2 application framework receiver runs when the framework reports that this app has been deregistered, then clears the app's stored SPF access token.
disableEffect: The stored SPF access token will not be cleared when the framework deregisters the app.

name: it.sisal.bill.consumersdk.WebViewActivity
description: The Sisal Bill Consumer Android SDK opens this in-app checkout page when the host app starts a Bill payment and reports whether checkout succeeded, failed, or was canceled.
disableEffect: Customers cannot complete the Sisal Bill payment flow through this SDK.

name: jm.droid.lib.download.DefaultDownloadService
description: Jmdroid Download (Jiang Junmin) runs queued file downloads, tracks their progress and posts completion or failure notifications. The app starts it when downloads are added, resumed or restarted.
disableEffect: Downloads that rely on this Service may stop, fail to resume or lose their completion and failure notifications.

name: jm.droid.lib.download.scheduler.PlatformScheduler$PlatformSchedulerService
description: Jmdroid Download (Jiang Junmin) uses this Android job Service to restart a queued download when its network, idle, charging and storage requirements are met. Android calls it as a scheduled job.
disableEffect: Downloads waiting for suitable conditions may not restart in the background.

name: jm.droid.lib.httpmonitor.core.HttpMonitorProvider
description: HTTP Monitor (Jiang Junmin) initializes the local store for captured request and response details when the app starts. The monitor's recording layer saves traffic there for later review.
disableEffect: The monitor may stop saving requests, and apps using its traffic recorder may fail when captured data cannot be stored.

name: jm.droid.lib.httpmonitor.ui.HttpDetailActivity
description: HTTP Monitor (Jiang Junmin) displays the saved details for one recorded network request and response. It opens when the user selects an item from the traffic list.
disableEffect: The HTTP monitor will no longer open its per-request detail screen.

name: jm.droid.lib.httpmonitor.ui.HttpMonitorActivity
description: HTTP Monitor (Jiang Junmin) lists recorded HTTP traffic and lets users refresh or clear the list. The library's launcher shortcut opens this screen.
disableEffect: The saved HTTP-traffic list and its refresh and clear controls will be unavailable.

name: jm.droid.lib.mock.server.MockInitProvider
description: Mock API Server (Jiang Junmin) initializes its local mock service and connects to it automatically when the app starts. The server can supply mock responses from the app's configured test data.
disableEffect: App requests or test screens that rely on the local mock server may stop receiving their mock responses.

name: jm.droid.lib.mock.server.core.MockWebServer
description: Mock API Server (Jiang Junmin) runs a local mock-response server after its startup Provider connects to it. It loads configured test data when starting and stops the server when the service ends.
disableEffect: App requests configured to use this local mock server may fail or lose their mock responses.

name: jp.co.cyberagent.katalog.KatalogActivity
description: The CyberAgent Katalog Compose UI catalog library opens this screen when the app explicitly launches its catalog of Compose interface samples.
disableEffect: The Katalog sample catalog will no longer open; the app's other screens remain available.

name: jp.maio.sdk.android.AdFullscreenActivity
description: The maio ad SDK opens this Activity to play a full-screen video ad and report when it starts, finishes, or is skipped.
disableEffect: Maio video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

name: jp.maio.sdk.android.HtmlBasedAdActivity
description: The maio ad SDK opens this Activity to render an HTML ad and its interactive controls, including links opened when the user taps the creative.
disableEffect: Maio HTML ads will not render, and rewards tied to completing those ads will no longer be granted.

name: jp.maio.sdk.android.v2.AdActivity
description: The maio 2 ad SDK opens this Activity to display a full-screen ad using its web and video content, with controls for playback and closing.
disableEffect: Maio full-screen ads will not display, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

name: jp.maio.sdk.android.v2.PlayableActivity
description: The maio 2 ad SDK opens this Activity to show an interactive playable ad with web content, a playable view, and a close control.
disableEffect: Maio playable ads will not open, and rewards tied to completing ads will no longer be granted.

name: jp.pay.android.ui.PayjpCardFormActivity
description: PAY.JP Android Card Form opens this screen when the app requests card entry; it validates card details and returns a payment token, with optional 3-D Secure verification.
disableEffect: Card entry and checkout flows that use PAY.JP cannot complete.

name: jp.pay.android.ui.PayjpSearchCountryCodeActivity
description: This PAY.JP Android Card Form screen displays searchable countries and calling codes, then returns the selected region to the card form.
disableEffect: The phone-country selector in the PAY.JP card form will not open, which can prevent users from entering the needed country code.

name: jp.pay.android.verifier.ui.PayjpThreeDSecureStepActivity
description: During PAY.JP 3-D Secure checks, this activity opens the verification step and receives the issuer's return link so the card form can continue.
disableEffect: Card payments that require 3-D Secure verification may not complete.

name: jp.pay.android.verifier.ui.PayjpWebActivity
description: When a PAY.JP 3-D Secure check uses an in-app browser, this activity displays the web challenge and sends its return link back to the verifier.
disableEffect: 3-D Secure checks that rely on PAY.JP's in-app browser may not finish.

name: kh.com.ipay88.sdk.IPay88Activity
description: IPay88 (Cambodia) opens this payment screen during checkout or when a payment app returns to the merchant app. It displays the web payment page and handles payment redirects.
disableEffect: IPay88 checkout or payment return links may fail, so users may be unable to complete payment.

name: kin.backupandrestore.KinRecoveryFileProvider
description: When a Kin wallet backup creates a recovery QR image, this Provider exposes the app's private image file so the backup screen can display or share it.
disableEffect: The recovery QR image cannot be opened or shared from the backup flow, so Kin wallet backup cannot be completed.

name: kin.backupandrestore.backup.view.BackupActivity
description: When a user starts a Kin wallet backup, this Activity guides them through creating a password and displaying or sharing a recovery QR code.
disableEffect: Users cannot create and save a recovery QR backup through Kin.

name: kin.backupandrestore.restore.view.RestoreActivity
description: When a user starts Kin wallet recovery, this Activity lets them provide a saved recovery QR code, enter its password, and restore the wallet.
disableEffect: Users cannot restore a Kin wallet from its recovery QR code.

name: kit.activity.FragmentContainerActivity
description: When the app opens an AndroidKit page, this screen displays that page, including the media-download page.
disableEffect: App pages that rely on AndroidKit's page host will not appear.

name: kit.player.ui.activity.PlayerActivity
description: Kotle AndroidKit opens this player for a media link or item selected by the app; it plays the media and supports full-screen playback.
disableEffect: Media items opened through AndroidKit's player can no longer be played there.

name: kit.player.ui.service.PlayerDownloadService
description: Kotle AndroidKit runs this service during media downloads and keeps a persistent notification visible with the download title.
disableEffect: The AndroidKit player can no longer show its persistent download notification.

name: kr.co.bootpay.bio.activity.BioActivityInterface
description: Bootpay opens this screen for biometric card or payment flows; it shows the order and saved-card details and asks the user to confirm with fingerprint authentication.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete biometric payment or card registration and editing through this screen if disabled.

name: kr.co.bootpay.bio.activity.BootpayBioActivity
description: Bootpay opens this screen for biometric card or payment flows; it shows the order and saved-card details and asks the user to confirm with fingerprint authentication.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete biometric payment or card registration and editing through this screen if disabled.

name: kr.co.bootpay.core.activity.BootpayBioActivity
description: Bootpay opens this screen for biometric card or payment flows; it shows the order and saved-card details and asks the user to confirm with fingerprint authentication.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete biometric payment or card registration and editing through this screen if disabled.

name: kr.co.onedrop.homekit_ad_sdk.Ble.FwUpdate.DfuService

name: kr.co.onedrop.homekit_ad_sdk.Controller.Alarm.AlarmReceiver

name: kr.co.onedrop.homekit_ad_sdk.Controller.Alarm.BluetoothReceiver
description: When Android reports a Bluetooth state change, this 1drop HomeKit receiver clears connected status for the SDK's devices when Bluetooth is turned off.
disableEffect: The app may show an incorrect connection status for HomeKit devices after Bluetooth is turned off.

name: kr.co.touchad.sdk.ui.activity.advertise.AdFullActivity
description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) opens this full-screen page when a user views an ad offer; it loads the offer content and handles its web-based interactions.
disableEffect: TouchAd full-screen ads and their in-ad links will not open.

name: kr.co.touchad.sdk.ui.activity.card.CardRegisterActivity
description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) opens this page from an offer when a user chooses card registration. It lets them select a transit-card issuer, enter a card number, and submit it to TouchAd.

name: kr.co.touchad.sdk.ui.activity.webview.WebViewActivity
description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) opens this screen to display the web page supplied for an ad offer or account action, with its navigation and page controls.
disableEffect: TouchAd offer pages and other SDK web content will not open.

name: kr.co.touchad.sdk.ui.service.TouchAdService
description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) starts this foreground service for app-install offers or a deferred web link. It checks whether an advertised app was installed, reports the result for offer credit, and can open a supplied page after the user unlocks the phone.
disableEffect: Install-offer completion checks and related TouchAd credit reporting stop, and deferred pages will not open.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.AdMissionActivity
description: Motto (MobileCodit) opens this screen for a selected reward campaign. It routes ad, search, social, or website tasks to their campaign screen and returns the completion reward to the calling screen.
disableEffect: Motto campaign tasks opened here will not run, and their rewards will not be reported to the app.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.MLWebPageActivity
description: Motto (MobileCodit) opens this screen when its home content links to a page inside the app. It loads the supplied web page in the app.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.account.AccountActivity

disableEffect: Naver search campaigns opened through Motto will not complete or return their rewards.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.InstagramCampaignActivity
description: Motto opens this campaign page for an Instagram follow, like, save, or visit task. It guides the selected task and reports completion to the campaign screen.
disableEffect: Instagram reward campaigns opened through Motto will not run or return their rewards.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.SiteTrafficActivity
description: Motto opens this campaign page when a reward task asks the user to visit a website. It guides the visit and returns the task result and reward.
disableEffect: Website-visit campaigns opened through Motto will not complete or return their rewards.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.TestCampaignListActivity

disableEffect: The Motto campaign test list will not open; the regular campaign flow is separate.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.ads.AdCpcActivity
description: Motto opens this cost-per-click ad campaign when the user selects the offer. It displays the ad and reports the campaign result when the required interaction is completed.
disableEffect: Motto click-based ad offers will not open or report their campaign rewards.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.ads.AdCpvActivity
description: Motto opens this view-based ad campaign when the user selects the offer. It loads the ad, tracks the required viewing time, and reports the reward after completion.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete these ad views; rewards for watching these ads will no longer be granted.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.ads.AdNetworkActivity
description: Motto opens this campaign page to load a third-party ad-network offer. It reports the campaign reward when the ad task completes.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.human.AutoKeywordActivity

disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish these keyword-search campaigns or receive their rewards.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.human.HumanNaverActivity
description: Motto opens this page for a manually completed Naver campaign. It guides the user through the search task and returns the reward when it succeeds.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete these Naver campaigns or receive their rewards through Motto.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.human.SiteTrafficActivity
description: Motto opens this page for a manually completed website-visit campaign. It guides the visit and returns the campaign result and reward.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish these website-visit campaigns or receive their rewards through Motto.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.inapp.AutoKeywordInappActivity
description: Motto opens this in-app page for a keyword-search campaign. It guides the search task inside the app and reports the reward when the user completes it.
disableEffect: In-app keyword-search campaigns will not run or return their rewards through Motto.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.inapp.InstagramCampaignActivity
description: Motto opens this in-app page for an Instagram follow, like, save, or visit campaign. It guides the selected task and reports completion to Motto.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.campaign.inapp.SiteTrafficInappActivity
description: Motto opens this in-app page for a website-visit campaign. It guides the visit inside the app and returns the campaign reward when the task succeeds.
disableEffect: In-app website-visit campaigns will not complete or return their rewards.

name: kr.motto.mottolib.refactor.module.main.HallFameActivity

name: kr.motto.mottolib.standalone.MissionListActivity
description: Motto opens this screen to show the user's available reward missions. Selecting a mission opens its task page, and the list updates after completion.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or launch Motto reward missions from this screen.

name: kr.nectarine.android.fruitygcm.receiver.GcmNeedsUpdateReceiver
description: Nectarine Fruity checks Google Play services and refreshes push registration after the device starts or the app is replaced.

name: kr.nectarine.android.fruitygcm.receiver.GcmRegisteredReceiver
description: Nectarine Fruity saves the registration ID returned by Google push services for later message delivery.

name: kusu.chat.escape.api.network.NetworkChangeReceiver

name: kusu.chat.escape.sdk.ChatEscapeScreen
description: When the app opens Chat Escape, this Kusu Chat Escape SDK Activity connects to the chat service and shows messages and action buttons. Users can send messages or commands from this screen.

name: kz.airbapay.apay_android.ui.pages.acquiring.AcquiringActivity

name: kz.airbapay.apay_android.ui.pages.card_reader.ScanActivity

name: kz.airbapay.apay_android.ui.pages.error.ErrorActivity

name: kz.airbapay.apay_android.ui.pages.error.RepeatActivity

name: kz.airbapay.apay_android.ui.pages.external_webview.ExternalStandardFlowWebViewActivity

name: kz.airbapay.apay_android.ui.pages.googlepay.webview.GooglePayActivity

name: kz.airbapay.apay_android.ui.pages.home.HomeActivity

disableEffect: Scheduled Warply reminders and promotional notifications may not appear.

name: ly.warp.sdk.services.EventRefreshDeviceTokenService
description: After a messaging token changes, the Warply Android SDK schedules this background task to refresh device information stored by the SDK service.
disableEffect: Warply’s server-side device information may remain outdated, which can affect push or device-targeted updates.

name: ly.warp.sdk.services.FCMBaseMessagingService
description: This Warply Android SDK service receives Firebase messages, saves refreshed messaging tokens and handles Warply campaign notifications. The manifest connects it to Firebase messaging events.
disableEffect: Warply push campaigns and notifications delivered through Firebase will stop working.

name: ly.warp.sdk.services.HMSBaseMessagingService
description: This Warply Android SDK service receives Huawei push messages, saves refreshed messaging tokens and handles Warply campaign notifications. The manifest connects it to Huawei messaging events.
disableEffect: Warply push campaigns and notifications delivered through Huawei services will stop working.

name: ly.warp.sdk.services.UpdateUserLocationService
description: The Warply Android SDK runs this background location task to apply its location settings, obtain location when permitted, and send location or geofence updates.
disableEffect: Nearby and geofenced Warply offers will stop receiving these location updates.

name: ly.warp.sdk.services.WarpInAppNotificationService
description: Started by a Warply notification alarm, this service displays the scheduled notification title and message to the user.
disableEffect: Scheduled Warply in-app reminders and promotional notifications will not be displayed.

name: ly.warp.sdk.services.WarplyBeaconsRangingService
description: The Warply Android SDK scans for nearby Bluetooth beacons and reports detections to its service. Matching responses can trigger a campaign notification.
disableEffect: Warply cannot detect nearby beacons or show beacon-triggered promotions.

name: ly.warp.sdk.utils.WarplyProvider
description: The Warply Android SDK declares this Provider as an app endpoint, but its code returns no data and stores nothing. It does not provide a user-facing screen.
disableEffect: The empty Warply endpoint becomes unavailable; the app loses no screen or stored content from this Provider.

name: me.actv8.core.util.GimbalBeaconService
description: When started by ACTV8, this Service monitors Gimbal place visits and nearby beacon sightings, then sends matching observations to ACTV8’s trigger service.
disableEffect: ACTV8 place and nearby-beacon triggers will no longer be detected or delivered.

name: me.actv8.core.util.KontaktBeaconService
description: When started by ACTV8, this Service scans for Kontakt Eddystone beacons, applies a configured namespace filter when present, and sends discoveries to ACTV8 after a session is active.
disableEffect: ACTV8 nearby-beacon triggers will no longer be detected or delivered.

name: me.aravi.commons.activities.AboutAppActivity
description: Kamaravichow Commons opens this Activity when the app displays its About page; the screen uses the library’s bundled About layout.
disableEffect: The app’s About page will no longer open.

name: me.aravi.commons.activities.about.AboutAppActivity
description: Kamaravichow Commons opens this Activity when the app displays its About page; the screen uses the library’s bundled About layout.
disableEffect: The app’s About page will no longer open.

name: me.aravi.commons.activities.web.WebViewerActivity
description: The Kamaravichow Commons library opens this in-app browser when the app sends it a URL to show. It can display a page title and open the page full-screen.
disableEffect: Help pages or links routed through this screen will no longer open.

name: me.aravi.commons.base.BaseActivity
description: When an app opens a screen built on Kamaravichow Commons, this shared Activity applies the saved language and prepares the common page layout and progress display.
disableEffect: This Activity has no screen of its own; disabling it does not prevent the other Commons screens from opening.

name: me.aravi.instapi.auth.InstaAuthActivity
description: Kamaravichow’s Instagram SDK opens Instagram’s sign-in page in an in-app browser when the app starts Instagram authorization.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in to Instagram through this screen.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.AlarmBroadcastReceiver
description: When VCloud’s scheduled alarm fires, this Receiver posts a missed-call notification and sends a background heartbeat if the messaging service is active and the app was in the background.
disableEffect: VCloud’s alarm-driven missed-call notifications and background heartbeat will stop.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.MessageService
description: When VCloud starts its messaging connection, this background Service processes unsent messages, fetches offline conversations, handles incoming messages, and starts call support.
disableEffect: VCloud conversations may no longer sync or receive messages, and the call service it starts may not be brought up.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.NetReceiver
description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver network-connectivity and mobile-data state changes; it updates the chat connection and stops active call audio or video when the network is lost.
disableEffect: Chats and calls may not reconnect or stop cleanly when network connectivity changes.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.RemoteControlReceiver
description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver Bluetooth-headset connection and media-button broadcasts; it updates call audio routing and forwards headset button presses to the active call interface.
disableEffect: Bluetooth call routing and headset-button controls will stop being handled, so users may need to use calls without those headset controls.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.SdcardMountReceiver
description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver removable-storage mount, removal, unmount, bad-removal, and shared-storage broadcasts; it refreshes the SDK’s cached file directory.
disableEffect: VCloud’s cached file location will not refresh after storage changes, which can interrupt access to attachments on removable storage.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.UniversalReceiver
description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver boot, unlock, screen on/off, and network-change broadcasts; it starts VCloud’s push, messaging, and call services for background communication.
disableEffect: VCloud may stop restarting background communication services after those device events, so incoming message or call alerts may be delayed or missed.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.BeautyAdjustActivity
description: When opened from VCloud’s camera settings, this Activity shows a live camera preview and controls for adjusting the video-call beauty effect.
disableEffect: Users cannot open VCloud’s video-call beauty controls or adjust the camera effect from this screen.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.CropImageActivity
description: When VCloud’s image flow opens it, this Activity loads a selected image, lets the user adjust a crop, and saves the result to the requested output location.
disableEffect: VCloud’s image-cropping flow cannot complete, which can prevent a cropped photo from being used in a message.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.CropPhotoViewActivity
description: When VCloud’s photo flow opens it, this Activity previews a selected or captured image, crops the visible area, and returns the saved image location.
disableEffect: Users cannot crop and return a photo through this VCloud flow, interrupting photo selection or sharing.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.DialogActivity
description: When VCloud needs to explain a camera or microphone permission for a call, this Activity shows the matching permission dialog and closes after the user responds.
disableEffect: The in-app camera or microphone permission explanation cannot open, which can interrupt starting a voice or video call.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.GroupContactsAtSelectionActivity
description: When a VCloud group conversation opens its member picker, this Activity displays contacts so the user can choose people to mention in the conversation.
disableEffect: Users cannot choose group members through VCloud’s mention picker.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.ImageAllActivity
description: When VCloud opens a conversation’s image gallery, this Activity shows the image URLs supplied by the chat and returns the position of the image the user taps.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the conversation’s image grid through this VCloud flow.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.ImageChooseActivity
description: Opened from VCloud’s message composer, this Activity lets the user select photos from albums or take a new photo, then returns the selected file paths for the message.
disableEffect: Users cannot attach or capture photos through VCloud’s image picker.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.activity.ImagePreviewActivity
description: VCloud opens this Activity to preview conversation images; its menu lets the user save an image locally or forward it to another conversation.
disableEffect: Users cannot use VCloud’s image-preview, save, or forward controls for these images.

name: me.chatgame.mobilecg.call.CallService
description: Started by VCloud’s messaging and call controls, this background Service maintains one-to-one and group voice/video calls and handles live-room media.
disableEffect: VCloud calls, group video, and live audio/video sessions may not connect or continue.

name: me.chatgame.uisdk.activity.BackLiveVideoActivity
description: Opened with a VCloud live-room role and room ID, this Activity creates or rejoins the live-video view and resumes video playback as the room state changes.
disableEffect: Users cannot re-enter or continue a VCloud live-video room through this screen.

name: me.chatgame.uisdk.activity.LiveVideoActivity
description: Opened for a VCloud live room, this Activity lets hosts and viewers create or join a live video session, exchange room messages, and use live-call controls.
disableEffect: VCloud live video, room chat, and on-stage call features using this screen will fail to open.

name: me.chatgame.uisdk.activity.MainActivity
description: VCloud launches this Activity for its conversation screen; it opens one-to-one and group chats and connects the chat and call interfaces.
disableEffect: VCloud’s main chat interface cannot open, blocking conversation and call flows supplied by the SDK.

name: me.chatgame.uisdk.activity.PPTSendMsgActivity
description: When a VCloud live room opens its comment composer, this Activity lets the user type and send a message to the live conversation.
disableEffect: Users cannot send messages from the VCloud live-room composer.

name: me.codeboy.android.common.ui.CBUpdateUi
description: When the host app opens Codeboy Android Common’s update screen, this Activity displays an update title, release details, and action buttons.
disableEffect: An app that uses this screen cannot display or complete this update prompt.

name: me.daemon.infrastructure.file.FileProvider
description: Daemon369 Android Infrastructure uses this provider to expose eligible app files through private content links, including downloaded packages handed to Android's installer.
disableEffect: Blocking it breaks package installation through this library on Android 7 and later, along with other file links that rely on it.

name: me.devilsen.czxing.ResultActivity
description: When CZXing (Devilsen QR and barcode scanner) completes a scan without an app-provided result handler, this Activity shows the scanned text and lets the user copy it.
disableEffect: The scanner cannot open its built-in result screen, so scans that rely on that screen will not show or copy the result.

name: me.devilsen.czxing.ScanActivity
description: When an app starts the CZXing scanner, this Activity requests camera access and opens a camera preview to read QR codes and barcodes. It can also accept an image selected from the album and return successful scan results to the app or the SDK result screen.
disableEffect: QR and barcode scanning in the app can no longer open this scanner or return a scan result.

name: me.digi.sdk.ui.ConsentBrowserActivity
description: When digi.me opens this Activity during a consent flow, it hands the supplied web link to the browser or receives the return link and passes the consent result and authorization details back to the app.
disableEffect: digi.me consent or authorization may not return a result, preventing the related account-linking or data-sharing flow from completing.

name: me.digi.sdk.ui.GuestConsentBrowserActivity
description: During digi.me guest consent, this Activity hands the supplied link to the browser and receives the consent return link, reporting acceptance or cancellation to the app.
disableEffect: The app may not receive the guest-consent result, so the digi.me guest-sharing flow can fail.

name: me.digi.sdk.utilities.DMEResumeStateActivity
description: When a digi.me return notification is tapped after the SDK opens the digi.me app for consent or postbox creation, this short-lived Activity closes immediately to bring the host app back to the foreground.
disableEffect: The return notification cannot bring the host app back to finish the digi.me consent or postbox handoff.

name: me.drakeet.library.ui.CatchActivity
description: When CrashWoodpecker opens its crash-log viewer, this Activity lists captured crash traces and offers to share the report.
disableEffect: Crash-log browsing and sharing will be unavailable; ordinary app screens are unaffected.

name: me.drakeet.library.ui.DialogActivity
description: When CrashWoodpecker presents an error-recovery prompt, this Activity shows the supplied message and lets the user download an offered build or restart the app.
disableEffect: CrashWoodpecker’s recovery prompt will not appear; the normal app flow is unaffected.

name: me.drakeet.library.ui.PatchDialogActivity
description: When CrashWoodpecker presents a patch prompt, this Activity shows the supplied update message and offers download or restart actions.
disableEffect: CrashWoodpecker’s patch prompt will not appear; the normal app flow is unaffected.

name: me.ele.uetool.TransparentActivity
description: UETool (Ele.me) is a UI inspection tool; it opens this transparent Activity over the app to show view details, a layout grid, or spacing between elements. It is used for the tool’s inspection overlay.
disableEffect: UETool’s on-screen layout inspection tools will not open.

name: me.id.idmesocialcontacts.WebActivity
description: When ID.me Social Contacts starts a contact-connection flow, this Activity opens an embedded web page for Yahoo contact authorization and retrieval.
disableEffect: Users cannot connect Yahoo contacts through ID.me Social Contacts.

name: me.id.sdk.IDmeAuthenticationActivity
description: When ID.me authentication starts, this Activity shows sign-up and sign-in choices and hosts the selected account flow.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete ID.me sign-in or registration through this SDK.

name: me.id.sdk.IDmeHelpActivity
description: Opened from ID.me’s identity flow, this Activity displays the SDK’s help page for account or credential verification.
disableEffect: The ID.me help page cannot open, leaving that guidance unavailable.

name: me.id.sdk.camera.IDmeActivityCapture
description: When ID.me credential verification starts, this Activity opens the camera and scans an identity credential’s barcode, then returns the scan result to the SDK.
disableEffect: Users cannot scan an identity credential, so ID.me verification through this flow cannot finish.

name: me.id.webverifylib.IDmeCustomTabsActivity
description: When the app starts ID.me verification or sign-in, the ID.me Web Verify SDK opens its identity page in a browser tab.
disableEffect: ID.me verification or sign-in cannot open, so the app cannot complete that authentication flow.

name: me.id.webverifylib.RedirectUriReceiverActivity
description: When the browser returns from ID.me, the ID.me Web Verify SDK receives the redirect and returns the sign-in result to the app; it also handles the return from sign-out.
disableEffect: ID.me sign-in or sign-out cannot return its result to the app.

name: me.id.webverifylib.WebViewActivity
description: In older ID.me Web Verify flows, this screen displays the ID.me verification page inside the app.
disableEffect: The older SDK cannot open this verification screen, so its sign-in or verification flow cannot finish.

name: me.jahnen.libaums.core.server.http.UsbFileHttpServerService
description: When an app shares a file or folder from a USB drive, the libaums library serves it over HTTP and keeps an ongoing notification while the server runs.
disableEffect: The app can no longer share USB drive files through this HTTP service.

name: me.jahnen.libaums.core.storageprovider.UsbDocumentProvider
description: The libaums USB storage library makes connected USB drives available in Android's document picker and updates the listing when drives are attached or removed.
disableEffect: USB drives will not appear through this document source, so apps cannot browse, open, or save their files there.

name: me.jahnen.libaums.server.http.UsbFileHttpServerService
description: When an app shares a file or folder from a USB drive, the libaums library serves it over HTTP and keeps an ongoing notification while the server runs.
disableEffect: The app can no longer share USB drive files through this HTTP service.

name: me.jahnen.libaums.storageprovider.UsbDocumentProvider
description: The libaums USB storage library makes connected USB drives available in Android's document picker and updates the listing when drives are attached or removed.
disableEffect: USB drives will not appear through this document source, so apps cannot browse, open, or save their files there.

name: me.jessyan.autosize.InitProvider
description: The AndroidAutoSize library, originally by JessYan and also distributed in community copies, initializes the app's screen-size adaptation when the app starts.
disableEffect: The app may stop applying this screen-size adaptation, so controls and text can appear too large or too small.

name: me.leon.ext.Utils$LeonFileProvider
description: Leon406's Ade cmp-lib utility library starts this file provider during app initialization. It initializes the utility helpers and supplies shareable links for files configured by the app.
disableEffect: Utility startup and file-sharing flows that use this provider may fail.

name: me.leon.ext.android.PermissionUtils$PermissionActivity
description: Leon406's Ade cmp-lib opens this transparent screen when it requests runtime permissions, permission to change system settings, or permission to draw over other apps. It returns the user's grant or denial to the app.
disableEffect: Permissions requested through cmp-lib may not appear or return a result, which can break app features that need them.

name: me.luzhuo.lib_core.app.appinfo.CoreProvider
description: When Android initializes Luzhuo Core's file-sharing provider at app startup, it saves the app context and exposes the library's approved files for sharing with other apps.
disableEffect: Features that rely on the library's startup context or shared files may fail to initialize or share files.

name: me.luzhuo.lib_image_select.utils.VideoPlayerActivity
description: When the app opens a video from Luzhuo Image Select, this screen displays its cover image and plays the selected video with playback controls.
disableEffect: Users cannot play videos through the Image Select library's video viewer.

name: me.luzhuo.lib_qrcode.style.QRCodeStyleAActivity
description: When an app starts a scan from Luzhuo QRCode, this screen opens the camera, reads a QR code, and returns its text; it also offers a flashlight control when available.
disableEffect: The app cannot scan QR codes or return their contents through this screen.

name: me.majiajie.barcode.scanning.ScaningActivity
description: When the app starts a barcode scan, Majiajie Barcode Scanning opens a camera screen, lets the user toggle the flashlight, and returns the first detected barcode text.
disableEffect: The app cannot use this SDK screen to scan barcodes and return their text.

name: me.majiajie.rfid.RFIDSettingActivity
description: When the app opens Majiajie RFID Helper settings for a connected reader, the screen shows reader details and lets the user adjust read power or the beeper, disconnect, or return to scanning.
disableEffect: Users lose this screen for viewing or changing reader settings and disconnecting the reader.

name: me.majiajie.rfid.bluetooth.ConnectBluetoothDeviceActivity
description: When an app starts Bluetooth setup for an RFID reader, Majiajie RFID Helper lists Bluetooth devices and connects the selected OR2505 reader.
disableEffect: Users cannot select and connect an OR2505 Bluetooth reader through this screen.

name: me.majiajie.rfid.devices.ConnectOR2127Activity
description: When the app connects an OR2127 RFID reader, this Majiajie RFID Helper screen lists Bluetooth devices, connects the selected reader, and returns the connection result.
disableEffect: The app cannot connect an OR2127 reader through this screen.

name: me.majiajie.rfid.devices.ConnectOR2505Activity
description: When the app connects an OR2505 RFID reader, this Majiajie RFID Helper screen lists Bluetooth devices, connects the selected reader, and returns the connection result.
disableEffect: The app cannot connect an OR2505 reader through this screen.

name: me.nathanfallet.unlockpremium.activities.UnlockPremiumActivity
description: When the app opens an UnlockPremium offer, this screen lists premium benefits and provides options to purchase or restore in-app purchases.
disableEffect: The app cannot show this offer or start its purchase and restore flow through UnlockPremium.

name: me.philio.disqus.AuthorizeActivity
description: When an app requests Disqus authorization, Disqus for Android displays the login page in a WebView and returns the authorization result to the app.
disableEffect: The app cannot complete Disqus authorization or receive the login token.

name: me.proton.core.accountmanager.presentation.compose.SignOutDialogActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks to sign out, disable, or remove an account. It asks the user to confirm that account action.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app may not be able to complete its account sign-out, disabling, or removal flow.

name: me.proton.core.accountrecovery.presentation.compose.ui.AccountRecoveryDialogActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app starts account recovery for an account. It presents the recovery dialog and can continue to password management.
disableEffect: If disabled, account-recovery steps and the password-management handoff that use this dialog will not open.

name: me.proton.core.accountrecovery.presentation.compose.ui.PasswordResetDialogActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this dialog during account recovery when a password reset is needed. It offers the password-reset step and can open Proton's account reset page.
disableEffect: If disabled, the user may be unable to continue the password-reset part of account recovery in the app.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.AddAccountActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the user chooses to add an account. It runs the sign-in or sign-up flow and returns the result to the app.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to add another account or finish sign-in through the add-account flow.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.AuthHelpActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity from sign-in help. It offers account-recovery and support choices, including help for starting sign-in on a new device.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may lose the in-app help and recovery routes needed to regain access to an account.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.ChooseAddressActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity during new-account setup so the user can choose or confirm a Proton email address. It checks available domains and username suggestions before returning the setup result.
disableEffect: If disabled, new-account setup may not be able to finish choosing the account address.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.ConfirmPasswordActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when an account action requires the user to confirm their password. It returns whether the password check succeeded.
disableEffect: If disabled, password-confirmation steps for sensitive account actions may fail to open.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.DeviceApprovalActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity during sign-in when a new device needs approval. It presents the account's device-approval step, including member or administrator approval.
disableEffect: If disabled, sign-ins that require device approval may not complete.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.DeviceSecretActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when sign-in needs a backup password or organization-admin help. It guides the user through those account-security steps and returns the outcome.
disableEffect: If disabled, users who need a backup password or administrator assistance may be unable to finish signing in.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.LoginActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks a user to sign in. It collects the account credentials, handles the sign-in result, and returns the signed-in account to the app.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to sign in to the app or access their accounts.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.LoginSsoActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when an organization account signs in through single sign-on. It opens the identity-provider page in an in-app web view or browser tab and processes the return to the app.
disableEffect: If disabled, organization single sign-on and its return flow may not work.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.LoginTwoStepActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity for a two-step sign-in flow. It asks for the account name or email first, then the password, and can continue through supported single sign-on.
disableEffect: If disabled, users assigned this sign-in flow may not be able to access their accounts.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.SecondFactorActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity after password sign-in when the account requires two-factor authentication. It accepts a one-time or recovery code, or a security key, and returns the verification result.
disableEffect: If disabled, users who have two-factor authentication enabled may be unable to sign in.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.TwoPassModeActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity for accounts that use a separate mailbox password. It asks the user to unlock the Proton Mail mailbox after sign-in.
disableEffect: If disabled, users with a separate mailbox password may be unable to unlock their mail after signing in.

name: me.proton.core.auth.presentation.ui.signup.SignupActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the user creates a Proton account. It collects account details and password, supports recovery and verification steps, and returns the sign-up result.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to create an account through the app.

name: me.proton.core.devicemigration.presentation.DeviceMigrationActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity on the current device when the user starts an account transfer to another device. It guides the source-device side of the transfer.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to prepare or complete this device-migration flow.

name: me.proton.core.devicemigration.presentation.TargetDeviceMigrationActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity on the receiving device during account migration. It guides the new device through connecting to the existing account and returns the sign-in or migration result.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to connect a new device or finish the migration sign-in.

name: me.proton.core.devicemigration.presentation.qr.EdmQrCaptureActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when device migration needs to scan a pairing QR code. It uses the camera to read the code and can return a request for manual entry.
disableEffect: If disabled, QR-based device pairing may not work and the migration flow may not complete.

name: me.proton.core.humanverification.presentation.ui.HumanVerificationActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when Proton requires a human-verification check, such as during account creation. It presents the verification flow and returns whether it completed.
disableEffect: If disabled, sign-up or other account flows that require human verification may be blocked.

name: me.proton.core.network.presentation.ui.ProtonWebViewActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when a flow needs to show a web page inside the app. It loads the requested page and reports success, cancellation, or an error to the caller.
disableEffect: If disabled, web-based sign-in and other flows that rely on this in-app page may fail.

name: me.proton.core.notification.presentation.deeplink.DeeplinkBroadcastReceiver
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK receives an internal app link from a notification or pending intent and routes it to the matching in-app screen.
disableEffect: If disabled, notification links that use this route may stop opening their intended screen.

name: me.proton.core.notification.presentation.ui.NotificationPermissionActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks the user to enable notifications. It explains the request when needed, launches Android's notification-permission prompt, and returns the user's choice.
disableEffect: If disabled, this in-app flow cannot request notification permission, so app notifications may not be enabled from the app.

name: me.proton.core.payment.presentation.ui.BillingActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity during supported in-app checkout. It presents billing details, processes the payment, and returns the purchase result.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to complete an in-app purchase or subscription payment.

name: me.proton.core.payment.presentation.ui.PaymentOptionsActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when a purchase needs the user to choose a payment method. It lists the available options and starts the selected payment flow.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to choose a payment method or continue checkout.

name: me.proton.core.payment.presentation.ui.PaymentTokenApprovalActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when a payment provider requires a secure approval page for a payment token. It loads that page and returns whether the token is ready to charge.
disableEffect: If disabled, payments requiring this approval step may not complete.

name: me.proton.core.plan.presentation.ui.DynamicSelectPlanActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app presents its dynamic plan choices. It hosts the plan-selection page so the user can review available subscriptions.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to open the plan chooser or continue to a selected subscription.

name: me.proton.core.plan.presentation.ui.DynamicUpgradePlanActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity from a plan-upgrade link or flow. It shows upgrade options for the account and returns the selected plan and billing result.
disableEffect: If disabled, plan-upgrade links and in-app subscription upgrades may not work.

name: me.proton.core.plan.presentation.ui.UnredeemedPurchaseActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when it finds a Google Play purchase that has not yet been applied to the account. It asks whether to redeem the purchase and reports the result.
disableEffect: If disabled, a pending Google Play purchase may remain unredeemed and the related subscription may not activate.

name: me.proton.core.presentation.ui.alert.ForceUpdateActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the server tells the app that an update is required. It displays the blocking update message and can offer a learn-more link.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to continue when the service requires a newer app version.

name: me.proton.core.report.presentation.ui.BugReportActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the user chooses to report a problem. It presents the bug-report form and returns the report-submission result.
disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to submit a bug report from the app.

name: me.proton.core.userrecovery.presentation.compose.DeviceRecoveryDialogActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this secure dialog when the app starts device recovery for an account. It presents the recovery step for that user and closes or returns when the step is finished.

name: net.donky.core.messaging.rich.logic.database.RichMsgContentProvider
