disableEffect: Blocking it can leave Donky’s rich-message storage uninitialized, preventing rich messages and the inbox from loading.

name: net.donky.core.messaging.rich.ui.components.RichMessagePopUpActivity
description: When Donky presents a queued rich message as a popup, this Activity shows the message and removes it from the pending popup list when it resumes.
disableEffect: Donky rich-message popups may fail to appear or be recorded as viewed.

name: net.flow.jetpackmvvm.base.Ktx
description: FlowNetFast by Han Xiaofeng initializes shared library services as the app starts, including local storage and network and app-lifecycle tracking.
disableEffect: Disabling it skips FlowNetFast startup setup, which may break screens that rely on its saved settings or network-state updates.

name: net.gini.android.bank.sdk.capture.CaptureFlowActivity
description: When the app starts Gini Bank’s capture flow, this Activity opens the invoice capture or import screens and returns the result to the app.
disableEffect: Users may no longer be able to capture or import invoices through the app’s Gini Bank flow.

name: net.gini.android.capture.camera.CameraActivity
description: When the app starts a Gini Capture document scan, this Activity opens the camera capture screen and returns the capture result to the app.
disableEffect: The app’s Gini document-scanning flow may stop working.

name: net.gini.android.health.sdk.review.ReviewFragment$ShareWithBroadcastReceiver
description: After Android returns the result of sharing a payment-request PDF from Gini Health’s review screen, this receiver notifies the SDK so the review flow can react.
disableEffect: Gini Health may miss the share-sheet result, so its PDF-sharing flow may not finish cleanly.

name: net.gini.android.health.sdk.util.HealthSDKFileProvider
description: When Gini Health shares a payment-request PDF, this provider creates a temporary content link that lets the selected app open the file without exposing its local path.
disableEffect: The receiving app may not be able to open the shared PDF, breaking Gini Health’s sharing flow.

name: net.gini.android.internal.payment.utils.PaymentFileProvider
description: When Gini’s internal payment SDK shares a payment-request PDF, this provider creates a temporary content link for the app selected in Android’s share sheet.
disableEffect: The selected app may not be able to open the shared PDF, breaking the payment-sharing flow.

name: net.gini.android.internal.payment.utils.ShareWithBroadcastReceiver
description: After Android returns the result of sharing a PDF through Gini’s internal payment SDK, this receiver notifies the SDK so the payment flow can react.
disableEffect: The payment flow may miss the share-sheet result and fail to complete its sharing step cleanly.

name: net.gini.android.merchant.sdk.util.MerchantSDKFileProvider
description: When Gini Merchant shares a payment-request PDF, this provider creates a temporary content link so the selected app can open the file.
disableEffect: The selected app may not be able to open the shared PDF, breaking the Gini Merchant sharing flow.

name: net.gini.android.merchant.sdk.util.ShareWithBroadcastReceiver
description: After Android returns the result of sharing a PDF through Gini Merchant, this receiver notifies the SDK so the payment flow can react.
disableEffect: Gini Merchant may miss the share-sheet result and fail to complete its sharing step cleanly.

name: net.gotev.hostmonitor.ConnectivityReceiver
description: When the network changes and Gotev Host Monitor has configured hosts to check, this receiver starts a reachability check using the new connection.
disableEffect: Host Monitor may miss network-change checks, leaving apps that use its results with stale host status.

name: net.gotev.hostmonitor.HostMonitor
description: When Gotev Host Monitor is started, this service checks configured remote hosts and ports and broadcasts any change in reachability.
disableEffect: The app will no longer receive Host Monitor reachability updates and may keep using stale connection status.

name: net.gotev.sipservice.SipService
description: When an app using Feige SIP configures an account, changes registration, or places or answers a call, this service runs SIP account and voice or video call operations.
disableEffect: Incoming and outgoing SIP calls and related call controls will stop working.

name: net.gotev.uploadservice.UploadService
description: When an app queues a background file upload, Gotev Android Upload Service runs the upload task and shows its progress in an ongoing notification.
disableEffect: Background file uploads can fail or stop, preventing the app from sending files.

name: net.gouline.droidxing.CaptureActivity
description: When an app starts Droid Xing’s barcode scanner, this Activity opens the camera view, reads supported codes, and returns the scan result to the app.
disableEffect: Users may no longer be able to scan barcodes or QR codes through the app’s Droid Xing screen.

name: net.henryco.sqlightning.SQLightningTestActivity
description: SQLightning (HenryCo SQLite helper library) includes this empty test screen, which appears only when an app explicitly opens the library's test page. It does not create or manage the app's normal database screens.
disableEffect: The blank test page will be unavailable; normal app screens and database use remain available.

name: net.hockeyapp.android.ExpiryInfoActivity
description: When HockeyApp’s update manager marks the installed build as expired, it ends the current screen and opens this page explaining the expiry.
disableEffect: An app using HockeyApp’s expiry gate may lose its expiry notice or fail when the SDK tries to open it.

name: net.hockeyapp.android.FeedbackActivity
description: When a user opens HockeyApp feedback, this Activity lets them read or send messages and attach files or screenshots.
disableEffect: The app’s HockeyApp feedback and bug-report screen will no longer open; other app features can continue.

name: net.hockeyapp.android.LoginActivity
description: When HockeyApp feedback requires identity verification, this Activity collects the user’s HockeyApp email or login details and sends them to the SDK.
disableEffect: HockeyApp feedback authentication will no longer open; the app’s own sign-in flow is unaffected.

name: net.hockeyapp.android.PaintActivity
description: When a user chooses to mark up a screenshot attached to HockeyApp feedback, this Activity opens the image for drawing and returns the edited attachment.
disableEffect: Screenshot annotation in HockeyApp feedback will no longer be available; other app features can continue.

name: net.hockeyapp.android.UpdateActivity
description: When HockeyApp finds an available app update and needs a full update screen, this Activity displays the update details and download flow.
disableEffect: HockeyApp’s in-app update screen may fail to open, breaking the app’s update flow.

name: net.ilocalize.logic.screenshot.mp.MediaProjectionService
description: When the iLocalize screenshot tool starts a screen capture, this foreground Service uses Android's approved screen stream and supplies it to the capture tool.
disableEffect: iLocalize cannot capture screen images; the app's ordinary screens remain available.

name: net.ilocalize.logic.screenshot.mp.PermissionRequestActivity
description: When iLocalize requests screen-capture access, this Activity opens Android's screen-capture approval prompt and returns the choice to the screenshot tool.
disableEffect: iLocalize cannot request screen access, so screen captures that need this prompt cannot start.

name: net.ilocalize.ui.activity.EvaluateActivity
description: When iLocalize reviews one translated string, this Activity shows the current text and its source text and lets the user rate it and send a comment.
disableEffect: Single-string translation reviews and feedback cannot be submitted through iLocalize.

name: net.ilocalize.ui.activity.EvaluateAllActivity
description: When iLocalize opens an overall translation review, this Activity lets the user rate the translations and send a comment.
disableEffect: Overall translation feedback cannot be submitted through iLocalize.

name: net.ilocalize.ui.activity.ImageInfoActivity
description: When details for a saved iLocalize screenshot are opened, this Activity shows the image and the translated strings associated with it.
disableEffect: The screenshot's linked string details cannot be viewed through iLocalize.

name: net.ilocalize.ui.activity.PreviewActivity
description: When a saved iLocalize screenshot is opened, this Activity previews the image and offers access to its details.
disableEffect: Saved screenshots cannot be previewed through iLocalize.

name: net.ilocalize.ui.activity.SelectScreenshotActivity
description: When iLocalize's screenshot manager opens, this Activity lists saved screen captures and lets the user select, upload, or delete them.
disableEffect: Screenshots cannot be managed or uploaded from the iLocalize screenshot manager.

name: net.ilocalize.ui.floatwindow.FloatActivity
description: When iLocalize needs overlay access for its floating screenshot and upload controls, this Activity opens Android's permission settings and reports the result.
disableEffect: iLocalize cannot request overlay access, so its floating screenshot and upload controls cannot be enabled.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.GCMIntentService
description: In older indigitall SDK versions, this Service handles incoming Google Cloud Messaging data, shows non-silent indigitall notifications, and forwards message data to app listeners.
disableEffect: Legacy indigitall GCM messages are no longer processed or shown.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.activity.NotificationActivity
description: When an indigitall notification or action button is tapped, this Activity passes its message and button choice to the SDK so it can open the configured destination.
disableEffect: Tapping an indigitall notification or its buttons no longer opens the configured destination; the app remains available from its icon.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.broadcast.GCMBroadcastReceiver
description: In older indigitall SDK versions, this Receiver accepts Google Cloud Messaging receive and registration broadcasts for the SDK sender and hands matching messages to background processing.
disableEffect: The app no longer receives legacy indigitall GCM messages through this receiver.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.broadcast.IndigitallBroadcastReceiver
description: When Android finishes starting, this indigitall Receiver logs the boot event and the SDK's saved next-alarm time.
disableEffect: Only this startup log is lost; the receiver code does not start a service or post a notification.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.GCMIntentJobService
description: In older indigitall SDK versions, this JobService processes queued Google Cloud Messaging messages, shows non-silent notifications, and forwards push data to the app.
disableEffect: Queued legacy GCM messages are no longer turned into indigitall notifications or app events.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.GifJobService
description: While an indigitall push with an animated image remains active, this scheduled service refreshes the notification image.
disableEffect: Animated images in indigitall notifications stop updating; ordinary app screens remain available.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.GifService
description: While an indigitall push with an animated image remains active, this Service refreshes the notification image until the notification is dismissed.
disableEffect: Animated indigitall notifications can no longer update while visible.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.IndigitallInstanceIDService
description: When Google refreshes the app's Firebase push token, this Service retrieves the new token and saves it for indigitall.
disableEffect: A refreshed Firebase token is not saved for indigitall, which can prevent later push messages from reaching the app.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.IndigitallJobService
description: On scheduled background runs, this JobService checks indigitall device registration, sends changed device and push details, refreshes configuration, and schedules another check.
disableEffect: Indigitall cannot refresh push registration or configuration in the background, so its notifications and location-triggered messages can become stale or stop.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.IndigitallMessagingService
description: When Firebase delivers an indigitall push, this Service reads its data, shows non-silent notifications, and forwards the message to app listeners.
disableEffect: New indigitall Firebase messages are not processed, so their notifications and app callbacks stop.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.IndigitallService
description: When indigitall starts or refreshes its setup, this Service checks device registration, sends device and push details, retrieves configuration, and schedules later checks.
disableEffect: Indigitall push setup and scheduled refreshes no longer run, so remote notifications and related location messages can stop.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.LocalNotificationJobService
description: When the app schedules an indigitall local notification, this JobService builds and posts it from the supplied title, text, image, and action.
disableEffect: Locally scheduled indigitall notifications do not appear.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.LocalNotificationService
description: When the app asks indigitall to show a local notification, this Service builds and posts it from the supplied message text, image, and action.
disableEffect: Locally requested indigitall notifications do not appear.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.LocationJobService
description: When scheduled location checks run, this indigitall JobService starts location updates if the SDK's location settings allow them.
disableEffect: Indigitall stops collecting background location updates through this path, so location-triggered messages can stop arriving.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.LocationService
description: When indigitall's location feature is enabled, this Service starts location updates so the SDK can use changes in the device's position.
disableEffect: Indigitall stops collecting location updates through this service, so location-triggered messages can stop arriving.

name: net.indigitall.pushsdk.service.NotificationService
description: When an indigitall notification or action is tapped, this Service opens the configured app screen or link, records the interaction, and applies requested tag or dismissal changes.
disableEffect: Taps on indigitall notifications or buttons can no longer open their target or update interaction status; messages may remain visible.

name: net.mready.hover.HoverService
description: When the app asks the mReady Hover library to show a floating panel, this service places it over the current screen and adjusts it when the screen turns off, turns on, or unlocks.
disableEffect: The app's floating panels and their notifications will no longer be available.

name: net.mready.picker.FileProvider
description: The mReady PhotoPicker file provider creates a temporary content link for a photo file so the camera can save the image and the app can read it.
disableEffect: The camera mode cannot receive the file link needed to save a photo, so that photo-capture flow will fail.

name: net.mready.picker.PhotoPickerActivity
description: When the app requests a photo, the mReady PhotoPicker activity opens the camera or image gallery, processes the image size and compression, and returns the local image to the app.
disableEffect: The app's photo-selection or capture flow will not open, so users cannot attach a picture through this picker.

name: net.netheos.pcsapi.OAuth2AuthorizationActivity
description: When the app connects a personal cloud-storage account, Netheos PCS API opens this activity for the provider's web sign-in and authorization, then returns the account credentials to the app.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete sign-in for those cloud-storage providers through the app.

name: net.openid.appauth.AuthorizationManagementActivity
description: AppAuth opens the browser for an OAuth sign-in request, handles the redirect back to the app, and reports success or cancellation.
disableEffect: Sign-in flows using AppAuth will not return an authorization result to the app.

name: net.openid.appauth.RedirectUriReceiverActivity
description: This OpenID AppAuth activity receives an OAuth or OpenID Connect return link from the browser and passes it to the authorization flow.
disableEffect: Sign-in flows that rely on AppAuth browser redirects cannot complete.

name: net.qiujuer.genius.command.CommandService
description: Qiujuer’s Genius Android library starts this bound Service when the app requests a command; it runs that command in the background and returns its text output.
disableEffect: App operations that rely on Genius command execution may stop working.

name: net.qiujuer.genius.kit.cmd.CommandService
description: When the app requests an operating-system command, the Genius-Android Kit runs it in the background and returns the command output to the app.
disableEffect: Any app operation that relies on this command service will not complete.

name: net.robotmedia.billing.BillingReceiver
description: Solovyev's Android Common Library Billing receives Google Play purchase notifications and billing replies, then passes them to the app's purchase handler.
disableEffect: The app may fail to confirm purchases or update purchase status after returning from Google Play.

name: net.robotmedia.billing.BillingService
description: Solovyev's Android Common Library Billing starts this Service for purchase checks, in-app purchase requests, and transaction restoration while it connects to Google Play billing.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to make in-app purchases or restore previous purchases.

name: net.samystudio.rxlocationmanager.ContextProvider
description: RxLocationManager, a location library, starts this Provider with the app process and stores the application context used by location requests.
disableEffect: If the app uses RxLocationManager for location updates, those requests may fail because the shared application context is not initialized.

name: net.sf.sprockets.app.ContentService
description: When Sprockets is asked to change stored content, this background Service applies insert, edit, or delete requests through Android’s content resolver; it can also clear the related notification.
disableEffect: Sprockets data changes will no longer be applied, so app features that save, edit, or delete that content may stop working.

name: net.sf.sprockets.app.InitProvider
description: Android creates this Sprockets Provider when the app starts; it initializes the library’s shared components before app features use them.
disableEffect: Sprockets components may be unavailable when the app first uses them, which can break app features built on this library.

name: net.shinsoft.imagepicker.ui.ImageBaseActivity
description: Shinsoft ImagePicker uses this shared base Activity to style the status bar when its picker, crop, and preview screens are created; the library does not open it as a separate screen.
disableEffect: Disabling its standalone manifest entry leaves the picker, crop, and preview screens available because each has its own Activity entry.

name: net.shinsoft.imagepicker.ui.ImageCropActivity
description: In Shinsoft ImagePicker, this Activity opens when a selected photo is sent for cropping; it lets the user adjust the crop and returns the saved image.
disableEffect: Photo-cropping workflows that use Shinsoft ImagePicker will not open or return a cropped image.

name: net.shinsoft.imagepicker.ui.ImageGridActivity
description: When the app opens Shinsoft ImagePicker, this Activity loads image folders and lets the user choose photos, preview them, and confirm the selection.
disableEffect: The image-selection screen will not open, so app workflows that rely on this picker cannot choose photos.

name: net.shinsoft.imagepicker.ui.ImagePreviewActivity
description: When a user previews selected images in Shinsoft ImagePicker, this Activity displays them full-screen and lets the user browse and confirm the selection.
disableEffect: Users will lose the picker’s full-screen photo preview and cannot confirm selections through this screen.

name: net.tajsoft.aywa.payment.AywaGateway
description: At launch, Aywa Payment Gateway’s exported Activity displays the SDK’s simple welcome screen.
disableEffect: That screen will no longer open; in version 0.0.1 the Activity only displays a static “Hello World!” layout and starts no payment action.

name: net.take.blipchat.activities.ThreadActivity
description: The BLiP Chat Android widget opens this activity to display a support conversation in its embedded chat view. The flow also handles message attachments and location permission requests.
disableEffect: In-app BLiP support conversations and their attachment or location features may stop working.

name: net.take.blipchat.providers.BlipChatProvider
description: The BLiP Chat Android widget uses this provider to share captured photos with the chat screen through temporary file links.
disableEffect: Sending photos captured for a BLiP chat may fail.

name: net.veloxity.ble.ab.beacon.BeaconIntentProcessor
description: Veloxity’s contextual-offer SDK sends nearby beacon scan results to this background Service for processing.
disableEffect: Veloxity will miss nearby-beacon signals, reducing location-based recommendations; the host app’s own screens remain available.

name: net.veloxity.ble.ab.service.BeaconService
description: Veloxity starts this background Service to monitor and range nearby Bluetooth beacons for contextual recommendations.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s beacon detection and nearby-place signals will stop, while the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.ble.ab.service.ScanJob
description: Android runs this Veloxity job when the SDK schedules an immediate or periodic Bluetooth beacon scan.
disableEffect: Scheduled Veloxity beacon scans will not run, reducing its nearby-device context and related recommendations.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.AppUpdateReceiver
description: When Android reports that the app has been updated, this Veloxity Receiver sends the SDK’s startup request so its background service can resume.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s background tracking and offers may not resume automatically after an app update; the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.BootReceiver
description: Veloxity registers this Receiver for device boot, quick-boot, and its own startup signal. Version 6.1.9 initializes the SDK on boot; version 7.0.3 proceeds only for Veloxity’s startup signal.
disableEffect: Veloxity may not restore its contextual tracking and offer service after startup; the host app’s ordinary screens remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.DataUsageActivity
description: When Veloxity requests permission for its data-collection setup, this Activity shows the SDK’s prompt and requests phone-state and precise-location access; it reports the user’s choice and continues SDK setup.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s permission prompt and follow-up context tracking may not run, limiting its recommendations; the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.LifeCheckReceiver
description: Veloxity uses this Receiver to maintain its background schedules and respond to internal service-check, disable, and shutdown signals.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s periodic uploads, nearby-device and sensor collection, and service recovery may stop; the host app itself can still open.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.ModeReceiver
description: While Veloxity’s background Service runs, this Receiver handles requests to change location, sensor, playlist, and monitoring modes.
disableEffect: The Service also registers this handler at runtime, so disabling its manifest entry alone does not stop these SDK mode updates.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.MultilineDialog
description: Veloxity opens this Activity for a multi-line push message; it displays the supplied title, message, and response buttons.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s multi-line push prompts will not appear, but the host app’s own screens remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.NotificationOpenedReceiver
description: When a user taps a Veloxity push notification, this translucent Activity passes the notification action to the SDK and closes.
disableEffect: Tapping Veloxity notifications will no longer open their associated offer or destination; other app features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.PromotionDialog
description: When a user opens a Veloxity promotion, this Activity can show an offer dialog or web view, open a web link, or launch the promoted app.
disableEffect: Veloxity promotion screens and their links will not open; the host app’s ordinary features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.STReceiver
description: Veloxity’s background Service uses this Receiver for internal device-state, test, and promotion-widget messages.
disableEffect: The Service registers the handler at runtime, so disabling its manifest entry alone does not stop those SDK updates.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.VLagDialog
description: For a Veloxity push promotion, this Activity displays a small web-based offer with an image; tapping it opens the listed website or app-market page.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s pop-up offers and their external links will not appear; the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.VeloxityHelperService
description: Veloxity starts this foreground Service to support its main background Service; it shows a persistent notification while tracking is active and then stops.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s long-running background tracking may be interrupted or lose its required notification; the host app’s main interface remains available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.VeloxityService
description: Veloxity starts this Service for background contextual-data collection, including location, network, device-state, and usage-access changes.
disableEffect: Veloxity will lose these background signals and related location-based recommendations; the host app’s unrelated screens remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.VlxDeviceIdProvider
description: Veloxity’s contextual-offer SDK stores and returns its device identifier through this Provider so its services can recognize the same device.
disableEffect: Veloxity loses this device-ID lookup and storage path, which can reduce cross-session matching and offer relevance; normal host-app features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.core.deviceId.CoreDeviceIdProvider
description: Veloxity Core uses this Provider to store and return device records when its contextual-offer services request an identifier.
disableEffect: Veloxity Core cannot read or save these device records, which can reduce device matching for SDK recommendations; the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.customdata.CustomDataBroadcast
description: When the app sends custom attributes to Veloxity as a JSON message, this Receiver forwards them to the contextual-offer SDK.
disableEffect: Veloxity will not receive those custom attributes, so its targeting and recommendations may be less relevant; the host app’s own features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.fcm.VeloxityDefaultMessagingService
description: When Firebase delivers a device token or a data message intended for Veloxity, this Service forwards it to the contextual-offer SDK.
disableEffect: Veloxity push messages and token updates will no longer be handled by this service; the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.geofence.GeoFenceTrackingService
description: When Google Play Services reports entering, leaving, or dwelling in a monitored area, this Veloxity Receiver passes the event and location to its tracking system.
disableEffect: Veloxity will stop receiving these geofence signals, reducing location-based contextual recommendations; the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.hybrid_applist.PackageActionReceiver
description: When an app is installed or removed, Veloxity’s hybrid module refreshes its installed-app list in the background.
disableEffect: Veloxity will no longer refresh this list after package changes, which may reduce its contextual targeting; the host app’s normal features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.hybrid_core.BootReceiver
description: After device boot or quick boot, Veloxity’s hybrid module sends a signal to schedule its next contextual-score calculation.
disableEffect: Hybrid recommendation calculations may not be rescheduled after device startup; the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.hybrid_core.VlxHybridService
description: When Veloxity’s hybrid Service starts, it loads SDK settings, registers device and network context, and schedules background recommendation work.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s hybrid context collection and recommendation updates will stop; the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.hybrid_core.vskor.workManager.AlarmSetReceiver
description: When Veloxity’s hybrid alarm signal arrives, this Receiver schedules the next contextual-score calculation.
disableEffect: The hybrid module may not schedule its next background calculation, leaving recommendations out of date; the host app remains usable.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.hybrid_core.vskor.workManager.CalculateVSkorReceiver
description: When Veloxity’s hybrid scoring signal arrives, this Receiver enqueues a background recalculation and schedules the next cycle.
disableEffect: Veloxity’s hybrid recommendation score will no longer be recalculated on schedule; the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.hybrid_deviceid.VlxDeviceIdProvider
description: Veloxity’s hybrid module stores and returns its device identifier through this Provider and looks for a matching identifier in other installed Veloxity providers.
disableEffect: The hybrid module loses this shared device-ID lookup, which may reduce cross-app matching and recommendation relevance; the host app’s normal features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.locationUpload.LocationUpdatesReceiver
description: When Google Play Services delivers location updates for Veloxity, this Receiver forwards each location for background processing.
disableEffect: Veloxity will lose these background location signals and related location-based recommendations; the host app’s unrelated location features remain available.

name: net.veloxity.sdk.preferences.MultiprocessPreferences
description: Veloxity’s background processes use this Provider to read and update the SDK’s saved preferences across processes.
disableEffect: Veloxity components that share settings across processes may stop working correctly; the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.vmate.ui.HostActivity
description: When the app opens a VMate support screen, this Activity creates the SDK’s support interface and starts its support helper.
disableEffect: The in-app support center provided by VMate will not open.

name: net.youmi.overseas.android.background.receiver.PackageReceiver
description: When Android reports another app being installed or removed, the Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK processes that app for its install-task tracking. It is also registered for package replacement and keyboard-change notices.
disableEffect: App-install offers will stop receiving app-change updates, while the host app’s other screens remain available.

name: net.youmi.overseas.android.base.YoumiWebActivity
description: When a user follows a Youmi Overseas Offers Wall web link, this screen loads the supplied page inside the app and shows its title and loading progress.
disableEffect: Youmi pages that use this in-app browser will not open, but the host app’s other screens remain available.

name: net.youmi.overseas.android.ui.activity.YoumiOffersWallActivity
description: The Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK opens this screen as its offer wall. It shows available earning tasks and task records, with links to the SDK’s help and agreement pages.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse Youmi offers or their task records, while the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.youmi.overseas.android.ui.activity.YoumiReceivePointDialog
description: After Youmi reports a successful point award, this dialog displays the credited amount with a short coin animation, then closes automatically.
disableEffect: Users will no longer see this points confirmation, but the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.youmi.overseas.android.ui.activity.YoumiTaskDetailActivity
description: When a user selects an offer from the Youmi wall or task records, this screen shows its reward and required steps and lets the user start or continue a step. A successful point claim opens Youmi’s points confirmation.
disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue that Youmi offer task through this screen, but the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.youmi.overseas.offers.background.receiver.PackageReceiver
description: When Android reports an app install or removal, the Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK updates its installed-app tracking and checks whether a pending task should open that app. The receiver is also registered for boot, package-replacement, and keyboard-change notices.
disableEffect: App-install offers will no longer update their tracking or resume a waiting task app, while the host app’s other features remain available.

name: net.youmi.overseas.offers.base.YoumiWebActivity
description: When a user follows a Youmi Overseas Offers Wall web link, this screen loads the supplied page inside the app and shows its title and loading progress.
disableEffect: Youmi pages that use this in-app browser will not open, but the host app’s other screens remain available.

name: net.youmi.overseas.offers.mvp.ui.activity.YoumiMainActivity

disableEffect: Geofences may not be refreshed after system time or location-service changes.

name: org.infobip.mobile.messaging.geo.transition.GeofenceTransitionsIntentService
description: When the device enters or leaves a tracked area, Infobip Mobile Messaging processes the location transition for location-based messages.
disableEffect: Entering or leaving tracked areas may no longer trigger Infobip location messages.

name: org.infobip.mobile.messaging.geo.transition.GeofenceTransitionsReceiver
description: When Android reports that the device entered or left a tracked area, this receiver starts Infobip Mobile Messaging's background handler for the transition.
disableEffect: Geofence entries and exits may not be delivered to Infobip for location-based messaging.

name: org.infobip.mobile.messaging.interactive.notification.NotificationActionTapReceiver
description: When a user taps an interactive Infobip notification action, this receiver dismisses the notification, captures any typed reply, and sends the action to the app.
disableEffect: Notification buttons and inline replies may no longer reach the app, which can break actions offered there.

name: org.infobip.mobile.messaging.platform.MobileMessagingJobService
description: When its scheduled network job runs, Infobip Mobile Messaging retries syncing queued messages and updates after internet access becomes available.
disableEffect: Queued messaging data may not sync automatically when the network returns.

name: org.infobip.mobile.messaging.view.WebViewActivity
description: When a user opens a web link in an Infobip notification, this screen displays the page and sends supported app links to the browser or matching app.
disableEffect: Web pages linked from Infobip notifications may not open through the SDK screen.

name: org.instnt.instntsdk.view.FormActivity
description: The Instnt Android SDK opens this Activity when the app requests a configured identity form. It shows text, choice, checkbox, and date fields, then submits the entered values or reports cancellation or an error.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot collect or submit the Instnt form details.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ar.ArActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT augmented-reality Activity opens when the host app requests AR content for a channel. It starts a live camera view over that content and supports saving or sharing a screenshot.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the channel's augmented-reality view or share screenshots from it.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.MainActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT search Activity opens from the SDK entry point or Android VIEW and SEND intents. It routes shared text, links, text queries, images, and scan results to search, and provides the SDK's history and news sections.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app loses this version of the iQNECT search screen and cannot route shared or scanned searches through it.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.ScannerActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK uses this manifest alias as its public camera-search entry point. It opens the scanner Activity used in that SDK version so users can search by barcode or product image.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the iQNECT camera-search entry point through this alias.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.app.MainActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT main Activity opens for the SDK's main, Android VIEW, or SEARCH action. It routes text and image searches and supplied search results, and hosts the search home, news, history, and linked web pages.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the iQNECT search experience, history, news, or linked pages through this Activity.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.app.SearchResultActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI SDKs launch this Activity with their search-result action after a search. It displays the returned result and can open linked web content.
disableEffect: If disabled, search results from these SDK flows cannot open in their result screen.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.camera.IqKitScannerActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI camera Activity starts an image or barcode search from the live camera. It sends camera frames or detected barcodes for lookup and opens the result screen when a match is returned.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot search with the camera or view matches returned by either SDK.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.camera.ScannerActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT camera Activity can be launched for a result by its host app. It scans live images and barcodes, and also accepts a chosen gallery image for a search.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app's barcode and image-search flow cannot open or deliver its results.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.camera.ScannerFailedActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI camera flow opens this screen when a user-started scan has no matching result. It shows the submitted image with failure feedback and lets the user close the screen.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot show feedback for a scan that finds no match.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.channels.ChannelsActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this screen when the app asks the user to manage search channels. It shows active channels, lets the user reorder them or open channel selection, and saves or discards changes.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot manage the channels used by the app's iQNECT searches.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.channels.SelectChannelsActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this screen from channel management so the user can add or remove available search channels. It returns whether the changes were saved or discarded.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot offer the channel-selection step or apply the user's choices.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.coupons.CouponDetailActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this Activity for a selected coupon. It shows the coupon's title, summary, image, and details.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open the full details for an iQNECT coupon.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.coupons.CouponListActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens its wallet screen to show saved coupons. The screen can load, add, or remove coupons from the user's wallet.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app's iQNECT coupon wallet and its add or remove flow are unavailable.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.facebook.FacebookShareActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this Activity with a link, initializes Facebook if needed, and presents Facebook's share dialog.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot share iQNECT links through Facebook from the app.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.history.HistoryActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens a list of previous searches. Selecting an item runs that search again in the app.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or rerun saved iQNECT searches.

name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.web.WebActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI SDKs open a supplied page URL in an embedded browser with an optional title or full-screen view. This Activity is also used for linked result and legal pages.
disableEffect: If disabled, linked result pages, legal pages, and other in-app web content cannot open through these SDKs.

name: org.jboss.aerogear.android.unifiedpush.fcm.AeroGearFCMMessageReceiver
description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK receives Firebase Cloud Messaging data messages here and forwards their fields to the app's registered push handlers.
disableEffect: If disabled, incoming AeroGear push messages are not passed to the app, so features that rely on those messages stop updating.

name: org.jboss.aerogear.android.unifiedpush.fcm.AeroGearUPSMessageService
description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK receives Firebase data messages here and forwards them to the app's registered handlers. When Firebase issues a new device token, it also updates the token registered with UnifiedPush.
disableEffect: If disabled, AeroGear messages are not delivered to the app and refreshed device tokens are not registered with UnifiedPush.

name: org.jboss.aerogear.android.unifiedpush.fcm.UnifiedPushInstanceIDListenerService
description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK starts this Service when Firebase refreshes the device token. It sends the new token and device details to the app's UnifiedPush server so future push messages can reach the device.
disableEffect: If disabled, a refreshed device token is not sent to UnifiedPush and push delivery can stop.

name: org.jetbrains.compose.resources.AndroidContextProvider
description: JetBrains Compose Multiplatform Resources starts this Provider with the app and stores the Android app context for its resource system.
disableEffect: If disabled, Compose resource lookups that depend on this Android context cannot load their resources.

name: org.jewel.app.AppActivity
description: JewelSample opens its main app screen when the user launches it.
disableEffect: JewelSample loses its launcher screen and cannot be opened.

name: org.jitsi.meet.sdk.ConnectionService
description: The Jitsi Meet SDK registers this service with Android's call system to manage incoming and outgoing internet calls. It reports call state and connection changes to the system.
disableEffect: Jitsi call integration with Android's call controls may fail, disrupting voice or video meetings.

name: org.jitsi.meet.sdk.JitsiMeetActivity
description: The Jitsi Meet SDK opens this screen when the app asks to join a conference. It displays and runs the audio or video meeting.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to join meetings hosted through the Jitsi Meet SDK.

name: org.jitsi.meet.sdk.JitsiMeetOngoingConferenceService
description: The Jitsi Meet SDK starts this foreground service during a conference to keep the meeting active and show its ongoing-call notification while the app is in the background.
disableEffect: A Jitsi meeting may lose its ongoing-call notification or stop when the app moves to the background.

name: org.joty.mobile.authorization.ChangePasswordActivity
description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity from its password-change flow. It checks the old password when required, collects the new password twice, and submits it after both entries match.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot complete its Joty password-change flow.

name: org.joty.mobile.authorization.LoginActivity
description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity when a session needs user authentication. It collects the username and password and, when shared access is enabled, the sharing key before continuing login.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot sign in through the Joty login flow.

name: org.joty.mobile.gui.ServerUrlActivity
description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity during startup to load the configured start page and read the application server address from it, then initializes the connection.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app may not resolve its service address or finish connecting at startup.

name: org.joty.mobile.gui.StartUrlActivity
description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity when the starting server address must be entered or changed. The user can enter a URL, which the SDK saves before continuing its startup connection flow.
disableEffect: If disabled, the user cannot set the start address needed for the app's Joty connection flow.

name: org.jraf.android.androidwearcolorpicker.ColorPickActivity
description: BoD's Android Wear Color Picker library opens this Activity through its result contract. It displays a color picker seeded with an optional existing color and returns the selected color.
disableEffect: If disabled, users of the color-selection flow cannot open the picker or return a chosen color.

name: org.jun1or.dwebview.fragment.WebViewDownloadCompleteReceiver
description: When Android finishes a WebView download that matches the one recorded by Jun1or DWebView, this component opens the file in an app that can handle it.
disableEffect: Web downloads can finish, but matching files will no longer open automatically.

name: org.kin.sdk.spend.view.PaymentFlowActivity
description: When Kin is asked to process an invoice payment, this Activity presents the confirmation and progress screens and returns the result to the calling app.
disableEffect: The app cannot complete invoice payments through Kin's payment flow.

name: org.kustom.api.dashboard.DashboardActivity
description: Frank Monza’s Kustom Dashboard API opens the skin pack dashboard when the host app launches it. It lists the pack’s preset pages and, when configured, its wallpaper collection.
disableEffect: Users would lose this skin pack's dashboard for browsing presets and any configured wallpapers.

name: org.kustom.api.dashboard.ImagePreviewActivity
description: When a user selects a wallpaper from the dashboard, Frank Monza’s Kustom Dashboard API opens this screen. It loads the image and offers controls to apply it or save it when downloads are enabled.
disableEffect: Users could no longer preview, apply, or save wallpapers from the dashboard.

name: org.librarysimplified.audiobook.views.mediacontrols.PlayerMediaButtonReceiver
description: The Palace Project's Library Simplified audiobook SDK receives Android media-button presses and forwards them to the audiobook playback session.
disableEffect: Headphones and other media buttons can no longer control audiobook playback.

name: org.librarysimplified.audiobook.views.mediacontrols.PlayerService
description: The Palace Project's Library Simplified audiobook SDK creates a media session that lets Android playback controls and connected devices control audiobook playback, including in the background.
disableEffect: System playback controls and connected devices cannot control audiobook playback through this session.

name: org.ligboy.selectphoto.CropImageActivity
description: After a photo is chosen or captured through Ligboy's SelectPhoto image picker, this Activity lets the user crop or rotate it and returns the edited image.
disableEffect: Photo flows that require cropping cannot finish through SelectPhoto.

name: org.ligboy.selectphoto.SelectImageActivity
description: When an app asks the user to choose a photo, Ligboy's SelectPhoto image picker offers camera capture or the device's image picker and returns the selected image, cropping it when requested.
disableEffect: The app cannot use SelectPhoto to choose or capture a photo.

name: org.ligboy.selectphoto.SpFileProvider
description: When Ligboy's SelectPhoto captures a new photo, this Provider gives the camera app temporary access to write the image into the host app's cache.
disableEffect: Camera capture through SelectPhoto fails because the camera cannot write the photo to the app's cache.

name: org.maplibre.android.plugins.offline.offline.OfflineDownloadService
description: When a MapLibre offline-map download starts or is canceled, this Service creates or removes the map area, tracks progress, and updates the download notification.
disableEffect: Users cannot download or cancel offline map areas through this plugin.

name: org.maplibre.android.plugins.offline.ui.OfflineActivity
description: When an app asks the user to save a map area for offline use, this Activity opens MapLibre's region picker and returns the selected area and name.
disableEffect: The app cannot let users select map areas for offline download through this plugin.

name: org.maplibre.navigation.android.navigation.ui.v5.MapLibreNavigationActivity
description: When an app starts a route with MapLibre Navigation, this Activity opens the turn-by-turn screen and begins guidance for that route.
disableEffect: MapLibre route guidance cannot open its navigation screen.

name: org.maplibre.navigation.android.navigation.ui.v5.notification.service.NavigationNotificationService
description: During MapLibre Navigation guidance, this Service keeps a foreground notification with route progress and updates it as the route advances.
disableEffect: Users lose the ongoing route-progress notification during MapLibre guidance.

name: org.matrix.android.sdk.api.session.file.MatrixSDKFileProvider
description: The Matrix.org Matrix Android SDK 2 registers this Provider to expose cached downloads to file-sharing flows and report each file's type. Android makes it available under the SDK's file authority.
disableEffect: Disabling it can break sending or opening cached attachments in Matrix chats.

name: org.meetsl.snetbus.receiver.NetStateChangeReceiver
description: On Android versions before 5.0, SNetBus updates the shared network status when Android reports a connectivity change.
disableEffect: Apps that rely on SNetBus for network status will stop receiving these connectivity updates.

name: org.microg.gms.cast.CastDeviceControllerService
description: The microG GmsCore Cast device service connects an app to its selected receiver and relays playback controls, volume, device status, and messages. It starts when an app asks to control a Cast device.
disableEffect: Apps using Cast may be unable to connect to, control, or receive status from a receiver.

name: org.microg.gms.crossprofile.CrossProfileRequestActivity
description: During Android work-profile setup, this microG GmsCore screen requests access to settings shared from the personal profile, then stores the permission returned by Android.
disableEffect: microG will not automatically connect shared settings between the work and personal profiles.

name: org.microg.gms.crossprofile.CrossProfileSendActivity
description: When work-profile setup requests shared settings, this microG GmsCore screen returns a read-only settings link from the personal profile with permission for the work profile to keep using it.
disableEffect: The work profile may not be able to access the shared microG settings it needs.

name: org.microg.gms.crossprofile.UserInitReceiver
description: When Android initializes a managed work profile, this microG GmsCore receiver opens the cross-profile setup screen so that shared settings can be connected.
disableEffect: New work profiles will not automatically start microG's shared-settings setup.

name: org.microg.gms.droidguard.core.DroidGuardService
description: The microG GmsCore DroidGuard service answers app bindings for device checks and processes ping requests by preparing app-specific diagnostic data for a server check.
disableEffect: Apps that rely on microG DroidGuard checks may fail their security or verification step.

name: org.microg.gms.fido.core.privileged.Fido2PrivilegedService
description: When a privileged FIDO2 client connects, this microG GmsCore service provides credential lookup and passkey registration or sign-in actions.
disableEffect: Passkey registration or sign-in flows that use the privileged FIDO2 service may fail.

name: org.microg.gms.fido.core.regular.Fido2AppService
description: When an app connects for FIDO2, this microG GmsCore service provides WebAuthn passkey registration and sign-in actions to the app.
disableEffect: Apps may be unable to register or use passkeys for sign-in.

name: org.microg.gms.fido.core.ui.AuthenticatorActivity
description: When a FIDO2 request opens this microG GmsCore screen, it handles passkey or security-key registration and sign-in, then returns the credential result to the app.
disableEffect: Apps may be unable to complete passkey or security-key registration and sign-in.

name: org.microg.gms.fido.core.ui.hybrid.HybridAuthenticateActivity
description: When a WebAuthn link starts a phone-as-security-key session, this microG GmsCore screen requests Bluetooth access, connects to the other device, and handles credential creation or sign-in.
disableEffect: Phone-as-security-key registration and sign-in flows may not complete.

name: org.microg.gms.gmscompliance.GmsDeviceComplianceService
description: When an app requests a GMS device-compliance result, microG GmsCore returns a successful response that marks the device compliant.
disableEffect: Apps that require this compliance response may reject the device or block sign-in and other protected features.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.core.ui.ExposureNotificationsConfirmActivity
description: When an app asks the user to enable Exposure Notifications, this microG GmsCore screen identifies the requesting app and requests required Bluetooth and location permissions.
disableEffect: Apps may be unable to obtain user approval and activate Exposure Notifications.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.core.ui.ExposureNotificationsSettingsActivity
description: When the user opens Exposure Notifications settings, this microG GmsCore screen displays the controls for managing that feature.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to open or change Exposure Notifications settings through this screen.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.AdvertiserService
description: While Exposure Notifications monitoring is enabled, this microG GmsCore service broadcasts temporary Bluetooth identifiers so participating nearby devices can detect encounters.
disableEffect: The device will stop broadcasting encounter identifiers, reducing exposure detection.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.CleanupService
description: When Exposure Notifications data needs maintenance, microG GmsCore runs daily cleanup of stored diagnosis keys and encounter records.
disableEffect: Expired exposure records may remain stored longer and use additional space.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.ExposureFileProvider
description: When an app shares exported Exposure Notifications files, this microG GmsCore provider grants temporary access to the configured files.
disableEffect: Apps may be unable to open or share exposure-key files provided through this route.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.ExposureNotificationService
description: When an app connects to the Exposure Notifications API, microG GmsCore handles monitoring, diagnosis-key, status, and exposure-summary requests.
disableEffect: Apps will lose access to Exposure Notifications monitoring and exposure-reporting features.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.NotifyService
description: When Exposure Notifications cannot run because Bluetooth, location, or required nearby permissions are off, this microG GmsCore service shows a warning and refreshes it when those settings change.
disableEffect: Warnings that explain why exposure monitoring is unavailable will no longer appear.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.ScannerService
description: While exposure monitoring is enabled, this microG GmsCore service scans for participating devices' Bluetooth broadcasts and records rotating identifiers used to detect encounters.
disableEffect: The device will stop detecting nearby encounter broadcasts, so exposure matching may miss contacts.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.ServiceInfoReceiver
description: When an app requests configuration from the older microG GmsCore Exposure Notifications service, this receiver saves any submitted settings and sends the current configuration back.
disableEffect: Apps using this older setup flow may be unable to read or update Exposure Notifications configuration.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.ServiceTrigger
description: After device startup, app replacement, or package restart, this microG GmsCore receiver checks which exposure-monitoring background services are needed and starts them again.
disableEffect: Exposure monitoring may not resume automatically after a reboot or app restart.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.ui.ExposureNotificationsConfirmActivity
description: When an app asks the user to enable Exposure Notifications, this microG GmsCore screen identifies the requesting app and requests required Bluetooth and location permissions.
disableEffect: Apps may be unable to obtain user approval and activate Exposure Notifications.

name: org.microg.gms.nearby.exposurenotification.ui.ExposureNotificationsSettingsActivity
description: When the user opens Exposure Notifications settings, this microG GmsCore screen displays the controls for managing that feature.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to open or change Exposure Notifications settings through this screen.

name: org.microg.gms.oss.licenses.core.OssLicensesService
description: When an app requests information for its open-source notices, microG GmsCore returns the submitted license entries sorted by name.
disableEffect: The app may not be able to retrieve or display its open-source license list.

name: org.microg.gms.recaptcha.RecaptchaService
description: When an app requests reCAPTCHA verification, this microG GmsCore service routes the request to an available web-challenge or device-check implementation.
disableEffect: Apps that require reCAPTCHA for sign-in or abuse prevention may not complete verification.

name: org.microg.gms.safetynet.ReCaptchaActivity
description: When a SafetyNet reCAPTCHA challenge opens, this microG GmsCore screen loads the challenge in an in-app browser and returns the response to the requesting app.
disableEffect: Apps waiting for this reCAPTCHA response may not complete sign-in or other protected actions.

name: org.microg.gms.safetynet.SafetyNetClientService
description: When an app connects to SafetyNet, microG GmsCore handles device-attestation and reCAPTCHA verification requests and returns their results.
disableEffect: Apps that rely on SafetyNet checks or verification may reject the device or block a protected flow.

name: org.microg.gms.settings.SettingsProvider
description: Apps and microG GmsCore services use this provider to read and update saved check-in, messaging, authentication, location, exposure-notification, and profile settings.
disableEffect: GmsCore features that depend on these settings may lose saved options or fail when reading them.

name: org.microg.nlp.api.MPermissionHelperActivity
description: When a UnifiedNlp backend needs runtime permissions, microG UnifiedNlp uses this screen to show Android's permission request and report whether all requested permissions were granted.
disableEffect: A backend may not obtain required permissions, so its location or geocoding feature can stop working.

name: org.microg.nlp.geocode.v1.GeocodeService
description: When Android requests address lookup, this microG UnifiedNlp service connects the v1 geocoder to the selected backend and returns forward or reverse geocoding results.
disableEffect: Address searches based on place names or coordinates may stop working through this geocoder.

name: org.microg.nlp.location.v2.LocationService
description: When Android requests network-based location, this microG UnifiedNlp v2 service connects to configured location backends and supplies their location results.
disableEffect: Apps that depend on UnifiedNlp network location may receive no location updates.

name: org.microg.nlp.location.v3.LocationService
description: When Android requests network-based location through its v3 provider interface, this microG UnifiedNlp service supplies results from configured location backends.
disableEffect: Apps using the UnifiedNlp v3 network-location interface may receive no location updates.

name: org.microg.nlp.service.GeocodeService
description: When UnifiedNlp clients request forward or reverse geocoding, this microG service routes the lookup to the configured geocoding backends and returns matching addresses.
disableEffect: Clients using UnifiedNlp will lose address lookup through their configured geocoders.

name: org.microg.nlp.service.LocationService
description: When UnifiedNlp clients request current or last-known network location, this microG service coordinates the configured location backends and returns their results.
disableEffect: Clients depending on UnifiedNlp location backends may stop receiving network-based location.

name: org.microg.nlp.service.PackageChangedReceiver
description: When Android reports that an app package changed, was removed, or restarted, microG UnifiedNlp checks whether it is a selected location or geocoding backend and reloads the service if needed.
disableEffect: UnifiedNlp may keep stale backend selections after a provider is changed or removed, disrupting location or geocoding.

name: org.microg.nlp.service.UnifiedLocationServiceEntryPoint
description: When an older UnifiedNlp client requests the combined location service, this microG entry service connects it to the configured location and geocoding backends.
disableEffect: Older clients using the combined UnifiedNlp service may lose network location and geocoding.

name: org.mozilla.gecko.GeckoClipboardContentProvider
description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) uses this provider to serve copied images and other rich items when another app reads them from Android’s clipboard.
disableEffect: Copied images and other rich items may not paste into other apps, although plain text copying can still work.

name: org.mozilla.gecko.crashhelper.CrashHelper
description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) starts this service when one of its browser processes crashes so it can create a crash report from the saved crash data.
disableEffect: Browsing can continue, but GeckoView may no longer save a report when one of its processes crashes.

name: org.mozilla.gecko.media.MediaManager
description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) binds this service when a page needs Android media codecs or DRM support. It creates the codec and protected-media sessions used for playback.

name: org.mozilla.gecko.process.GeckoChildProcessServices$gmplugin

name: org.mozilla.gecko.process.GeckoChildProcessServices$gpu

name: org.mozilla.gecko.process.GeckoChildProcessServices$ipdlunittest
description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) includes this service for developer tests that check communication between its processes; it runs when those tests request it.
disableEffect: GeckoView process-communication tests that need this service will not run; normal browsing is unaffected.

name: org.mozilla.gecko.process.GeckoChildProcessServices$zygoteTab

name: org.multipaz.compose.prompt.PresentmentActivity
description: When an app starts Multipaz's credential-presentation flow, this screen shows connection, sharing, waiting, and failure prompts while a digital identity credential is presented to a reader.

name: org.myguide.sdk.FloatingViewService
description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK starts this service to show a movable shortcut while guides are available. Tapping the shortcut opens the guide home screen for signed-in users.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the floating shortcut used to open MyGuide guides.

name: org.myguide.sdk.OverlayViewService
description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK starts this service during a screen walkthrough. It displays guide steps over the app and lets the user move through or close them.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents MyGuide interactive walkthroughs from appearing.

name: org.myguide.sdk.feature.details.activity.MGGuideDetailActivity
description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK opens this screen when someone selects a guide. It shows the guide title and details before playback.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening MyGuide guide details.

name: org.myguide.sdk.feature.home.view.MGHomeDialogActivity
description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK opens this full-screen home screen so users can browse available guides.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the MyGuide guide list.

name: org.n.account.core.data.DbProvider
description: This Machbird Account provider stores account, profile, and shared data in the app's local database for the SDK's account screens.
disableEffect: Machbird account and profile flows will not be able to read or update their saved local data.

name: org.n.account.ui.view.CropPhotoActivity
description: When a user changes the Machbird account photo, this screen lets them crop the selected image and return the finished picture.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to crop a new account photo through Machbird.

name: org.n.account.ui.view.EditContentActivity
description: This Machbird Account screen edits profile text, education, address, or interests and returns the changes to the profile page.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to edit these Machbird account profile details.

name: org.n.account.ui.view.EmailRegisterActivity
description: This Machbird Account page supports email registration by sending and checking verification codes before continuing.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete email registration through this Machbird page.

name: org.n.account.ui.view.LoginActivity
description: This is the Machbird Account sign-in screen, with Google, Facebook, phone, and email sign-in options.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open this Machbird Account sign-in screen.

disableEffect: Machbird's background user and device information requests will not run.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.AboutActivity
description: The About screen in Samagra's ODK Collect client opens from the app menu and lists the project website, community forum, sharing and review links, and open-source licenses.
disableEffect: You will lose the About page and its links and license list.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.BearingActivity
description: When an ODK Collect form asks for a compass bearing, this screen reads the device compass sensors and returns the measured direction to the form. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: Compass-bearing questions in forms will no longer be answerable.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.CrashHandlerActivity
description: After ODK Collect detects a crash from an earlier run during startup, this screen shows the crash recovery view and can return the user to the main menu. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: The crash recovery screen and its route back to the main menu will be unavailable after a detected crash.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.DeleteSavedFormActivity
description: Choosing Manage Files in Samagra's ODK Collect client opens tabs for saved data and forms so users can review and manage them.
disableEffect: You will lose the in-app screen for managing saved data and forms.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FirstLaunchActivity
description: When ODK Collect has no project configured, this first-run screen lets the user set one up with a QR code, configure it manually, or continue with the demo project. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: A new or unconfigured ODK Collect installation will have no setup screen for creating or selecting a project.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FormChooserList
description: When another app asks Samagra's ODK Collect client to choose or open a form, this entry opens the available-form list and returns or opens the selected form.
disableEffect: Other apps will no longer be able to use ODK Collect's form chooser entry point.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FormDownloadList
description: When ODK Collect is asked to open its form-download screen, this entry routes the user to the list of forms available from the configured server. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: The form-download screen will no longer open through ODK Collect's external entry point.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FormDownloadListActivity
description: From Get Forms or an external request, Samagra's ODK Collect client lists forms on the configured server and downloads the selected forms and their media.
disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to browse and download forms from the configured server.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FormEntryActivity
description: After a user selects a form or opens a saved response, Samagra's ODK Collect client displays its questions, accepts answers, and saves form progress.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to fill in, edit, or review forms through this screen.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FormHierarchyActivity
description: While a form is open in ODK Collect, this screen shows its question and group hierarchy so the user can jump directly to a section. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: Users will lose the form's question and group navigation view.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FormMapActivity
description: From the map control beside a form, ODK Collect shows that form's mapped records; selecting a record opens it for editing, while the map can also start a new record. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: Users will lose the map-based way to locate, edit, or start records for a form.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.InstanceChooserList
description: From Review Data or View Sent Forms, Samagra's ODK Collect client lists saved responses; choosing one opens it for editing or review, or returns it to an app that requested a selection.
disableEffect: Users will lose the saved-response chooser used for reviewing, editing, and selecting records.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.InstanceUploaderActivity
description: After selected responses are sent for submission, this ODK Collect screen uploads them to the configured server and reports the result. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: The server-upload step for selected form responses will no longer work.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.InstanceUploaderList
description: When another app opens ODK Collect's send-data screen, this entry routes the user to the list of saved responses awaiting submission. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: Other apps will no longer be able to open ODK Collect's send-data list through this entry.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.InstanceUploaderListActivity
description: From Send Data, Samagra's ODK Collect client lists saved responses, lets users select records, and submits them to the configured server or Google Sheets.
disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to select and submit saved responses from the app.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.MainMenuActivity
description: When Samagra's ODK Collect client launches, this main menu opens the project and provides routes to enter, review, send, and download form data and manage files.
disableEffect: The app's main screen and its routes to core form workflows will be unavailable.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.ScannerWithFlashlightActivity

disableEffect: Barcode questions in forms will no longer be answerable with the built-in scanner.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.ViewOnlyFormHierarchyActivity

disableEffect: Users will lose the read-only hierarchy view for reviewing a form.

name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.WebViewActivity

name: org.odk.collect.android.configure.qr.QRCodeTabsActivity

disableEffect: Users will lose the QR-based project configuration and sharing screen.

name: org.odk.collect.android.draw.DrawActivity

disableEffect: Users will lose the drawing and image-annotation answer option in forms.

name: org.odk.collect.android.external.AndroidShortcutsActivity
description: When Android asks ODK Collect to create a shortcut, this screen lets the user choose a form and returns a shortcut that opens it. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to create home-screen shortcuts for individual forms.

name: org.odk.collect.android.external.FormUriActivity

name: org.odk.collect.android.external.FormsProvider

name: org.odk.collect.android.external.InstanceProvider

disableEffect: Integrated apps will no longer be able to access or manage saved responses through this provider.

name: org.odk.collect.android.formlists.blankformlist.BlankFormListActivity

disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to choose a blank form and start a new response from the app.

name: org.odk.collect.android.gdrive.GoogleDriveActivity

name: org.odk.collect.android.gdrive.GoogleSheetsUploaderActivity

name: org.odk.collect.android.preferences.screens.ProjectPreferencesActivity

name: org.odk.collect.androidshared.ui.ReturnToAppActivity

name: org.odk.collect.audiorecorder.recording.AudioRecorderService

name: org.odk.collect.entities.EntityBrowserActivity

name: org.odk.collect.errors.ErrorActivity

name: org.odk.collect.geo.geopoint.GeoPointActivity

disableEffect: Location-point questions will no longer be answerable with this built-in location screen.

name: org.odk.collect.geo.geopoint.GeoPointMapActivity

name: org.odk.collect.geo.geopoly.GeoPolyActivity

name: org.opencv.samples.tutorial1.Tutorial1Activity

disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV camera tutorial will no longer open.

name: us.zoom.internal.SDKWBDashBoardActivity
