disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting whiteboard dashboard or start a board from it.

name: us.zoom.internal.SDKWhiteBoardActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens a whiteboard or a specific board in a meeting. It displays the board dashboard or selected whiteboard canvas.
disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue using whiteboards in a meeting.

name: us.zoom.internal.helper.PrivacyDisclaimerActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when it needs to show a privacy disclosure for a feature. It displays the notice and lets the user respond before continuing.
disableEffect: A feature that requires this disclosure may not be able to continue because its notice cannot be shown.

name: us.zoom.meeting.inperson.ZmOfflineMeetingActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity for its in-person meeting flow. It displays that meeting screen and handles its permission and return events.
disableEffect: The SDK in-person meeting flow will be unavailable.

name: us.zoom.plist.view.PListActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user views the participants in a meeting. It displays the meeting participant list and its available controls.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting participant list.

name: us.zoom.uicommon.activity.ZMFileListActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user selects a file for a meeting or chat action. It lists files of the requested types and returns the chosen file.
disableEffect: Users cannot select files through the SDK file picker for meeting or chat sharing.

name: us.zoom.zmeetingmsg.MeetPhotoPickerActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user adds a photo to a chat message. It lets the user choose a photo to attach.
disableEffect: Users cannot choose photos to attach to Zoom chat messages.

name: us.zoom.zmeetingmsg.MeetingChatActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens a meeting chat conversation. It displays the conversation thread and its messages.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting chat conversation.

name: us.zoom.zmeetingmsg.MeetingCommentActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens comments on a message in meeting chat. It displays the selected comment thread.
disableEffect: Users cannot open comments on meeting chat messages.

name: us.zoom.zmeetingmsg.MeetingImageEditorActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user edits a picture before sending it in meeting chat. It provides the image-editing screen for the selected picture.
disableEffect: Users cannot edit pictures in meeting chat before sending them.

name: us.zoom.zmeetingmsg.MeetingImageEditorCropActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user crops a picture for a meeting chat message. It displays the crop controls for that picture.
disableEffect: Users cannot crop pictures with the meeting chat editor.

name: us.zoom.zmeetingmsg.MeetingImageListActivity
description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user browses images in a meeting chat conversation. It displays the conversation image list.
disableEffect: Users cannot browse the image list from meeting chat.

name: uuxia.com.library.ui.DefaultErrorActivity
description: The CustomOnCrash crash-reporting library shows this screen after routing an app error to its handler; it displays error details and offers restart, copy, and email actions.
disableEffect: The crash details and recovery screen will not appear after an app error; normal app use is unaffected.

name: uuxia.het.com.library.DaemonReceiver
description: The AppDaemon background-service library receives its restart broadcast in a separate process and starts the configured service when the broadcast requests recovery.
disableEffect: AppDaemon will no longer restart the configured service in response to that broadcast.

name: uuxia.het.com.library.DaemonService
description: The AppDaemon background-service library runs this service in its own process, checks whether a configured service is alive, and starts it again when missing.
disableEffect: Apps relying on AppDaemon to keep a background service running may lose its automatic restart.

name: uz.ipakyulibank.acqlib.library.Lib
description: Ipak Yuli Bank's acquiring library opens this screen with a field for entering a bank-card number.
disableEffect: The app's card-entry or acquiring screen will not open.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.BrowserActivity
description: MetaOne Wallet SDK opens this Activity for wallet browsing and links; it displays websites, connects a selected wallet, and lets users review requests to sign.
disableEffect: Users will lose the SDK's browser and its wallet-link signing flows.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.ConfirmTransactionActivity
description: This MetaOne Wallet Activity appears when the SDK asks the user to review a wallet transaction; it displays the request and handles confirmation or cancellation.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to approve or reject transactions through this confirmation screen.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.CreateSignatureActivity
description: When a MetaOne wallet needs a new authorization code, this Activity guides the user through setting and confirming it.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish the SDK's wallet-code setup flow.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.CustomSendDialogHostActivity
description: When MetaOne receives a token-send request, this Activity shows the amount, destination, and network details for the user to approve or reject.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or confirm token sends through this screen.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.CustomTxDialogHostActivity
description: When a website requests a contract transaction in MetaOne's browser, this Activity shows transaction and network details so the user can approve or reject it.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or confirm browser contract transactions through this screen.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.DialogHostActivity
description: When the MetaOne browser receives a contract-transaction request, this Activity shows its details for the user to approve or reject.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or confirm these browser transactions through this screen.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.HomeActivity
description: The older MetaOne SDK home screen offers a way into the wallet and lets users choose a light, dark, or blue appearance.
disableEffect: Users lose this optional home and theme screen; the wallet itself has a separately registered screen.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.ResetSignatureActivity
description: When a MetaOne user changes the wallet authorization code, this Activity guides the user through entering and confirming the replacement.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete the SDK's wallet-code reset flow.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.SignFailedActivity
description: After an SDK signing request fails, this Activity displays the failure result and lets the user return to the wallet.
disableEffect: Users will lose the visible failure result for a signing request.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.SignMessageActivity
description: When a website asks MetaOne to sign a message, this Activity presents the request for the user to approve or cancel.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or approve message-signing requests.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.SignSuccessActivity
description: After MetaOne completes a signing request, this Activity displays a success result and returns the user to the wallet.
disableEffect: Users will lose the visible completion result for a signing request.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.VerifyEmailActivity
description: When MetaOne requires email verification, this Activity lets users complete the email-check step for their account.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish the SDK's email verification flow.

name: ventures.aag.metaonesdk.activities.WalletActivity
description: MetaOne Wallet SDK opens this Activity to show its wallet interface and handle web-page navigation and file selection within the wallet.
disableEffect: Users will lose access to the SDK's wallet screen and its in-wallet web interactions.

name: vk.adnetwork.activity.OfferwallActivity
description: When the app opens the InAd Network offer wall, this Activity loads promoted app offers and lets users open the advertised app or page; it also records clicks and checks completed installs.
disableEffect: The offer wall and its install offers disappear, and users will no longer earn credits for completing those offers.

name: vk.adnetwork.receiver.OfferwallReceiver
description: At scheduled InAd offer checks, this Receiver starts a background check when the network is available or schedules another check when it is not.
disableEffect: InAd’s background offer-install checks stop, so completed offers may not be credited.

name: vk.adnetwork.receiver.PackageAddedReceiver
description: When Android reports that a new app was installed, this InAd Receiver starts a check to see whether the install completes a promoted app offer.
disableEffect: InAd may miss completed app-install offers and fail to award their credits.

name: vk.adnetwork.receiver.PackageRemovedReceiver
description: When Android reports that an app was uninstalled, this InAd Receiver removes the matching app from the offer wall’s saved install records.
disableEffect: The offer wall may retain stale records for apps that have been removed, making offer status inaccurate.

name: vk.adnetwork.service.CheckInstalledAppService
description: InAd checks whether apps saved from its offer wall have been installed, reports completed installs, and sends the related offer-credit event to the app.
disableEffect: InAd will no longer verify or credit app-install offers.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.common.OpenWebviewActivity
description: The myG game SDK opens a titled web page inside its account flow, including the password-change page from sign-in.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open myG account pages such as password change.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.auth.AuthActivity
description: The myG game SDK displays account sign-in and registration, including password, Facebook, and Google sign-in.
disableEffect: Players will not be able to use myG sign-in or registration.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.notification.GCMNotificationIntentService
description: myG turns incoming game messages into phone notifications; tapping one opens the game or a link from the message.
disableEffect: Notifications handled by this older myG push flow will no longer appear.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.notification.MyGFirebaseInstanceIDService
description: myG registers refreshed Firebase device tokens with its notification service so push messages can be delivered.
disableEffect: myG may stop receiving push messages after Firebase changes the device token.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.notification.MyGFirebaseMessagingService
description: myG receives Firebase game messages and displays their title and text as phone notifications using the app icon.
disableEffect: These myG push notifications will no longer appear on the device.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.notification.MyGNotifiListener
description: When a myG notification is tapped, this receiver opens the game or the link included with the message and dismisses the notification.
disableEffect: Tapping myG notifications will no longer open the game or their linked pages.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.payment.PaymentActivity
description: myG displays the player’s balance and payment options here, then returns the payment result to the game.
disableEffect: The game’s myG payment and top-up screen will not open.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.payment.banking.PaymentBankingActivity
description: myG loads the signed-in player’s bank-payment page inside the app for purchases.
disableEffect: Players will not be able to pay by bank through myG.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.payment.iap.PaymentIapActivity
description: myG starts the selected in-app purchase through Google Play and reports its result to the game.
disableEffect: Players will not be able to buy the selected game items through Google Play.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.payment.payment_web.PaymentWebActivity
description: myG opens the web checkout for a purchase and returns its success result to the payment screen.
disableEffect: Players will not be able to complete these myG web payments.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.tracking.InstallReceiver
description: myG saves campaign details from Google Play install-referrer messages and passes them to Google campaign tracking.
disableEffect: myG install-source details will no longer be saved or passed to campaign tracking.

name: vn.myg.gamesdk.features.user.UserActivity
description: myG opens the player account center with configured pages such as profile, inbox, transaction history, support, game offers, and invitations.
disableEffect: Players will lose access to the myG account center, including its profile and transaction pages.

name: vn.tiki.android.chat.main.ChatActivity
description: When the app opens a conversation, the Tiki Android Chat SDK creates the chat screen and passes it the conversation address and any attachment supplied by the app.
disableEffect: Users cannot open this conversation screen, so the app's in-app chat feature is unavailable.

name: vn.tiki.android.chat.main.LinkCatcherActivity
description: When a user opens a Tiki chat link, the Tiki Android Chat SDK converts it into a chat page address and opens that conversation.
disableEffect: Tiki chat links cannot open their conversation in the app.

name: vn.tiki.android.chat.main.deeplink.ChatDeepLinkHandlerActivity
description: When a user opens a Tiki chat link from outside the app, the Tiki Android Chat SDK passes the link to the app's launch screen so it can open the matching conversation.
disableEffect: External Tiki chat links cannot route the user into the requested conversation.

name: vn.tiki.android.chat.main.link.LinkCatcherActivity
description: When a user opens a Tiki chat link, the Tiki Android Chat SDK converts it and sends the resulting chat address to the app for handling.
disableEffect: The app does not receive chat links through this path, so those links cannot open their conversation.

name: wang.leal.ahel.socket.process.SocketService
description: The AHEL socket library runs a separate-process service for TCP connections requested by the app. It relays connection status and received messages between app clients and those connections.
disableEffect: App features that rely on this library for live socket messages may lose their connection.

name: webtrekk.android.sdk.integration.EngageIntegrationReceiver
description: When Mapp Engage broadcasts a user's identifier to Mapp Intelligence, this receiver stores it so analytics events can be associated with that user.
disableEffect: Mapp Engage and Mapp Intelligence will stop sharing this user identifier.

name: webtrekk.android.sdk.integration.MappIntelligenceListener
description: When Mapp Intelligence sends an alias update through the Mapp event broadcast, this receiver saves the alias for Mapp Intelligence.
disableEffect: Alias changes sent from Mapp events will no longer be saved by Mapp Intelligence.

name: wigzo.android.sdk.messaging.ProxyActivity
description: Wigzo’s messaging SDK opens this Activity when a push message is tapped or displayed while the app is open; it shows the message and follows its configured app link or review action.
disableEffect: Wigzo push message dialogs and their app links or review prompts will no longer open.

name: wigzo.android.sdk.messaging.WigzoMessaging
description: Wigzo’s real-time messaging SDK uses this Receiver for Google cloud push broadcasts and forwards received messages to Wigzo’s message service.
disableEffect: Wigzo push campaigns will no longer be received by this app; the app’s other features remain available.

name: wigzo.android.sdk.messaging.WigzoMessagingService
description: Wigzo’s messaging SDK starts this Service after a push arrives; it checks the message and posts a notification, or opens the message in a dialog when the app is already open.
disableEffect: Wigzo push notifications and in-app message prompts will stop appearing.

name: wigzo.sdk.ProxyActivity
description: Wigzo’s push SDK opens this Activity when a user taps a notification; it records the open and takes the user to the configured app screen or web link.
disableEffect: Wigzo push notification links will no longer open their configured destination.

name: wigzo.sdk.WigzoInstanceIDListenerService
description: Google Play services starts this Wigzo Service when the push registration token changes; it clears the old registration state and starts registration again.
disableEffect: Wigzo push delivery may stop after a token change, while the app’s other features remain available.

name: wigzo.sdk.WigzoRegistrationIntentService
description: Wigzo’s push SDK starts this Service after registration changes to obtain the Google push token, send it with device and organization details to Wigzo, and subscribe the device to its push topic.
disableEffect: The app may stop receiving Wigzo push messages or have its device registration out of date.

name: world.mappable.runtime.connectivity.internal.ConnectivityService
description: Mappable MapKit runs this scheduled job to notify the app when network connectivity changes. The SDK’s map and navigation features can then refresh their online or offline state.
disableEffect: Map and navigation features may not respond correctly when connectivity is lost or restored.

name: world.shanya.serialport.discovery.DiscoveryActivity
description: Shanya SerialPort opens this screen to search for paired and nearby Bluetooth devices. Choosing a device starts a BLE or classic Bluetooth connection.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to discover and connect Bluetooth devices through the SerialPort screen.

name: world.shanya.serialport.server.SerialPortServerService
description: While a Shanya SerialPort Bluetooth server connection is active, this service reads incoming data from the connected device and sends it to the app's receive callback.
disableEffect: The app will stop receiving data from devices connected through SerialPort server mode.

name: world.shanya.serialport.service.SerialPortService
description: While a Shanya SerialPort classic Bluetooth connection is active, this service reads incoming data and reports it to the app as text or hexadecimal bytes.
disableEffect: The app will stop receiving data over classic Bluetooth serial connections.

name: wormholelogger.log.LogProvider
description: WormholeLogger uses this provider at app startup to initialize its logging client and connect to the optional cloud-logging service.
disableEffect: The app can still run, but WormholeLogger will not connect its client for cloud log forwarding.

name: wormholelogger.service.WormholeLoggerService
description: When a WormholeLogger client binds, this service accepts log messages and passes them to a handler that buffers and uploads them through Firebase.
disableEffect: App features remain available, but WormholeLogger messages will not reach its cloud logging service.

name: x.com.base.provider.FileContext
description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog Provider exposes local files as shareable links and initializes the library's application context when Android starts app providers.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes DialogDialog's startup context setup and file-sharing path, which can break library features or initialization.

name: x.com.base.service.StepService
description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog starts this Service when its optional step-count helper is requested. It listens for step-counter readings and writes them to the library log.
disableEffect: The optional step readings from this helper will no longer be collected or logged.

name: x.com.fliepick.media.pick.SystemPickActivity
description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog opens this Activity for file or media selection and preview flows. It displays the picker or preview screen requested by the app.
disableEffect: DialogDialog file/media selection and preview flows will fail to open.

name: x.com.rxHttp.download.FileDownloadService
description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog starts and binds to this Service for background file downloads. It reports progress in a notification and can offer an install action when a downloaded app package finishes.
disableEffect: File downloads, their progress notifications, and any app-package installation flow using this Service will stop working.

name: x.com.util.permissions.ApplyPermissionActivity
description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog opens this Activity when a library feature requests Android permissions or document access. It shows the permission flow and returns the result to the requester.
disableEffect: Permission requests cannot complete, so DialogDialog features that need those permissions or document access may fail.

name: xenoss.sdkdevkit.android.adrenderer.internal.mraid.MraidActivity
description: When the Moloco Android ad renderer displays an interactive ad, this Activity shows it full screen and handles its orientation and close controls.
disableEffect: Interactive ads using this renderer will not display.

name: xenoss.sdkdevkit.android.adrenderer.internal.staticrenderer.StaticAdActivity
description: When the Moloco Android ad renderer presents a static ad, this Activity shows the ad full screen and handles ad taps or closing.
disableEffect: Static ads using this renderer will not display.

name: xenoss.sdkdevkit.android.adrenderer.internal.vast.VastActivity
description: When the Moloco Android ad renderer presents a video ad, this Activity plays it full screen and closes when the ad finishes or is dismissed.
disableEffect: Video ads using this renderer will not display.

name: xyz.appinform.appinformsdk.OnboardingActivity
description: AppInform opens its web-based guided tour in this screen using the tour address and identity details supplied by the app. It appears when the app requests an onboarding guide.
disableEffect: Guided tours will not open, and an app request to launch one may fail.

name: xyz.junerver.compose.hooks.BiometricActivity
description: ComposeHooks opens Android’s biometric prompt when an app requests biometric verification. It passes the authentication result back to the calling flow.
disableEffect: Apps using this hook may be unable to complete biometric sign-in or unlock.

name: xyz.junerver.fileselector.FileSelectorActivity
description: Junerver FileSelector opens a local file browser, requests the required storage access, and returns the files the user selects. Apps start it when a user chooses files to attach or import.
disableEffect: The app’s file-picking or import flow may fail.

name: xyz.junerver.update.InitProvider
description: Junerver's update library initializes this provider at app startup and checks for update information when the configured app screen resumes.
disableEffect: The app will stop receiving automatic update checks from this library; its normal screens remain available.

name: xyz.junerver.utils.UtilsFileProvider
description: The Junerver Utils Android utility library starts this Provider when Android initializes the app's content providers; it initializes the utility library and supplies app-scoped file links for file operations.
disableEffect: Utility functions that rely on its startup setup or file links, including file sharing and app installation helpers, can fail or crash.

name: xyz.junerver.utils.UtilsTransActivity
description: The Junerver Utils Android utility library briefly opens this Activity for runtime permission requests and other operations that need to return a result to the app.
disableEffect: Apps that rely on these helpers may lose permission prompts or returned results, which can block permission-dependent features.

name: xyz.klinker.android.article.ArticleActivity
description: When an app opens an article URL with Klinker's Android Article Viewer, this Activity fetches and displays the article. If the page cannot be parsed as an article, it opens the URL in a browser custom tab.
disableEffect: The app's Klinker article reader will not open, so article reading through that screen is unavailable.

name: xyz.klinker.android.article.ImageViewActivity
description: When an app opens an article image with Klinker's Android Article Viewer, this Activity loads the image URL into a full-screen, swipe-away image view.
disableEffect: Images opened through the article viewer will no longer display in its image screen.

name: xyz.klinker.giphy.GiphyActivity
description: When the app opens Klinker's Giphy Search picker, it loads trending GIFs or stickers, searches entered terms, and downloads a selected item to the configured location.
disableEffect: The app's GIF and sticker picker will not open, so users cannot search for or download items from it.

name: xyz.klinker.wear.reply.TextReplyActivity
description: When a user chooses a typed response in the Klinker Wear Reply flow, this Activity accepts the text and returns it to the calling screen.
disableEffect: Typing a response from the wearable reply screen will no longer work.

name: xyz.klinker.wear.reply.WearableReplyActivity
description: When the app asks Klinker Wear Reply to compose a wearable notification reply, this Activity offers preset responses, voice recognition, or typed text and returns the selected response to the app.
disableEffect: Preset, voice, and typed replies from that wearable reply screen will no longer be available.

name: xyz.metakeep.sdk.AuthActivity
description: The MetaKeep Android SDK opens this Activity when the app begins browser-based authentication; it launches the sign-in page and returns the success or cancellation result to the app.
disableEffect: MetaKeep authentication cannot complete, so app features that require that sign-in may be unavailable.

name: xyz.metakeep.sdk.RedirectActivity
description: When a browser returns through the MetaKeep SDK's configured Android link, this Activity forwards the returned link to the SDK authentication screen to complete sign-in.
disableEffect: The browser return cannot reach the app, so MetaKeep authentication may remain incomplete.

name: xyz.truenight.rxinapps.HiddenActivity
description: TrueNight's RxInApps Google Play billing library opens this transparent Activity for a purchase request; it launches Play's purchase confirmation and processes the returned purchase result.
disableEffect: In-app purchases and purchase restoration through this library cannot complete, so paid content may not unlock.

name: xyz.vfhhu.lib.android.PerMissionActivity
description: The vfhhu AndroidLib toolkit opens this Activity with a permission request; it requests supported runtime permissions and offers retry or exit choices when access is denied.
disableEffect: The app may be unable to request permissions through this screen, preventing features that need that access from working.

name: zendesk.belvedere.BelvedereFileProvider
description: Zendesk Belvedere uses this Provider to make selected files available to attachment and sharing features, so the support app or receiving app can open them.
disableEffect: Attaching or sharing files may fail because the app can no longer provide the selected file.

name: zendesk.messaging.MessagingActivity
description: The Zendesk Messaging SDK opens this screen when the app starts a support conversation. It displays the conversation and message composer and handles navigation within the chat.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or use the Zendesk support conversation.

name: zone.bi.mobile.fingerprint.impl.cs.FpWorkerService
description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK binds this background worker when its device-fingerprinting checks need to run. It supplies device signals used during payment security checks.
disableEffect: The payment security checks cannot use this worker, so a payment that depends on its device signals may fail.
